1.def_en: adj. habitually complaining
1.ex_en: One gets unsettled, depressed, and inclined to be querulous.
1.ex_zh: 有的人变得心绪不宁，神情沮丧，动不动就爱发牢骚。

1.def_en: n. mechanical or unthinking routine or repetition
1.ex_en: He is very skeptical about the value of rote learning.
1.ex_zh: 他非常怀疑死记硬背是否有用。

1.def_en: v. to plan with cleverness or ingenuity
1.ex_en: They somehow contrived to lose ten s of thousands of applications.
1.ex_zh: 他们精心策划故意遗失了数万份申请书。

1.def_en: adj. dealing with or affecting a great variety of different things
1.ex_en: The negotiations have a wide- ranging scope with emphasis on trade and investment liberalization and facilitation.
1.ex_zh: 谈判涵盖的范畴广泛，重点是贸易和投资的自由化及便利化。

1.def_en: v. to confuse completely
1.ex_en: An apple tree producing square fruit is baffling experts.
1.ex_zh: 一棵结方形苹果的树令专家大惑不解。

1.def_en: (1)n. a symbolic representation (2)n. a story in which the characters and events are symbols that stand for ideas about human life or for a political or historical situation
1.ex_en: The contrast in their personalities reminded me of the biblical allegory of Cain and Abel.
1.ex_zh: 二人性格的反差让我想起来《圣经》里该隐和亚伯的寓言。

1.def_en: adj. directly forward
1.ex_en: I admire her forthright way of dealing with people.
1.ex_zh: 我钦佩她那直率待人的方式。

1.def_en: v. to say in a very strong and definite way
1.ex_en: In spite of all you say, I still aver that his report is true. ,
1.ex_zh: 不管你怎么说；我还是断言他的报告是真实的。

1.def_en: adj. flagrantly wicked or impious
1.ex_en: The EU reckons that Intel's use of such rebates was nefarious.
1.ex_zh: 欧盟认为，英特尔利用返点促销用意恶毒。

1.def_en: v. to recruit someone to join one's party, institution, or cause
1.def_zh: 极力劝诱某人加入（政党或宗教）
1.ex_en: Do not proselytize your work or ideas.
1.ex_zh: 不要变节你的工作或观念

1.def_en: v. to feel or express annoyance or ill will at
1.ex_en: Many conscripts resent having to do their military service.
1.ex_zh: 许多应征入伍者对被迫服兵役愤愤不平。

1.def_en: v. to increase or improve
1.ex_en: BBC backing for the scheme will enhance its credibility.
1.ex_zh: 英国广播公司对这一计划的支持将提高其可信度。

1.def_en: n. dissent or deviation from a dominant theory, opinion, or practice
1.ex_en: He was burned at the stake for heresy.
1.ex_zh: 他因为信奉异端思想而以火刑处死。

1.def_en: adj. done or said in a natural and often sudden way and without a lot of thought or planning
1.ex_en: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
1.ex_zh: 观众自发地鼓起掌来。

1.def_en: adj. having no personal reference or connection
1.ex_en: We must be as impersonal as a surgeon with his knife
1.ex_zh: 我们必须像外科医生拿手术刀时一样冷静客观，不受任何感情影响。

1.def_en: (1)adj. not usual (2)adj. much better than average

1.ex_zh: 他显示出特殊的音乐才能。

1.def_en: adj. turbulent, stormy
1.ex_en: Somehow the marriage lasted for eight tempestuous months. 8
1.ex_zh: 不管怎么说，那场婚姻还是维持了；个月，其间双方的关系一直很紧张。

1.def_en: adj. extremely or excessively particular, exacting, or meticulous in taste or standards
1.ex_en: Even the most finicky eater will find something appetizing here.
1.ex_zh: 即使是最挑剔的食客在这里也会找到让人胃口大开的美食。

1.def_en: v. to come together
1.ex_en: The capitalists amass great wealth by exploiting workers.
1.ex_zh: 资本家剥削工人而积累了巨额财富。

1.def_en: (1)v. to adopt an air of condescension toward (2)v. provide aid or support for
1.def_zh: 以高人一等的态度去对待；支持
1.ex_en: Don't you patronize me!
1.ex_zh: 别在我面前摆出一副屈尊俯就的样子！

1.def_en: (1)v. to turn away or aside (2)v. to prevent from happening
1.ex_en: Efforts are being made to avert war and find a diplomatic solution.
1.ex_zh: 各方正在为避免战争、寻求外交解决途径而作出积极的努力。

1.def_en: v. torment, vex
1.ex_en: Todd could take it, whereas I'm harrowed by it.
1.ex_zh: 托德可以忍受，但是我却感到很痛苦。

1.def_en: v. to compose out of materials from other documents
1.ex_en: The album was compiled from live recordings from last year's tour.
1.ex_zh: 这套唱片选辑由去年巡回演出的实况录音汇编而成。

1.def_en: v. to make a ritual of ...

1.ex_zh: 以仪式化的方式去结束这一天的工作。

1.def_en: (1)adj. of or relating to trees (2)adj. living in or often found in trees

1.ex_zh: 松鼠是树栖动物。

1.def_en: n. a way of using humor to show that someone or something is foolish, weak, bad, etc.
1.ex_en: The novel is a stinging satire on American politics.
1.ex_zh: 这部小说是对美国政治的尖锐讽刺。

1.def_en: n. the power of choosing or determining
1.ex_en: We like to think that everything we do and everything we think is a product of our volition.
1.ex_zh: 我们愿意认为我们所做和所想的一切都是出于自己的意志。

1.def_en: adj. existing from the time a person or animal is born
1.ex_en: Correct ideas are not innate in the mind.
1.ex_zh: 人的正确思想不是自己头脑中固有的。

1.def_en: adj. expressing praise or admiration for someone or something

1.ex_zh: 梅格的妈妈在书中自己写到：自己是不应该被女儿称赞的。

1.def_en: v. to dislike greatly and often with disgust or intolerance
1.ex_en: You loathe the smell of greasy food when you are seasick.
1.ex_zh: 当你晕船时，你会厌恶油腻的气味。

1.def_en: adj. very thorough
1.ex_en: He has made an exhaustive study of the problem.
1.ex_zh: 他对这个问题进行了彻底的研究。

1.def_en: adj. painfully affecting the feelings
1.ex_en: In fact, they are probably the most poignant and important experience.
1.ex_zh: 事实上，它们可能是你最深刻最重要的人生阅历。

1.def_en: v. to attract and hold the attention of by being interesting, pretty, etc.
1.ex_en: For 40 years she has captivated the world with her radiant looks. 40
1.ex_zh: 年来，她那令人惊艳的美貌让全世界为之痴迷。

1.def_en: v. to put on
1.ex_en: Today's bikini offers more support, a nd the body-conscious woman is able to don a bikini in confidence.
1.ex_zh: 今天的比基尼给人体多一些支撑，让担心自己身材的女士有自信穿上它。

1.def_en: n. the physical or social setting in which something occurs or develops

1.ex_zh: 他们幸福无忧地呆在自己的社交圈子里

1.def_en: v. to give an omen or anticipatory sign of

1.ex_zh: 该变化没有预示社会状况的基本改观。

1.def_en: n. government, rule
1.ex_en: Everybody here must obey the new regimen.
1.ex_zh: 每一个在这里的人都必须服从这个新政体。

1.def_en: adj. having no plan, order, or direction
1.ex_en: The books had been piled on the shelves in a haphazard fashion.
1.ex_zh: 书架上的书堆放得杂乱无序。

1.def_en: adj. having or showing a lack of intelligence or serious thought
1.ex_en: When you feel vacuous and unhappy, you can do some labour, such as cleaning the house, tables and windows .
1.ex_zh: 感到空虚不快乐的时候你可以劳动一下，比如打扫房子，抹抹桌子，窗子啥的。

1.def_en: adj. coming from outside
1.ex_en: For many people the Church was a symbol of external authority.
1.ex_zh: 对许多人来讲，教堂是外来权威的象征。

1.def_en: adj. capable of being easily led, taught, or controlled
1.ex_en: He could easily manage his tractable and worshipping younger brother.
1.ex_zh: 他能轻而易举地管住听话并且崇拜自己的弟弟。

1.def_en: adj. of very great weight
1.ex_en: He's slow and ponderous, and can pick up and put down objects nearby.
1.ex_zh: 它行动迟缓笨重，可以拿起或者放下旁边的物件。

1.def_en: v. to assign value or merit to

1.ex_zh: —；但是自从他去世半个世纪以来，一件奇怪的事情发生了—那些反对他的人现在对他评价很高。

1.def_en: n. devotion or loyalty to a person, group, or cause
1.ex_en: The constitution requires members of parliament to take an oath of allegiance.
1.ex_zh: 宪法规定，议员必须宣誓效忠。

1.def_en: v. to say in a strong and definitive way that someone or something is bad or wrong

1.ex_zh: 政界领袖昨日联合起来对最近激增的暴力事件予以谴责。

1.def_en: v. to give up or leave entirely
1.ex_en: To forsake good for the sake of gold is not for me.
1.ex_zh: 我不干这种见利忘义的事。

1.def_en: adj. shockingly unfair or unjust

1.ex_zh: 留给下一代巨额债务负担和一个衰败的国家是不合理的。

1.def_en: adj. existing or occurring at the same time

1.ex_zh: 那同时发出的两声枪响听起来像是一响

1.def_en: n. a heavy burden

1.ex_zh: 对今天的政治家而言，该条约正成为一大包袱。

1.def_en: adj. too important and respected to be changed, criticized, etc.
1.ex_en: Freedom of the press is sacrosanct.
1.ex_zh: 新闻自由是神圣不可侵犯的。

1.def_en: (1)v. to prevent from doing something (2)v. to keep under control
1.ex_en: he was unable to restrain her desperate anger.
1.ex_zh: 她无法控制自己极度的愤怒。

1.def_en: adj. creating disunity or dissension

1.ex_zh: 人工流产一直是个引发争议的问题。

1.def_en: (1)v. to express sorrow, mourning, or regret for often demonstratively (2)n. complaint
1.ex_en: The royal members lamented the passing of aristocratic society.
1.ex_zh: 王室家族成员悲叹贵族社会的消失。

1.def_en: adj. having qualities appropriate to or usually associated with a man

1.ex_zh: 他看起来很有男子汉气概和驾驭能力。

1.def_en: adj. of a commonplace or repetitious character

1.ex_zh: 太多的日子都是平淡和无趣，尤其是在冬季。

1.def_en: adj. done in a quiet and secret way to avoid being noticed
1.ex_en: His furtive behavior aroused our suspicion.
1.ex_zh: 他鬼鬼祟祟的行为引起了我们的怀疑。

1.def_en: adj. causing someone to feel sad or without hope

1.ex_zh: 总之，等待琼斯的似乎是一个相当令人沮丧的夏天。

1.def_en: adj. very strong, clear, and effective

1.ex_zh: 他的评论既一针见血又鞭辟入里。

1.def_en: v. to oppose or challenge especially in a direct and forceful way ...

1.ex_zh: 这是他第一次面对一个武装劫匪。

1.def_en: v. to change level, strength, or value frequently

1.ex_zh: 人患病后体温可能会上下波动。

1.def_en: n. luck that takes the form of finding valuable or pleasant things that are not looked for

1.ex_zh: 我园子里最珍贵的几件物品是机缘巧合之下意外所得。

1.ex_zh: 医生被指责滥用抗生素。

1.def_en: v. to take on an aggressively defensive attitudes

1.ex_zh: 他怒发冲冠。

1.def_en: n. the beginning of something

1.ex_zh: 随着冬天的来临，大多数的关卡都已经关闭。

1.def_en: adj. of basic importance

1.ex_zh: 作为推销员；最基本的原则是竭尽全力让顾客满意。

1.def_en: adj. not focusing the mind on a matter

1.ex_zh: 政府声称那是因疏忽造成的过失。

1.def_en: adj. showing or expressing deference

1.def_en: v. bring about, cause

1.ex_zh: 肯定有什么重大的事导致了这次访问。

1.def_en: adj. not healthy or normal

1.ex_zh: 不厌其烦地谈论墓地以及诸如此类的事是一种病态。

1.def_en: adj. brilliantly lively, stimulating, or witty

1.ex_zh: 你几乎想不到那么点儿的孩子会说出妙趣横生的话来。

1.def_en: n. a diverse assortment or mixture
1.ex_en: Japan won the Men's 200 metre individual medley. 200
1.ex_zh: 日本赢得了男子；米个人混合泳比赛。

1.ex_zh: 他的被动态度使我办起事来容易多了。

1.def_en: v. to keep from doing what he or she wants to do

1.ex_zh: 葡萄酒或含糖饮料抑制消化。

1.def_en: v. to be better than
1.ex_en: The men tried to outdo each other in their generosity.
1.ex_zh: 男人们个个试图展示自己比别人慷慨。

1.def_en: v. to cause to vibrate in a definite pattern

1.ex_zh: 在英国，导弹部署极大地导致了意见进一步分化。

1.def_en: n. a sharp cleavage
1.ex_en: The failure of any process in meiosis can result in chromosome mal- disjunction. ,
1.ex_zh: 这个过程中；任何一个环节的错误都可能会导致染色体的异常分离。

1.def_en: adj. conflicting with accepted standards of good conduct or good taste

1.ex_zh: 尽管凯莉非常爱他却无法忽视他那有失体统的行为。

1.def_en: v. to completely do away with

1.ex_zh: 美国；年废除了奴隶制度。

1.def_en: n. a great success or achievement
1.ex_en: The winning team returned home in triumph .
1.ex_zh: 球队凯旋而归。

1.def_en: adj. able to be discussed and changed before an agreement or decision is made

1.ex_zh: 他告诫说他为国家制订的经济计划是不容商榷的。

1.def_en: n. an opinion or idea formed without proof or sufficient evidence
1.ex_en: That was a conjecture, not a fact.
1.ex_zh: 那只是猜测，不是事实。

1.def_en: v. to give support or maintain loyalty

1.ex_zh: 锡克教徒应当严格遵守该教对外表的规定。

1.def_en: n. a disastrous event marked by great loss and lasting distress and suffering

1.ex_zh: 最近南方的洪水是一场灾难。

1.def_en: adj. having an air of easy unconcern or indifference
1.ex_en: Denis tried to look nonchalant and uninterested.
1.ex_zh: 丹尼斯竭力表现出漠不关心、不感兴趣的样子。

1.def_en: v. food for animals especially when taken by browsing or grazing
1.ex_en: Gregarious species forage in flocks from colonies or roosts.
1.ex_zh: 群居动物从聚居地或栖息地成群结队地外出觅食。

1.def_en: adj. interchangeable

1.ex_zh: 金融创新与全球化已使得资本变得可以替代。

1.def_en: v. to actively second and encourage

1.ex_zh: 你所作的一切足以被控教唆犯罪。

1.def_en: n. a feeling of great happiness and excitement
1.ex_en: There was euphoria after the electio ns.
1.ex_zh: 选举后一片兴高采烈。

1.def_en: v. to reduce to minute particles or to a fine spray
1.ex_en: For proper combustion it is necessary to atomize the propellants.
1.ex_zh: 为了有效地进行燃烧，推进剂必须雾化。

1.def_en: v. take back, cancel
1.ex_en: Trade Union leaders have demanded the government rescind the price rise.
1.ex_zh: 工会领导已经要求政府阻止价格上涨。

1.def_en: n. a deserter from one faith, cause, or allegiance to another
1.ex_en: When he was doing underground work he was arrested because a renegade informed against him.
1.ex_zh: 他做地下工作时，曾因叛徒告密而被捕。

1.def_en: n. personal belongings
1.ex_en: All my fishing paraphernalia is in the car.
1.ex_zh: 我的钓鱼用品都在汽车里。

1.def_en: n. a feeling of contempt for someone or something regarded as unworthy or inferior
1.ex_en: Jackie disdained the servants that h er millions could buy.
1.ex_zh: 杰姬鄙视那些她用钱就可以收买的奴仆。

1.def_en: v. to advance beyond the usual or proper limits

1.ex_zh: 中国的领土和主权绝不允许任何人侵犯。

1.def_en: v. to make noble
1.ex_en: Hard work ennobles human spirit.
1.ex_zh: 艰苦的工作使人精神变得高尚。

1.def_en: v. to fall or drop suddenly in amount, value, etc.
1.ex_en: Mengniu and Yili have seen their shares plummet since the incident broke. , .
1.ex_zh: 自事件发生以来；蒙牛和伊利的股票大幅下跌

1.def_en: adj. able to be understood in more than one way
1.ex_en: This agreement is very ambiguous and open to various interpretations.
1.ex_zh: 这份协议非常含糊，可以有多种解释。

1.def_en: v. to coax with flattery
1.ex_en: They find means to approach to me and blandish to me. ,
1.ex_zh: 他们总是想尽一切办法来接近我；讨好我。

1.def_en: n. a show of intention to inflict harm
1.ex_en: In my view you are a menace to the public.
1.ex_zh: 在我看来，你对公众是个威胁。

1.def_en: (1)v. to move on unsteadily (2)v. to cause to doubt or hesitate

1.ex_zh: 目送老妇人扛着一大包衣服蹒跚而去，实在令人心酸。

1.def_en: (1)adj. strong and healthy (2)adj. successful or impressive and not likely to fail or weaken
1.ex_en: The Secretary of State has made a robust defence of the agreement.
1.ex_zh: 国务卿对这项协议进行了强有力的辩护。

1.def_en: v. to pass or flow slowly through or as if through small openings or interstices

1.ex_zh: 他看到这个男人后脑勺上有道大口子，血还在往外渗。

2.def_en: n. matters relating to the life or culture of ancient times
2.ex_en: The museum contains the remains of Chinese antiquity.
2.ex_zh: 博物馆藏有中国古代的遗物。

2.def_en: n. a cooperative relationship (as between two persons or groups)
2.ex_en: One consequence for coral reefs is that the symbiosis between the corals and algae that constitute a living reef is breaking down.

2.ex_zh: 整个地球可以想像为一块硕大的磁石。

3.def_en: (1)v. to grasp with the understanding (2)v. to anticipate especially with anxiety, dread, or fear (3)v. arrest, seize
3.ex_en: I would try to understand the conversation by watching the captions, so as to apprehend it better.
3.ex_zh: 在看的过程中，我会努力的去听里面人物的对话，去看屏幕上的字幕，以便能够更好的理解它。

3.def_en: n. an imperfection or lack that detracts from the whole

3.ex_zh: 不守时间是他的最大缺点

3.def_en: (2)v. to gradually go from an advanced state to a

3.ex_zh: 将向地方政府下放更多的权力。

3.def_en: v. to represent (an abstraction) by a concrete instance

3.ex_zh: 他的论文里有关于这两个组的研究，研究似乎能似乎能举例说明这东西有效性。

3.def_en: n. the path of a point in a plane moving around a central point while continuously receding from or approaching it
3.ex_en: The process is not a circle but rather a spiral
3.ex_zh: 这个过程不是一个圆周运动而是螺旋上升型的。

3.def_en: adj. arising from annoyance or irascibility

3.ex_zh: 她经常对孩子们凶巴巴的。

3.def_en: n. an outline or synopsis of a play
3.ex_en: In the worst-case scenario, you could become a homeless person.
3.ex_zh: 最坏的情况是你可能会无家可归。

3.def_en: adj. causing or tending to cause sleep
3.ex_en: The warmth of the room and the monotony of the speaker's voice grew soporific.
3.ex_zh: 房间里的热气和发言人单调的声音让人昏昏欲睡。

3.def_en: v. to say publicly and forcefully that you regard as bad, wrong, etc.
3.ex_en: People decried the campaign as a w aste of money.
3.ex_zh: 人们谴责这一活动是浪费金钱。

3.def_en: adj. plain to the understanding especially because of clarity and precision of presentation
3.ex_en: The analysis of concepts is a matter of finding more perspicuous and complexity-revealing words.
3.ex_zh: 对概念进行分析是一项有关寻找更加明白易懂和能揭示复杂性的词汇的问题。

3.def_en: n. the implicit or metaphorical meaning (as of a literary text)

3.ex_zh: 新上映的惊悚电影《欧罗巴》背后的潜台词是欧洲的分裂。

3.def_en: n. a body of people entitled to vote
3.ex_en: The government largely misread the mood of the electorate.
3.ex_zh: 政府在很大程度上没有弄清楚全体选民的情绪。

3.def_en: n. skill in planning, making, or executing
3.ex_en: Nowadays, people tend to write lette r by computers, there was a time, no t so long ago, when letter writing was a real cr aft.
3.ex_zh: 现在，人们更愿意用电脑写信了，不久的以前，那时候手写书信也算是一种手艺。

3.def_en: n. action that is quickest or most effective in a particular situation
3.ex_en: This was a matter less of morals than of expediency.
3.ex_zh: 此举只是权宜之计，不关乎道德问题。

3.def_en: n. a contrary or opposing force
3.ex_en: Currently, the only counterforce to the power of the capital is the supreme political power.
3.ex_zh: 目前在中国能够对抗资本强大力量的只有最高的政治权利。

3.def_en: v. to adapt (someone) to a new temperature, altitude, climate, environment, or situation
3.ex_en: Jim have become acclimate to this weather since he move here.
3.ex_zh: 吉姆搬到这里后，他已适应这里的天气。

3.def_en: adj. strongly marked

3.ex_zh: 早期罗马的事务是属于显著的贵族政治类型。

3.def_en: adj. successful, well- known and respected
3.ex_en: He is one of the three eminent profe ssors in the college.
3.ex_zh: 他是这所大学三名杰出教授之一。

3.def_en: n. a place of refuge and protection
3.ex_en: There was a sanctuary of political refugees behind the hospital.
3.ex_zh: 医院后面有一个政治难民的避难所。

3.def_en: n. a practice or interest followed for a time with exaggerated zeal

3.ex_zh: 事实证明，说唱音乐并不是昙花一现。

3.def_en: adj. commonplace, unimaginative

3.ex_zh: 他的文风十分平庸，那本书乏味至极。

3.def_en: (1)adj. likely to cause people to argue or disagree (2)adj. likely or willing to argue
3.ex_en: Sanctions are expected to be among the most contentious issues.
3.ex_zh: 制裁可能会是争议最大的问题之一。

3.def_en: v. to cause or aid the development of
3.ex_en: The birds returned to their nests and continued to incubate the eggs.
3.ex_zh: 鸟儿回到巢里继续孵卵。

3.def_en: n. the forefront of an action or movement
3.ex_en: In a way they played a vanguard role.
3.ex_zh: 在某种意义上说，他们起了先锋的作用。

3.def_en: n. something pleasant or helpful
3.ex_en: Low-cost Chinese imports have been a boon to European consumers, retailers and producers.
3.ex_zh: 低成本的中国进口产品给欧洲消费者、零售商和生产商带来了实惠。

3.def_en: adj. having or showing great skills or cleverness
3.ex_en: As people grow older they generally become less dexterous.
3.ex_zh: 随着年龄的增长，人通常会变得不再那么手巧。

3.def_en: adj. lacking life, spirit, or zest
3.ex_en: My problem is, that when we get a few wins, we become lackadaisical .
3.ex_zh: 我的问题是，当取得一点点地胜利时，我们就会变得懒散。

3.def_en: adj. acting, moving, or changing in ways that are not expected or usual
3.ex_en: Businessmen are displeased with erratic economic policy- making.
3.ex_zh: 商界人士对变化无常的经济决策很是恼火。

3.def_en: adj. of little or no consequence
3.ex_en: He believed all of their conclusion comes from a nugatory and pointless observation.
3.ex_zh: 他相信他们的结论来自毫无价值和毫无意义的观察。

3.def_en: adj. belonging to the basic nature of someone or something
3.ex_en: Industry and frugality are the inherent qualities of the Chinese nation.
3.ex_zh: 勤劳俭朴是中华民族的本色。

3.def_en: n. a rash or reckless act

3.ex_zh: 她们对他的轻率鲁莽感到惊异。

3.ex_zh: 国家的官僚机构往往会扼杀人们的事业心和积极性。

3.def_en: adj. different from what is usually done or accepted

3.ex_zh: 许多医生不赞同用非正统的药品。

3.ex_zh: 他总喜欢干涉别人的事。

3.def_en: v. to show

3.ex_zh: 总统本身代表着一个国家的形象。

3.def_en: adj. good at doing something

3.ex_zh: 很多埃及人都精通外语。

3.def_en: adj. lacking in foresight or discernment

3.def_en: v. to twist or weave together

3.ex_zh: 该节目将文字和画面成功地交织在一起。

3.def_en: adj. not done or experienced before

3.ex_zh: 这种做法很罕见，但也不是没有先例的。

3.def_en: n. a coming into being or use

3.ex_zh: 在铁路出现之前，骆驼是中国北部去往中亚的主要运输工具。

3.ex_zh: 激进分子的一次叛乱未能实现。

3.def_en: (1)v. to prevent or keep from developing freely (2)v. to become narrower, smaller or tighter

3.ex_zh: 团聚时的气氛非常轻松愉快。

3.ex_zh: 他的职业生涯；可说是典型的美国成功故事。

3.def_en: v. cut down, reduce

3.ex_zh: 英国许多公司都热衷于用税收优惠的方式来鼓励研发。

3.ex_zh: 我离开了父母的家，放弃了我的房产和祖传财产。

3.ex_zh: 他们进了商店，那是幢破烂不堪的奇特建筑。

3.ex_zh: 她对天气作了一番平淡无奇的评论。

3.ex_zh: 他自己的祝酒词虽然也颇为动人；但是比较松散而冗长。

3.ex_zh: 他们发现新来的老师非常严格。

3.ex_zh: 银行家们对结果保持高度谨慎。

3.ex_zh: 他以政治悟性和强势的管理手腕出名。

3.ex_zh: 他们叫嚷着冲到大街上，大街上顿时乱作一团。

3.ex_zh: 他的第一部高成本制作电影《撞板三舞男》遭到恶评。

3.def_en: n. an offensive exhalation or smell

3.ex_zh: 这篇论文介绍了城市污水处理厂臭气来源、成分及产量。

3.def_en: adj. messy or untidy

3.ex_zh: 那个老乞丐蓬头垢面。

3.def_en: (1)v. to damage by rubbing, grinding or scraping (2)v. to wear down in spirit

3.ex_zh: 将军撤销了他不在时所发布的命令。

3.def_en: n. a strong feeling of not liking something

3.ex_zh: 他十分讨厌早起。

3.def_en: v. to end or stop by force

3.ex_zh: 这个政权残酷压制所有不同意见。

3.ex_zh: 低矮的群山上，绿色和棕色混杂着。

3.ex_zh: 他的出色表现让这部电影成为了毋庸置疑的经典。

3.def_en: v. to bring to maturity or self-sufficiency usually through nurturing care

5.def_en: v. to get worse

5.ex_zh: 退潮时，它便成为甲壳动物居住的岩石区潮水潭。

5.def_en: (1)n. the act of making fun of someone or something in a cruel or harsh way (2)v. to laugh at and make jokes about in a cruel or harsh way
5.ex_en: As a heavy child, she became the object of ridicule from classmates.
5.ex_zh: 作为一个胖孩子，她成了同学们的笑柄。

5.def_en: n. one who travels to a shrine or holy place as a devotee

5.ex_zh: 穆罕默德就这样在麦加创立了惟一神，丝毫没有影响麦加朝圣者往来的数量。

5.def_en: adj. elegant, stylish

5.def_en: v. to deal shrewdly or fraudulently with

5.ex_zh: 他骗去了这可怜的妇人的储蓄。

5.def_en: adj. respected and dignified

5.def_en: v. to become quiet or less

5.def_en: n. deceitful cunning

5.def_en: (1)adj. not interesting (2)adj. too simple

5.def_en: n. the state of looking or being like someone or something else

5.ex_zh: 尽管撤回了导弹，该政府在国内消费问题上仍旧保持蔑视的姿态。

5.def_en: (1)n. the state of being simple, uncomplicated, or uncompounded (2)n. lack of subtlety or penetration

5.def_en: v. to deprive of possessions

5.def_en: (1)adj. sudden and extreme (2)adj. attracting attention

5.ex_zh: 自由党在本次补选中取得引人注目的胜利。

5.def_en: n. honor or respect that is felt for or shown to

5.ex_zh: 这首诗表达了他对大自然的深深崇敬之情。

5.def_en: adj. excitingly attractive

5.ex_zh: 吸烟对很多年轻人还是很有诱惑力，他们觉得这让自己显得魅力十足。

5.def_en: adj. having a tendency or inclination

5.ex_zh: 首先，可能是有幻觉倾向的人把咖啡因当做一种自我疗法的方式。

5.def_en: adj. sad or depressed

5.def_en: n. importance

5.ex_zh: 谁领导加拿大对世界来讲也具有一定的重要性。

5.def_en: n. a feeling of good friendship among the people in a group
5.ex_en: Everyone in our class is permeated with the spirit of camaraderie.

5.ex_zh: 白宫官员命令威廉斯公开宣布放弃自己的观点。

5.def_en: n. great happiness or joy

5.ex_zh: 牛津布是一种颇为柔软，多孔的棉织物。

5.def_en: adj. trying to teach something in a way that is annoying or unwanted

5.ex_zh: 这部小说虽然有说教性质，但却搀有大量笑话，使人易于接受。

5.def_en: adj. subsisting or feeding on animal tissues

5.ex_zh: 老虎、狮子和豹都是凶猛的食肉动物。

5.def_en: adj. large and impressively beautiful

5.ex_zh: 工业劳动生产率年平均增长；。

5.ex_zh: 她那经过斟酌的答复会受到选民的欢迎。

5.ex_zh: 科学家在治疗那种疾病方面已有突破。

5.def_en: adj. evoking or tending to evoke an especially emotional response

5.def_en: v. to produce or cause to be produced

5.ex_zh: 要想创造更多的收入，这项体育活动需要变得更加有趣味性。

5.ex_zh: 再过几个月，英国王室将再次集体亮相；再现一场盛大的王室婚礼。

5.ex_zh: 丹蒂旗帜鲜明地谴责不正当恋情。

5.def_en: v. to be slow to act

5.ex_zh: 我们习惯徘徊在自己最喜欢的改变阶段。

5.ex_zh: 无论在圈养场还是在野外，动物园在动物保护方面都承担了主要的工作。

7.ex_zh: 帕金森病是退化性疾病，它袭击大脑中控制运动的部分。

7.def_en: adj. easily affected, influenced, or harmed by something

7.def_en: v. to engage in contemplation or reflection
7.ex_en: That's when I try to meditate or do some deep-breathing exercises.
7.ex_zh: 这时我就会试着沉思或者做些深呼吸练习。

7.def_en: adj. made, shown, or done in a way that is not easily seen or notices

7.ex_zh: 他们一直在暗地里向叛乱者提供军事支援。

7.def_en: adj. important, consequential
7.ex_en: I am deeply honored to be invited to this momentous occasion.
7.ex_zh: 能应邀出席如此重要的场合，我深感荣幸。

7.def_en: adj. loving peace

7.ex_zh: 传统上，自由党人被认为更加爱好和平。

7.def_en: adj. not genuine, sincere, or authentic

7.ex_zh: 他设法制造出一种彻头彻尾的假象，让人误以为公司一派兴旺。

7.def_en: adj. in the wrong way
7.ex_en: Their instincts warned them something was amiss.
7.ex_zh: 他们直觉上感到有什么地方不对劲儿。

7.def_en: adj. used to describe things that touch each other or are immediately next to each other
7.ex_en: Its vineyards are virtually contiguous with those of Ausone.
7.ex_zh: 其葡萄园差不多与着欧颂堡的葡萄园相邻。

7.def_en: n. an untrue statement that is made to damage someone s reputation
7.ex_en: This is a malicious calumny.
7.ex_zh: 这完全是恶意诽谤。

7.def_en: v. to cause to execute tactical movements
7.ex_en: The pilot was able to maneuver the crippled aircraft out of the hostile area.
7.ex_zh: 飞行员成功地操纵严重损坏的飞机驶出敌区。

7.def_en: n. the quality or state of being dual or of having a dual nature
7.ex_en: The nature of a state is a social man rather than an economic man, with a dualism of being both self- interested and altruistic.

7.def_en: v. to make no longer necessary

7.ex_zh: 这一延期将消除卢布汇率面临的压力。

7.def_en: adj. irreproachable
7.ex_en: We deliver faultless products on time.
7.ex_zh: 我们按时交付无缺陷的产品。

7.def_en: adj. incapable of being taken by assault

7.ex_zh: 德意志联邦银行看似不可撼动的地位开始削弱了。

7.def_en: n. a strong feeling of excitement and enthusiasm

7.ex_zh: 这个演讲喚起了民族主义热情。

7.def_en: n. something that prevents or blocks movement from one place to another

7.def_en: adj. threadbare and faded from wear

7.ex_zh: 老头蓬头垢面，衣衫褴褛。

7.def_en: n. the state of being joined in some activity or effort
7.ex_en: What will be the effect of the alliance between IBM and Apple? IBM
7.ex_zh: 若；公司和苹果公司联手将会有什么效果呢？

7.def_en: adj. not having or showing a desire to be noticed, praised, etc.

7.def_en: adj. imperfectly formed or formulated

7.def_en: n. nimbleness, dexterity
7.ex_en: His intellect and mental agility have never been in doubt.
7.ex_zh: 他的才智和机敏从未受到怀疑。

7.def_en: (1)n. unlimited power over a country (2)n. a country s independent authority and the right to govern itself
7.ex_en: These people cherish their independence and sovereignty.
7.ex_zh: 这些人民珍视他们的独立和主权。

7.def_en: n. extreme hatred or dislike
7.ex_en: People always hold this abominable behavior in detestation.
7.ex_zh: 这种恶劣作风一向叫人厌恶。

7.def_en: adj. very excited about and interested in something
7.ex_en: We are keen that our school should get involved too.

7.def_en: adj. having knowledge or experience

7.def_en: adj. showing or feeling very strong emotions
7.ex_en: He made an impassioned appeal for peace.
7.ex_zh: 他慷慨陈词，呼吁和平。

7.def_en: v. to refuse to admit or approve
7.ex_en: The president vetoed the economic package passed by Congress.
7.ex_zh: 总统否决了国会通过的一揽子经济计划。

7.def_en: adj. of a kind that can be remitted
7.ex_en: Her poverty had been a venial fault for two gallant gentlemen.
7.ex_zh: 她的贫穷对那两位殷勤的绅士而言，只是一个微不足道的缺点。

7.def_en: adj. of a timid disposition
7.ex_en: He is a reclusive, timorous creature.
7.ex_zh: 他是个离群索居、胆小羞怯的家伙。

7.def_en: adj. coming and going at intervals
7.ex_en: After three hours of intermittent rain, the game was cancelled. 3
7.ex_zh: 雨断断续续地下了；个小时之后，比赛被取消了。

7.ex_zh: 他坚称他所知道的一切都获自前任肯尼思；赛瑟姆。

7.def_en: adj. free from care, anxiety, or seriousness
7.ex_en: I wanted to be brave, eager, confident, at ease, and lighthearted.
7.ex_zh: 我想变得勇敢，充满渴望，自信，自在，无忧无虑。

7.def_en: adj. of or relating to the kitchen or cookery
7.ex_en: She was keen to acquire more advanced culinary skills.
7.ex_zh: 她热切渴望学到更高超的烹饪技巧。

7.def_en: (1)n. the condition of having a healthy mind (2)n. the condition of being based on reason or good judgment

7.ex_zh: 他行为怪异，我有点怀疑他是否神智正常。

7.def_en: adj. marked by flawless craftsmanship or by beautiful, ingenious, delicate, or elaborate execution

7.ex_zh: 印第安人带了精美的珠饰来卖。

7.def_en: adj. happening completely by chance without being planned

7.ex_zh: 如与真人、真实地点或真实事件有雷同之处，纯属巧合。

7.def_en: n. the act or process of becoming worse

7.ex_zh: 看似永无止境的经济衰退导致了最近的恶化。

7.def_en: adj. extremely costly, rich, luxurious, or magnificent

7.ex_zh: 我们在富丽堂皇的环境中用餐。

7.def_en: adj. having a shy or sweetly innocent quality

7.ex_zh: 他被这名年轻女子的娇羞笑容迷住了。

7.def_en: n. a group of illustrious or notable persons or things
7.ex_en: This book records the pantheon of the all-time greats.

7.def_en: v. to throw a strong light on

7.def_en: n. the establishment of boundaries or limits separating two areas, groups, or things

7.def_en: adj. very old or old- fashioned

7.ex_zh: 他的思想是纯粹的老古董。

7.def_en: (1)adj. not influenced by personal feelings, opinions, or concerns (2)adj. not interested

7.ex_zh: 这本书展现了维多利亚时代特质的精华。

7.def_en: adj. attractively suitable

7.def_en: n. rapidity of motion or action

7.ex_zh: 那家商店内部依然保持着；世纪的格调。

7.def_en: n. a mixture of different things

7.def_en: n. an outer margin of an object or structural part

7.def_zh: 治疗药物；改进措施；纠正，弥补
7.ex_en: There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
7.ex_zh: 失业问题没有简单的解决办法。

7.def_en: adj. useless, unprofitable

7.ex_en: The mountains straddle the French- Swiss border.

7.def_en: n. a person who supplies the directing or creative intelligence for a project

7.def_en: adj. delayed beyond an appointed time

7.def_en: v. to go or pass around or about

7.ex_zh: 还有一些传统的农场主仍旧在用老式的方法制作奶酪。

7.def_en: adj. being without exception or qualification

7.ex_zh: 我们不知道这是否是因为他不想冒这个险，还是因为他相信绝对的道德原则。

7.ex_zh: 他宣布在武器的持有方面将会有更严格的控制。

7.def_en: adj. offensive to the senses and especially to the sense of smell

7.ex_zh: 难闻的蒸汽由船坞中余留的泥浆散发出来。

7.ex_zh: ‘；’；人们创造了；一词，用来指居住在纸板棚屋里无家可归者的居住区。

8.def_en: v. to limit the size or amount of
8.ex_en: His activities have been severely circumscribed since his illness.
8.ex_zh: 自生病以来他的行动一直受到严格的限制。

8.def_en: adj. continuing to happen or develop in the same way
8.ex_en: To standardize the Front Office's ap proach to guest amenities service and workstations to ensure a consistent standard through the company.
8.ex_zh: 使前厅对客房服务和工作岗位标准化，确保始终如一的工作水平。

8.def_en: v. to deprive or dispossess especially of property, authority, or title
8.ex_en: The army divested the king of all his power.
8.ex_zh: 陆军剥夺了国王的全部权力。

8.def_en: n. a valuable person or thing
8.ex_en: From day one he's been a great asset to the company.
8.ex_zh: 从入职第一天开始，他就是公司难得的人才。

8.def_en: adj. bitterly scathing
8.ex_en: There was a vicious and vitriolic attack on him in one of the Sunday newspapers two weeks ago.
8.ex_zh: 两周前一份周日报纸刊登了一篇对他进行尖酸恶毒攻击的文章。

8.def_en: adj. requiring a lot of effort, energy, etc.
8.ex_en: This shouldn't be too taxing for you.
8.ex_zh: 这对你来说不至于太费劲。

8.def_en: (1)adj. not interested in or concerned about something (2)adj. marked by impartiality
8.ex_en: People have become indifferent to the suffering of others.
8.ex_zh: 人们对别人的痛苦已经变得无动于衷。

8.def_en: adj. deserved, appropriate
8.ex_en: The public approved the condign punishment.
8.ex_zh: 公众一致称赞这个罪判得很恰当。

8.def_en: n. mettle, pluck
8.ex_en: I admired her independence and spunk.
8.ex_zh: 我敬佩她的独立精神和她的勇气。

8.def_en: v. to eliminate the interrelationship of ...
8.ex_en: The issue threatened to decouple Eu rope from the United States.
8.ex_zh: 这一问题可能会割裂欧洲同美国的关系。

8.def_en: adj. flowing in abundance
8.ex_en: People's need for money has been increasing since they have been enjoying the many benefits brought by an affluent material life.
8.ex_zh: 人们享受在丰富的物质生活带来的好处中，从而对金钱的需求越来越大。

8.def_en: v. to disappear entirely without a clear explanation
8.ex_en: The magician vanished in a puff of smoke.
8.ex_zh: 魔术师在一股烟雾中突然不见了。

8.def_en: adj. liking to talk and talking smoothly and easily
8.ex_en: Would you guess women are more loquacious?
8.ex_zh: 你会认为女人更健谈吗？

8.def_en: v. to have and use (power, influence, etc.)
8.ex_en: They wield enormous political power.
8.ex_zh: 他们行使巨大的政治权力

8.def_en: adj. caused by or indicating acute discernment
8.ex_en: He is the most sagacious member of the committee.
8.ex_zh: 他是委员会里最睿智的成员。

8.def_en: adj. very appropriate
8.ex_en: She thought in both languages, and selected the most apposite phrase from either.
8.ex_zh: 她用两种语言思考，然后从中选择最贴切的一种表达。

8.def_en: adj. not feeling or showing any concern about the problems or suffering of other people
8.ex_en: The callous couple milked money from a hospital charity to fund a lavish lifestyle.
8.ex_zh: 为了过上奢靡的生活，这对冷漠无情的夫妇竟然贪污医院的慈善基金。

8.def_en: n. the state of being easily changed
8.ex_en: The flexibility of distance learning would be particularly suited to busy managers.
8.ex_zh: 远程学习的灵活性对于日理万机的经理人来说特别适合。

8.def_en: adj. old-fashioned and no longer suitable for modern conditions
8.ex_en: Many factories are so antiquated they are not worth saving.
8.ex_zh: 很多工厂过于陈旧落后，已不值得挽救。

8.def_en: adj. seeking to avenge
8.ex_en: He was stabbed to death by his vengeful wife.
8.ex_zh: 他被他的一心复仇的妻子用刀捅死了。

8.def_en: (1)v. to signal the approach of (2)v. to greet especially with enthusiasm
8.ex_en: These talks could herald a new era of peace.
8.ex_zh: 这些谈判可能预示着新的和平时代的来临。

8.def_en: v. to make beautiful with ornamentation
8.ex_en: The door of the old church was embellished with decorations.
8.ex_zh: 老教堂的门是用雕饰美化的。

8.def_en: v. to stop from doing or expressing something
8.ex_en: The government failed to stifle the unrest.
8.ex_zh: 政府没有制止住动乱。

8.def_en: n. a state of inaction or neutralization resulting from the opposition of equally powerful uncompromising persons or factions
8.ex_en: They called for a compromise on all sides to break the deadlock in the w orld trade talks.
8.ex_zh: 他们呼吁各方作出让步以打破世界贸易谈判中的僵局。

8.def_en: adj. imitative
8.ex_en: Both realism and naturalism are mimetic systems or practices of representation.
8.ex_zh: 现实主义和自然主义都是一种模仿体系或表现性的做法。

8.def_en: (1)n. an occurrence in which you fail to think or act in the usual or proper way for a brief time and make a mistake (2)n. an occurrence in which someone behaves badly or usually a short period of time (3)v. to stop for usually a brief time
8.ex_en: A momentary lapse in the final set cost her the match.
8.ex_zh: 她最后一盘稍有失误，输掉了整场比赛

8.def_en: adj. unambiguous
8.ex_en: The president declared that it was important to send a univocal message of support to the beleaguered country.
8.ex_zh: 总统宣称对处于困境中的国家，明确表示支持是很重要的。

8.def_en: v. to approve and sanction formally
8.ex_en: The treaty was ratified by all the member states.
8.ex_zh: 这个条约得到了所有成员国的批准。

8.def_en: v. to imitate or mimic in an inept way
8.ex_en: Modeling yourself on someone you admire is not the same as aping all they say or do.
8.ex_zh: 以偶像为榜样并不是说要模仿他们的一言一行。

8.def_en: adj. fully taking one s attention
8.ex_en: Children will find other exhibits equally absorbing.
8.ex_zh: 孩子们会对其他展品一样感兴趣。

8.def_en: n. a collection of selected literary pieces or passages or works of art or music
8.ex_en: Despite some artful editing, the anthology is a weak one.
8.ex_zh: 除了编辑上的一些巧妙之处，这本选集乏善可陈。

8.def_en: v. to declare assuredly
8.ex_en: The senator was forced to avow openly that he had received some money from that company.
8.ex_zh: 那个参议员被迫公开声明曾经收过那家公司的一些钱。

8.def_en: v. to make feel annoyed or angry
8.ex_en: It galls me to have to apologize to her.
8.ex_zh: 非得向她道歉，真让我恼火。

8.def_en: v. to lower the value or reputation of
8.ex_en: Politicians have debased the meaning of the word freedom.
8.ex_zh: 政客们贬低了“自由”一词的意义。

8.def_en: n. the money, skill, etc., that is needed to get or do something
8.ex_en: China has the wherewithal to make good on its promises of massive economic stimulus.
8.ex_zh: 中国有足够的资金实现其庞大的经济刺激计划。

8.def_en: v. to impair the strength of
8.ex_en: Prolonged strike action debilitated the industry.
8.ex_zh: 长时间的罢工削弱了这个行业的活力。

8.def_en: adj. characterized by procrastination
8.ex_en: The boss sacked a dilatory worker y esterday.
8.ex_zh: 昨天老板开除了一个凡事都爱拖延的人。

8.def_en: v. to criticize very harshly
8.ex_en: Susan was excoriated for her mistakes.
8.ex_zh: 苏珊因犯了错误而被指责。

8.def_en: adj. having or showing good judgment
8.ex_en: At a key moment in his life, he made a judicious investment that was the foundation of his wealth. , ,
8.ex_zh: 在他一生的关键时刻；他做出了明智的投资；这便成了他以后富裕的基础。

8.def_en: adj. having a wide range or effect
8.ex_en: The economy is in danger of collapse unless far-reaching reforms are implemented.
8.ex_zh: 如果不实施影响深远的改革，经济就面临崩溃的危险。

8.def_en: n. the curved path of something
8.ex_en: It is not difficult to sketch the subsequent trajectory.
8.ex_zh: 很容易描绘出它们最终的轨迹。

8.def_en: v. to be unwilling to give or admit
8.ex_en: I grudge paying so much for such inferior goods.
8.ex_zh: 我不愿花这么多钱买次品。

8.def_en: v. to establish or order by appointment, decree, or law
8.ex_en: Equal punishment was ordained for the two crimes.
8.ex_zh: 规定对这两种罪行量刑相同。

8.def_en: adj. weakly and effusively sentimental
8.ex_en: Jimmy turned maudlin after three drinks.
8.ex_zh: 三杯酒下肚后，吉米伤感起来。

8.def_en: v. to stop developing, progressing, moving, etc.
8.ex_en: Taiwan's economy is likely to stagnate for a long time to come.
8.ex_zh: 台湾经济很可能会停滞很长一段时间。

8.def_en: adj. very careful about doing something in a extremely accurate and exact way
8.ex_en: The painting had been executed with meticulous attention to detail.
8.ex_zh: 画这幅画的时候，画家对细节真是一丝不苟。

8.def_en: n. evil reputation brought about by something grossly criminal, shocking, or brutal
8.ex_en: He enjoyed exaggerating his infamy.
8.ex_zh: 他喜欢夸大他的恶行。

8.def_en: adj. fatigued by overwork
8.ex_en: I felt terribly jaded after working all weekend.
8.ex_zh: 整个周末工作之后我感到疲惫不堪。

8.def_en: adj. unable to be changed
8.ex_en: Our nature is not considered immutable, either socially or biologically. , .
8.ex_zh: 无论是从社会学还是从生物学的角度来看；我们的本性都不是永远不变的

8.def_en: v. adorn, embellish
8.ex_en: He tried to varnish over the facts, but it was useless.
8.ex_zh: 他想粉饰事实，但那是徒劳的。

8.def_en: v. to secure firmly
8.ex_en: The roots anchor the plant in the earth.
8.ex_zh: 根部使植物固定在土壤中。

8.def_en: v. to enjoy or take pleasure in
8.ex_en: He ate quietly, relishing his meal.
8.ex_zh: 他安静地吃着，细细品味着食物。

8.def_en: adj. having or expressing doubt about something
8.ex_en: They are skeptical about how much will be accomplished by legislation.
8.ex_zh: 他们对于立法成效心存疑虑。

8.def_en: adj. capable of being easily changed or influenced
8.ex_en: Silver is the most malleable of all metals.
8.ex_zh: 银是所有金属中延展性最好的。

8.def_en: v. to rate too low
8.ex_en: He underrated the seriousness of William's head injury.
8.ex_zh: 他低估了威廉头部伤势的严重性。

8.def_en: (1)adj. fully revealed or expressed without vagueness, implication, or ambiguity (2)adj. fully developed or formulated
8.ex_en: He was explicit about his intention to overhaul the party's internal voting s ystem.
8.ex_zh: 他直言自己的目的是改革党内的投票制度。

8.def_en: adj. equal to something in value, meaning, or effect
8.ex_en: If he resigned it would be tantamount to admitting that he was guilty.
8.ex_zh: 他若辞职就等于承认自己有错。

8.def_en: n. harsh or biting sharpness especially of words, manner, or feelings
8.ex_en: This book review was written with acrimony.
8.ex_zh: 这篇书评语调刻薄。

8.def_en: adj. of or relating to idealists or idealism
8.ex_en: This idealistic concept is at variance with reality.
8.ex_zh: 这种空想主义的观念和现实相矛盾。

8.def_en: n. extreme dislike or disgust
8.ex_en: There was fear and hatred in his voice.
8.ex_zh: 他的声音里透露着恐惧和仇恨。

8.def_en: adj. stubbornly adhering to an opinion, purpose, or course in spite of reason, arguments, or persuasion
8.ex_en: The trader was obstinate in the negotiation.
8.ex_zh: 这个商人在谈判中强拗固执。

8.def_en: adj. making usually unjustified or excessive claims
8.ex_en: He is a talented but pretentious writer.
8.ex_zh: 他是一个有才华但自以为是的作家。

8.def_en: adj. penetrating only the easily or quickly perceived
8.ex_en: The evening news is often criticized for being shallow.
8.ex_zh: 晚间新闻常因其内容肤浅而受到批评。

8.def_en: v. to cause to be loved or admired
8.ex_en: He became enamored of Jenny.
8.ex_zh: 他爱上珍妮了。

8.def_en: n. the quality or state of being very determined to do something
8.ex_en: The athletes displayed great tenacity throughout the contest.
8.ex_zh: 运动员在比赛中表现出顽强的意志。

8.def_en: adj. relating to the collection and study of valuable old things
8.ex_en: The library is rich in historical books and antiquarian.
8.ex_zh: 家图书馆拥有大量历史和古籍。

8.def_en: v. to give (control, responsibility, authority, etc.) to someone
8.ex_en: Officials have now been delegated t o start work on a draft settlement.
8.ex_zh: 现在已经委派官员着手起草解决方案。

8.def_en: n. a member of the laity
8.ex_en: How would you explain to the layperson how gene therapy works?
8.ex_zh: 你会如何向外行人解释基因治疗法的工作原理呢？

8.def_en: adj. having many parts
8.ex_en: The plot of the novel is intricate and fascinating.
8.ex_zh: 这部小说的情节错综复杂，引人入胜。

8.def_en: (1)v. to experience failure (2)n. one founds or establishes
8.ex_en: He was one of the founders of the university's medical faculty.
8.ex_zh: 他是该大学医学院的创建人之一。

8.def_en: n. an unfortunate, difficult, or precarious situation
8.ex_en: He just wants to draw attention to the plight of the unemployed.
8.ex_zh: 他仅仅是想引起人们对失业者困境的关注。

8.def_en: n. something made up or contrived
8.ex_en: The attack wasn't just a figment of m y imagination.
8.ex_zh: 袭击可不是我凭空想象出来的。

8.def_en: n. a concluding section that rounds out the design of a literary work
8.ex_en: Fortinbras speaks the epilogue in Shakespeare's Hamlet .
8.ex_zh: 在莎士比亚的《哈姆雷特》中，由福丁布拉斯念收场白。

8.def_en: adj. friendly, sociable, and congenial
8.ex_en: He is an educated, amiable and decent man.
8.ex_zh: 他是个有教养、和蔼可亲的正人君子。

8.def_en: adj. tremendous in size, volume, or degree
8.ex_en: That is a gargantuan challenge.
8.ex_zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。

8.def_en: n. a feeling of unity between people who have the same interests, goals, etc.
8.ex_en: The great friendship and militant solidarity between the peoples of our two countries are unbreakable.
8.ex_zh: 我们两国人民的伟大友谊与战斗团结是坚不可摧的。

8.def_en: adj. sincerely and honestly felt or experienced
8.ex_en: Fake designer watches are sold at a fraction of the price of the genuine article .
8.ex_zh: 伪造的设计师名牌手表以真品若干分之一的价格出售。

8.def_en: adj. having only one side
8.ex_en: Unpopular policies such as unilateral disarmament were ditched.
8.ex_zh: 诸如单边裁军之类不得人心的政策已被废除了。

8.def_en: adj. not exciting or interesting
8.ex_en: I found the characters very two- dimensional, not to say dull.
8.ex_zh: 我觉得那些人物形象即使不说是乏味无聊，至少也是毫无深度。

8.def_en: adj. of the best and most characteristic
8.ex_en: If you can buy only one case at auction, it should be vintage port.
8.ex_zh: 如果你在拍卖会上只能买一箱酒，那就应该是优质的波尔图葡萄酒。

8.def_en: adj. having or occurring in great variety
8.ex_en: Spain is a composite of multifarious traditions and people.
8.ex_zh: 西班牙是多种传统和多个民族的合成体。

8.def_en: v. to give pain or trouble to
8.ex_en: She was aggrieved at the insult.
8.ex_zh: 她因被侮辱而觉得感情上受到伤害。

8.def_en: n. friendly joking about or with somebody
8.ex_en: Prince Charles does not escape raillery from others.
8.ex_zh: 查尔斯王子也难逃人们善意的玩笑。

8.def_en: adj. unable to understand or think clearly
8.ex_en: People are confused about all the different labels on food these days.
8.ex_zh: 人们如今被那些五花八门的食物标签搞得稀里糊涂。

8.def_en: n. the quality or state of something that is not easily changed or likely to change
8.ex_en: NATO had charted a new course for stability and cooperation in Europe.
8.ex_zh: 北约制订了保持欧洲稳定与合作的新计划。

8.def_en: v. to cause to come
8.ex_en: Her screams drew passers-by to the scene.
8.ex_zh: 她的惊叫声把过路人吸引到了现场。

8.def_en: n. the doctrine that pleasure or happiness is the sole or chief good in life
8.ex_en: The age of hedonism is being ushered out by a new era of temperance.
8.ex_zh: 享乐主义时代正让位于一个注重节制的时代。

8.def_en: v. to slow the movement, progress, or action of
8.ex_en: The bad weather hampered rescue operations.
8.ex_zh: 恶劣的天气阻碍了救援工作的进行。

8.def_en: v. to become worse as time passes
8.ex_en: The chops will fester and go to wast e.
8.ex_zh: 猪排会腐烂，给糟蹋掉。

8.def_en: n. a sickness or illness
8.ex_en: The pharmacist can assist you with the treatment of common ailments.
8.ex_zh: 药剂师能帮你治疗一般的小病。

8.def_en: n. the state of having identical cumulative distribution function or values
8.ex_en: The government panicked into imposing a kind of cultural homogeneity.
8.ex_zh: 政府在恐慌下开始强制实施某种文化统一政策。

8.def_en: v. to demand an express term in an agreement
8.ex_en: That is why the vehicle manufacturers stipulate regular engine oil changes.
8.ex_zh: 这就是为什么汽车制造商规定定期发动机换油。

8.def_en: v. to shine with or as if with subdued steady light or moderate brightness
8.ex_en: Her black hair gleamed in the sun.
8.ex_zh: 她的黑发在阳光下闪着光泽。

8.def_en: adj. narrowly, stodgily, and often ostentatiously learned
8.ex_en: his is often cited as an example of the useless and pedantic degeneracy of medieval Catholic theology.
8.ex_zh: 这经常被作为一个对中世纪神学无用和迂腐的例子。

8.def_en: n. a feeling of not worrying about anything
8.ex_en: She hid her worries behind an air of insouciance.
8.ex_zh: 她掩饰着自己的烦恼，表现得无忧无虑。

8.def_en: adj. intricately involved
8.ex_en: The procedures surrounding legal redress are byzantine.
8.ex_zh: 修改法律的程序是错综复杂的。

8.def_en: n. a distinguishing quality
8.ex_en: Creativity is a human trait.
8.ex_zh: 创造力是人类的一种特性。

8.def_en: adj. very noticeable
8.ex_en: Her novels have just been reissued with eye-catching new covers.
8.ex_zh: 她的小说刚进行了重印，新封面非常抢眼。

8.def_en: v. to fill up the number of with new members
8.ex_en: The police are trying to recruit more black and Asian officers.
8.ex_zh: 警方正在试图招聘更多黑人和亚裔警官。

8.def_en: v. entrance or enthrall
8.ex_en: Like all great books, it has an enduring power to surprise and mesmerize.
8.ex_zh: 像所有伟大的著作，它有一个持久的力量感到惊讶和催眠。

8.def_en: (1)v. to show to be false or wrong ... (2)v. disguise (3)v. to present an appearance not in agreement with ...
8.def_zh: 证明；是错误的；掩饰；与；不符
8.ex_en: Her energy and youthful good looks belie her 65 years. 65
8.ex_zh: 她的活力与年轻美貌使人看不出她有；岁了。

8.def_en: adj. promoting health or well-being of mind or spirit
8.ex_en: Water is a wholesome drink.
8.ex_zh: 水是有益健康的饮料。

8.def_en: n. a person who attempts to stir up or spread something that is usually petty or discreditable
8.ex_en: Of course, once you've spotted the gossip-monger it might help to be very careful about the information you share with this employee.
8.ex_zh: 当然，一旦你知道了谁是喜欢传闲话的人，那么跟这个员工分享信息的时候就要特别小心谨慎。

9.def_en: adj. too ready to believe things
9.ex_en: Mary is so credulous that she may r eadily accept any excuse you make.
9.ex_zh: 玛丽很轻信，你随便找个借口她都可以相信。

9.def_en: n. one who attends or assists a leader
9.ex_en: Others say of course that he is an acolyte of the old regime, he's the one who has brought problem to Egypt.
9.ex_zh: 当然也有人说，他是旧政权的支持者，埃及的问题就出在他身上。

9.def_en: v. to help someone or something pay for the costs of
9.ex_en: Many universities subsidize research and publications.
9.ex_zh: 许多大学资助研究和出版。

9.def_en: adj. not easily understood or explained
9.ex_en: His equivocal response has done no thing to dampen the speculation.
9.ex_zh: 模棱两可的回应丝毫没有消除人们的猜疑。

9.def_en: v. to agree precisely
9.ex_en: His practice does not square with his principles.
9.ex_zh: 他的行为与主张不符。

9.def_en: v. to represent as less than is the case
9.ex_en: The government chooses deliberately to understate the increase in prices.
9.ex_zh: 政府有意选择对价格的上涨轻描淡写。

9.def_en: v. to manage prudently and economically
9.ex_en: Husbanding precious resources was part of rural life.
9.ex_zh: 节约地使用宝贵的资源是乡村生活的一部分。

9.def_en: v. to ruin or spoil
9.ex_en: His spirit was vitiated by pleasure seeking.
9.ex_zh: 他的志气因追求吃喝玩乐而消磨殆尽。

9.def_en: adj. experiencing or tending to bring about renewal or revival
9.ex_en: That could harm exports and growth in the resurgent eurozone.
9.ex_zh: 对于正在复苏的欧元区，这可能会危害到它的出口和增长。

9.def_en: adj. providing something additional to a main part of function
9.ex_en: The transport corps is ancillary to the infantry.
9.ex_zh: 运输队是步兵的辅助部队。

9.def_en: adj. changing often
9.ex_en: Online players are a fickle bunch wh o move to new games quickly.
9.ex_zh: 在线玩家是一群易变的人，他们很快就会转移到新游戏中。

9.def_en: adj. organized to do good things for other people
9.ex_en: The rich are not benevolent; the benevolent are not rich.
9.ex_zh: 为富不仁，为仁不富。

9.def_en: (1)adj. of or relating to the brain (2)adj. intellectual and not emotional
9.ex_en: His poetry is very cerebral.
9.ex_zh: 他的诗富涵理性。

9.def_en: adj. strongly desirous of acquiring and possessing
9.ex_en: The most acquisitive firms tend to be engineering groups.
9.ex_zh: 最贪得无厌的公司往往是工程队。

9.def_en: n. product of the imagination
9.ex_en: The story was certainly a favorite one, but it was undoubtedly pure invention.
9.ex_zh: 这个故事的确是人们最喜欢的一个，但毫无疑问它纯粹是虚构的。

9.def_en: adj. agreeing with a set of rules, standards, or requirements
9.ex_en: She was much naughtier than her co mpliant brother.
9.ex_zh: 她哥哥很听话，她却调皮得多。

9.def_en: v. to take arbitrary or forcible possession of
9.ex_en: All automobiles in the town were commandeered by the army.
9.ex_zh: 城中所有的汽车均被部队征用了。

9.def_en: (1)n. a person who argues for or supports a cause or policy (2)v. to support or argue for
9.ex_en: Mr Williams is a strong advocate of free market policies and a multi- party system.
9.ex_zh: 威廉斯先生是自由市场政策和多党派制度的坚决拥护者。

9.def_en: v. to confuse very much
9.ex_en: Don't perplex her with the question.
9.ex_zh: 你不要以这个问题困惑她。

9.def_en: adj. of outstanding spiritual, intellectual, or moral worth
9.ex_en: She elevated every rare small success to the sublime.
9.ex_zh: 她把每一次少有的微小成功都提升成了非凡的成就。

9.def_en: n. a person who has just started learning or doing something
9.ex_en: In fact, in the world of complex software, everyone is effectively a novice.
9.ex_zh: 事实上，在复杂的软件世界里，每个人实际上都是新手。

9.def_en: adj. exhibiting or given to extreme fierceness and unrestrained violence and brutality
9.ex_en: The ferocious panther is chasing a rabbit.
9.ex_zh: 那只凶猛的豹子正追赶一只兔子。

9.def_en: n. a natural liking for something
9.ex_en: Charles has always had a predilection for red-haired women.
9.ex_zh: 查尔斯对红头发女人一直有偏爱。

9.def_en: adj. very careful about doing what you are supposed to do
9.ex_en: She is very conscientious and never skimps her work.
9.ex_zh: 她办事认真，从不敷衍了事。

9.def_en: n. wrongdoing or misconduct especially by a public official
9.ex_en: The mayor is condemned for the monstrous malfeasance of his administration.
9.ex_zh: 市长被宣告有罪，由于其领导的政府渎职。

9.def_en: v. to become liable or subject to: bring down upon oneself
9.ex_en: She falls in love and incurs the wrath of her father.
9.ex_zh: 她恋爱了，这引起了父亲的愤怒。

9.def_en: adj. shocked and upset
9.ex_en: Tania stared at him aghast, unable to speak.
9.ex_zh: 塔妮娅吃惊地看着他，说不出话来。

9.def_en: n. a place or locality especially when viewed in relation to a particular event or characteristic
9.ex_en: An amusement park is the perfect locale for a bunch of irrepressible youngsters to have all sorts of adventures.
9.ex_zh: 游乐场是一帮精力过剩的年轻人寻求各种惊险刺激的绝佳场所。

9.def_en: adj. favoring, conducive to, or operating toward peace, moderation, or conciliation
9.ex_en: Great players can hold an irenic attitude toward former antagonists.
9.ex_zh: 伟大的运动员能够秉持对前对手的和平态度。

9.def_en: n. a lack of belief or a strong disbelief in the existence of a god or any gods
9.ex_en: David believes in atheism as though it were a new religion.
9.ex_zh: 大卫信奉无神论就像信仰一种新的宗教。

9.def_en: n. the act of causing two people or groups to become friendly again after an argument or disagreement
9.ex_en: Their handshake appeared to be a gesture of reconciliation.
9.ex_zh: 他们的握手似乎是和解的表示。

9.def_en: adj. used, needed, or enjoyed constantly usually by many individuals
9.ex_en: Rice is the staple food of more than half the world's population.
9.ex_zh: 稻米是全世界一半以上人口的主食。

9.def_en: v. to attract artfully or adroitly or by arousing hope or desire
9.ex_en: The promise of higher pay enticed me into the new job.
9.ex_zh: 高薪诱使我从事了这个新工作。

9.def_en: n. preservation from destruction or failure
9.ex_en: The church's message of salvation has changed the lives of many.
9.ex_zh: 基督教中耶稣拯救灵魂的教义改变了很多人的生活。

9.def_en: adj. very obvious and offensive
9.ex_en: The delegation submitted a memorandum to the Commons on the blatant violations of basic human rights.
9.ex_zh: 代表团向下院呈交了有关公然侵犯基本人权的备忘录。

9.def_en: adj. very poor
9.ex_en: The town government is responsible for assistance to indigent people.
9.ex_zh: 镇政府负责给穷人提供帮助。

9.def_en: adj. unshakable or insistent especially in maintaining a position or opinion
9.ex_en: American negotiators are adamant that they will not budge on this point.
9.ex_zh: 美国谈判者非常强硬，他们在这一点上是不会妥协的。

9.def_en: n. the last small part that remains of something that existed before
9.ex_en: These upright stones are the vestiges of some ancient religion.
9.ex_zh: 这些竖立的石头是某种古代宗教的遗迹。

9.def_en: n. a commonplace or hackneyed statement or notion
9.ex_en: The meeting produced the usual bromides about macroeconomic policy, third-world debt and the environment.
9.ex_zh: 会议上提出的还是那些惯常讨论的老套话题——宏观经济政策、第三世界债务和环境问题。

9.def_en: adj. being in an early stage of development
9.ex_en: It is still in an embryonic stage.
9.ex_zh: 它还处于萌芽阶段。

9.def_en: adj. easily duped or cheated
9.ex_en: The swindlers had roped into a number of gullible persons.
9.ex_zh: 骗子们已使一些轻信的人上了当。

9.def_en: v. to reduce the speed of
9.ex_en: But most analysts already expect Ch inese growth to decelerate.
9.ex_zh: 但大多数分析师已经预料到中国的增长会减速。

9.def_en: adj. not energetic or excited
9.ex_en: The critics's reaction to the film was rather tepid.
9.ex_zh: 评论家对那部影片的反映不太热烈。

9.def_en: n. a noisy disturbance or quarrel
9.ex_en: After the row in a pub he drove off in a huff.
9.ex_zh: 在酒吧里吵了一架后，他气鼓鼓地开车走了。

9.def_en: (1)v. to take or use especially in a way that is illegal, unfair, etc. (2)adj. right or suited for some purpose or situation
9.ex_en: So if you want people to get an education, maybe some sort of subsidy is appropriate.
9.ex_zh: 所以如果你想要人们受教育，也许一定形式的补助是合适的。

9.def_en: n. a terse formulation of a truth or sentiment
9.ex_en: It is the aphorism of the Asian Games.
9.ex_zh: 这是亚运会的格言。

9.def_en: n. a strong inclination or interest
9.ex_en: Mr Putin seems bent on proving only that Russia is again able to say no.
9.ex_zh: 普京似乎更倾向于试图证明俄罗斯再次可以说“不”。

9.def_en: v. to be in inward turmoil
9.ex_en: The gardener exploded with the rage that had simmered all morning.
9.ex_zh: 那名花匠憋了一个早上的愤怒终于爆发了。

9.def_en: v. analyze critically
9.ex_en: Then you could have your test automation read, parse, and use the data in this file.
9.ex_zh: 然后您可以让您的测试自动化读取、解析和使用该文件中的数据。

9.def_en: adj. currently or actually existing
9.ex_en: Two fourteenth-century manuscripts of this text are still extant. 14
9.ex_zh: 这个文本仍有两份；世纪手抄本存世。

9.def_en: v. to throw away because it is useless or unwanted
9.ex_en: On no account should we discard ou r fine traditions and styles of work.
9.ex_zh: 好传统、好作风绝不能扔掉。

9.def_en: adj. of, relating to, befitting, or suggestive of an empire or an emperor
9.ex_en: They executed Russia's imperial family in 1918. 1918
9.ex_zh: 他们；年处死了俄国沙皇皇族。

9.def_en: n. a great disaster or complete failure
9.ex_en: After the debacle of the war the world was never the same again.
9.ex_zh: 经历了这场战争的惨败之后，世界再也不是原来的那个样子了。

9.def_en: (1)v. to become worse in condition or quality (2)v. to say that you will not or cannot do something
9.ex_en: The electoral fortunes of the Liberal Democratic party may decline.
9.ex_zh: 自由民主党的选举运势可能会衰减。

9.def_en: (1)adj. unqualified, utter (2)adj. marked by great and continuous steepness (3)v. to deviate from a course
9.def_zh: 完全的，绝对的；陡峭的；偏航
9.ex_en: His music is sheer delight
9.ex_zh: 听他的音乐完全是一种享受。

9.def_en: n. a feeble or ridiculous imitation
9.ex_en: The parody was just a form of teasing.
9.ex_zh: 这拙劣的模仿仅仅是戏弄的一个形式。

9.def_en: adj. existing or continuing in the same way for a long time
9.ex_en: It reflects a perennial worry in the Arab world about the state of the language.
9.ex_zh: 它反映了长久以来对阿拉伯语世界内关于该语言现状的担忧。

9.def_en: n. ancestor, forefather
9.ex_en: I'll come back to the land of my forebears.
9.ex_zh: 我将回到祖先的土地上。

9.def_en: adj. having a pleasant or agreeable taste
9.ex_en: This dish is quite palatable.
9.ex_zh: 这个菜非常鲜美可口。

9.def_en: v. to think of or describe something as larger or greater than it really is
9.ex_en: Sheila admitted that she did someti mes exaggerate the demands of her job.
9.ex_zh: 希拉承认自己有时候确实夸大了工作的难度。

9.def_en: n. a situation in which you have to make a difficult choice
9.ex_en: The issue raises a moral dilemma.
9.ex_zh: 这个问题引发了一个道德上的两难抉择。

9.def_en: n. a mixture of different elements
9.ex_en: The film script is an amalgam of all three books.
9.ex_zh: 这个电影脚本由三本书合成。

9.def_en: adj. vast or ample in extent
9.ex_en: The house has a spacious kitchen and dining area.
9.ex_zh: 这座房子有一个宽敞的厨房和用餐区。

9.def_en: v. to hide your true feelings, opinions, etc.
9.ex_en: Henry was not slow to dissemble wh en it served his purposes.
9.ex_zh: 在需要时，亨利会毫不迟疑地伪装自己。

9.def_en: v. to stimulate or excite as if by an electric shock
9.ex_en: The aid appeal has galvanized the German business community.
9.ex_zh: 这份救助呼吁已经促使德国的工商业界行动了起来。

9.def_en: adj. depending on each other
9.ex_en: We live in an increasingly interdependent world.
9.ex_zh: 我们生活在一个日益相互依赖的世界。

9.def_en: v. to establish or bring about as if by force
9.ex_en: Parents of either sex should beware of imposing their own tastes on their children.
9.ex_zh: 父母双方都应切记不要把自己的喜好强加给孩子。

9.def_en: n. truth or accuracy
9.ex_en: They questioned the veracity of her story.
9.ex_zh: 他们质疑她所述事情的真实性。

9.def_en: adj. powerfully pleasing, appealing, or delightful
9.ex_en: She has the most enchanting smile.
9.ex_zh: 她有着最迷人的微笑。

9.def_en: adj. not easily or naturally deduced or introduced
9.ex_en: The storyline was too far-fetched and none of the actors was particularly good.
9.ex_zh: 故事情节太离谱，演员表演也没有出彩的。

9.def_en: adj. causing feelings of sadness and sympathy
9.ex_en: The animal gave a pathetic little whimper.
9.ex_zh: 这只动物低声哀叫，令人怜悯。

9.def_en: adj. strikingly out of the ordinary
9.ex_en: Grass's novels are peopled with outlandish characters.
9.ex_zh: 格拉斯的小说里都是些稀奇古怪的人物。

9.def_en: n. incapable of error
9.ex_en: No country should claim infallibility and each country should be prepared to re-examine its own attitudes for the common good.
9.ex_zh: 任何国家都不应自称一贯正确，各国都要准备为了共同的利益重新检查自己的态度。

9.def_en: adj. standoffish
9.ex_en: he was being offish with her.
9.ex_zh: 他故意对她表现出冷漠。

9.def_en: v. to let fall, exude, or precipitate in drops or in a wet mist
9.ex_en: We were asked to distill the crucial points of the book.
9.ex_zh: 我们被要求从这本书中提炼出关键点。

9.def_en: (1)n. an official document conferring a right or privilege (2)adj. obvious or clear
9.ex_en: P&G applied for a patent on its cookies.
9.ex_zh: 宝洁公司为它的饼干申请专利权。

9.def_en: v. to gather into a ball, mass, or cluster
9.ex_en: Similarly charged colloidal particles cannot agglomerate into larger particles.
9.ex_zh: 带相同电荷的胶粒不能聚集成较大的颗粒。

9.def_en: adj. a competition, dispute, or fight open to all comers and usually with no rules
9.ex_en: The lowering of trade barriers has led to a free-for-all among exporters.
9.ex_zh: 降低贸易壁垒导致出口商各自为政。

9.def_en: adj. not giving you enough useful information
9.ex_en: The reports of the explosion were brief and uninformative.
9.ex_zh: 有关爆炸事件的报道很简略，未及详情。

9.def_en: n. the state of being old and in bad condition or poor health
9.ex_en: The building had a general air of dec repitude and neglect.
9.ex_zh: 这座建筑看上去破旧失修，无人照管。

9.def_en: v. inflame, excite
9.ex_en: Lady Lysa's face was flushed with fury.
9.ex_zh: 莱莎夫人气得满脸通红。

9.def_en: adj. performed or existing on a large scale especially without discrimination
9.ex_en: Once wholesale prices are deregulated, consumer prices will also rise.
9.ex_zh: 一旦批发价格放开，零售价格也会随之上涨。

9.def_en: v. to treat as a very important and famous person ...
9.ex_en: The press began to lionize him enthusiastically.
9.ex_zh: 媒体开始狂热地吹捧他。

9.def_en: (1)v. to say that you accept or do not deny the truth or existence of (2)v. to regard or describe (someone or something as having or deserving a particular status
9.ex_en: Naylor acknowledged, in a letter to the judge, that he was a drug addict.
9.ex_zh: 内勒在给法官的信中承认自己吸毒。

9.def_en: (1)v. to pretend to have (2)v. to take as granted or true (3)v. to take to or upon oneself
9.ex_en: He contented himself by assuming an air of superiority.
9.ex_zh: 他表现出一副高高在上的样子以获得自我满足。

9.def_en: v. to act as intermediary
9.ex_en: The Vatican successfully mediated in a territorial dispute between Argentina and Chile in 1984. 1984
9.ex_zh: 梵蒂冈成功地调解了；年阿根廷与智利之间的领土争端。

9.def_en: adj. exciting distaste or aversion
9.def_zh: 令人厌恶的，使人反感的
9.ex_en: All food was repugnant to me during my illness. .
9.ex_zh: 生病时所有的食物都使我感到厌恶

9.def_en: adj. eerie, mysterious
9.ex_en: Tony was unnerved by the uncanny familiarity of her face.
9.ex_zh: 怪异的是，她看起来竟有些面熟，这让托尼心慌意乱。

9.def_en: v. to make more prominent or noticeable
9.ex_en: Americans always look at the bright side, whether or not there is one, and if possible accentuate the positive of every disaster.
9.ex_zh: 美国人总看事情光明的一面，不论是否有光明的一面，而且如有可能，就强调每场灾难的积极意义。

9.def_en: v. to persuade with flattery or gentle urging especially in the face of reluctance
9.ex_en: He cajoled me into agreeing to do the work.
9.ex_zh: 他诱骗我同意接下那份工作。

9.def_en: adj. not showing emotion
9.ex_en: He was content to stand by as an impassive spectator.
9.ex_zh: 他满足于站在旁边做一个冷漠的旁观者。

9.def_en: adj. poorly done or made
9.ex_en: We're not paying good money for shoddy goods.
9.ex_zh: 我们不会花高价买劣质商品。

9.def_en: adj. marked by arrogant assurance
9.ex_en: From across the desk she gave him a witheringly imperious look.
9.ex_zh: 她从桌子对面扫了他一眼，目光咄咄逼人，凌利而专横。

9.def_en: v. to make agitated and angry
9.ex_en: Cancellations and late departures rarely rile him.
9.ex_zh: 他很少因为约定取消或出发太晚而恼火。

9.def_en: adj. to be about to occur
9.ex_en: On the morning of the expedition I awoke with a feeling of impending disaster.
9.ex_zh: 出发远征的那个早上，我醒来就有一种灾难即将来临的感觉。

9.def_en: n. the period of one's greatest popularity, vigor, or prosperity
9.ex_en: In its heyday, the studio's boast was that it had more stars than there are in heaven.
9.ex_zh: 在其全盛时期，该制片公司夸口说，他们旗下的明星比天上的星星还要多。

9.def_en: v. to be present in large quantity
9.ex_en: The advertisements teem with our life everywhere.
9.ex_zh: 在我们的生活中到处充满了广告。

9.def_en: n. high spirits: merriment
9.ex_en: The colorful flags added to the gaiety of the occasion.
9.ex_zh: 彩旗增添了盛会的欢乐气氛。

9.def_en: v. to remove from power especially by force
9.ex_en: That government was overthrown in a military coup three years ago. 3
9.ex_zh: 那个政府在；年前的军事政变中被推翻。

9.def_en: adj. difficult or complicated
9.ex_en: The new management faces some knotty problems.
9.ex_zh: 新的管理层面临着一些棘手的问题。

9.def_en: v. to shrink away or crouch especially for shelter from something that menaces, domineers, or dismays
9.ex_en: A gun went off and people cowered behind walls and under tables.
9.ex_zh: 一声枪响，人们缩到墙后或桌子底下躲起来。

9.def_en: adj. impossible to resist especially because of strength or attractiveness
9.ex_en: The raging trend of reforms is irresistible.
9.ex_zh: 改革浪潮是不可抗拒的。

9.def_en: n. a mark of shame or discredit
9.ex_en: There is no longer any stigma attached to being divorced.
9.ex_zh: 离婚不再是什么羞耻的事。

9.def_en: v. to revive from apparent death or from unconsciousness
9.ex_en: He has submitted a bid to resuscitate the struggling magazine.
9.ex_zh: 他已经投标来拯救这个岌岌可危的周刊。

9.def_en: adj. very small in size or amount
9.ex_en: There is scant evidence of strong economic growth to come.
9.ex_zh: 没有足够的证据表明经济将会突飞猛进。

10.def_en: v. to give support to
10.ex_en: Prime minister unveiled new economic aid packages to bolster political and economic transitions in the region.
10.ex_zh: 总理公布新的经济援助措施来支持该地区的政治和经济转变。

10.def_en: adj. highly injurious or destructive
10.ex_en: They don't really, in their ivory towers, understand how pernicious drug crime is.
10.ex_zh: 他们身处象牙塔中，并不真正了解毒品犯罪的危害有多大。

10.def_en: (1)v. to measure exactly (2)n. an instrument that is used for measuring something
10.ex_en: Geologists gauged the wind at over thirty knots. 30
10.ex_zh: 地质学家们测出风速在；节以上。

10.def_en: v. to restrain, check, or control with or as if with a bridle
10.ex_en: She tried with all her might to bridle her resentment.
10.ex_zh: 她努力抑制住自己的怨恨。

10.def_en: n. the state of being first
10.ex_en: In this model, no one state is allowed primacy over the union's other members.
10.ex_zh: 根据这一模式，没有哪个州可以超过联盟中的其他成员成为第一。

10.def_en: (1)v. to entice by charm or attraction (2)n. power to attract
10.ex_en: The window displays allure customers to buy goods.
10.ex_zh: 橱窗陈列品引诱顾客购买商品。

10.def_en: n. pleasing or sweet sound
10.ex_en: Even the too-near table of boisterous boys contributes to its euphony.
10.ex_zh: 连近旁谈笑的年轻人也贡献出了悦耳之声。

10.def_en: v. to be or become inactive or dormant
10.ex_en: Bears often hibernate in caves.
10.ex_zh: 熊常在山洞里冬眠。

10.def_en: v. to quickly move away from something that is shocking, frightening, or disgusting
10.ex_en: He recoiled in horror at the sight of the corpse.
