11.ex_en: The same alarm is manifest everywhere.
11.ex_zh: 同样的恐慌在各地都已出现。

11.def_en: (1)v. to be usual, common, or popular (2)v. to defeat an opponent especially in a long or difficult contest
11.ex_en: Those beliefs still prevail among certain social groups.
11.ex_zh: 这些信念在某些社会群体中仍很盛行。

11.def_en: n. a selfish and excessive desire for more of something (such as money) than is needed
11.ex_en: Greed was written on his face.
11.ex_zh: 他脸上明显露出贪婪的表情。

11.def_en: v. to deprive of courage, strength, or steadiness
11.ex_en: The experience completely unnerved me.
11.ex_zh: 那段经历使我彻底丧失了信心。

11.def_en: adj. making good health possible or likely
11.ex_en: With its graceful movements and salubrious effects on health, it has a strong appeal to a vast multitude of people.
11.ex_zh: 因其优美的运动姿态和对健康的有益影响，武术在广大群众中有很强的吸引力。

11.def_en: v. to do something that is not allowed
11.ex_en: No one is permitted to have privileges to transgress the law.
11.ex_zh: 不允许任何人有超越法律的特权。

11.def_en: adj. superior to all others
11.ex_en: Nitrogen is of paramount importance to life on earth.
11.ex_zh: 氮对地球上的生命至关重要。

11.def_en: v. to release from something that engages or involves
11.ex_en: He managed to disengage himself from the contract.
11.ex_zh: 他成功地为自己解除了契约义务。

11.def_en: adj. continuing for a long time
11.ex_en: He had an abiding love of the English countryside.
11.ex_zh: 他对英国的乡村有着永久的热爱之情。

11.def_en: adj. not influenced by emotions or personal interest
11.ex_en: It is written in a detached, precise st yle.
11.ex_zh: 行文冷静客观，一针见血。

11.def_en: v. to instruct and improve especially in moral and religious knowledge
11.ex_en: They tried to edify the child with mus ic.
11.ex_zh: 他们试图用音乐陶冶这孩子。

11.def_en: adj. tedious from familiarity
11.ex_en: The Government, he said, were sticking to stale ideas.
11.ex_zh: 他说政府仍在抱残守缺。

11.def_en: n. official strong criticism
11.ex_en: I deserve neither such praise nor such censure.
11.ex_zh: 这样的夸奖我不敢当，这样的责备我也不敢当。

11.def_en: adj. characterized by absence of speech
11.ex_en: He is mute on the subject of social system.
11.ex_zh: 他对社会制度的问题保持沉默。

11.def_en: adj. not agreeing with what seems right or natural
11.ex_en: This sounds counterintuitive but within the logic of accounting it makes some sense.
11.ex_zh: 这听起来似乎违背常理，但从会计逻辑来说有一定道理。

11.def_en: n. manner of treating
11.ex_en: Parts of the motor wore out because of constant usage.
11.ex_zh: 发动机的一些部件由于不断使用而磨损了。

11.def_en: n. a very dangerous or frightening situation
11.ex_en: My boss felt he was on the edge of an abyss; one false move and he was done for.
11.ex_zh: 我的上司觉得自己如临深渊，一步不慎便会永劫不复。

11.def_en: adj. being over and above what is needed
11.ex_en: They don't have a lot of spare cash.
11.ex_zh: 他们没有多少闲钱。

11.def_en: adj. feeling or showing readiness to fight
11.ex_en: At the moment southerners are loyal mostly to belligerent tribal chiefs, not the nascent government that led the fight for independence.
11.ex_zh: 目前，南部苏丹居民主要效忠于好战的部落首领，而不是带领他们为独立而战的新生的政府。

11.def_en: adj. feeding on plants
11.ex_en: Mammoths were herbivorous mammals.
11.ex_zh: 猛犸是食草性哺乳动物。

11.def_en: adj. causing a feeling of great surprise or wonder
11.ex_en: The results are quite astounding.
11.ex_zh: 结果令人无比震惊。

11.def_en: adj. allowed according to rules or laws
11.ex_en: The French government has condemned the coup in Haiti and has demanded the restoration of the legitimate government.
11.ex_zh: 法国政府已经谴责了海地的政变，并要求恢复合法政府。

11.def_en: v. to avoid or ignore especially to get something done quicker
11.ex_en: A growing number of employers are trying to bypass the unions altogether.
11.ex_zh: 越来越多的雇主试图完全绕过工会行事。

11.def_en: n. a rude or discourteous act
11.ex_en: It is gross incivility to refuse answer when spoken to. .
11.ex_zh: 当人家找你说话时拒绝答应是极其无礼的事

11.def_en: v. affirm, declare
11.ex_en: We predicate goodness and mercy of god.
11.ex_zh: 我们断定上帝之善与慈悲。

11.def_en: v. to declare or make legally invalid or void
11.ex_en: Their marriage was annulled after just six months.
11.ex_zh: 他们的婚姻仅过半年就宣告取消。

11.def_en: v. to give heart to: cheer
11.ex_en: These initiatives appeared to hearten investors.
11.ex_zh: 这些举措似乎鼓舞了投资者。

11.def_en: n. a minor flaw or shortcoming in character or behavior
11.ex_en: I shall never attempt to palliate my own foible by expose the error of another.
11.ex_zh: 我从不想暴露别人的错误，以图减轻自己的缺点。

11.def_en: (1)v. to induct into an office with suitable ceremonies (2)v. to bring about the beginning of
11.ex_en: The new President will be inaugurated on January 20. 1 20
11.ex_zh: 新总统将于；月；号举行就职典礼。

11.def_en: v. to reduce in size
11.ex_en: Sales have decreased so much that they need to downsize.
11.ex_zh: 销售业绩减少很多，所以他们必须缩小规模。

11.def_en: adj. characterized by shrewdness in managing, contriving, or dealing
11.ex_en: Many towns often found it politic to change their allegiance.
11.ex_zh: 很多城镇经常发现改变拥戴对象才是上策。

11.def_en: v. to confound with fear, amazement, or awe
11.ex_en: The news petrified me.
11.ex_zh: 这个新闻让我非常吃惊。

11.def_en: adj. of, relating to, or marked by declamation or rhetorical display
11.ex_en: Rebels like Katharine Hamnett have made a name for bold, declamatory statements. ·
11.ex_zh: 诸如凯瑟琳；哈姆内特之类的叛逆者以口出大胆、夸张之词而闻名。

11.def_en: adj. dynamic, energizing
11.ex_en: The energy of motion is called kinetic energy.
11.ex_zh: 运动的能量称为动能。

11.def_en: (1)adj. believable or realistic (2)adj. superficially fair, reasonable, or valuable but often specious
11.def_zh: 真实的；看似真实（但实际虚假）
11.ex_en: He was so plausible that he conned everybody.
11.ex_zh: 他那么会花言巧语，以至于骗过了所有的人。

11.def_en: adj. not capable of being defended against attack or criticism
11.ex_en: This argument is untenable from an intellectual, moral and practical standpoint.
11.ex_zh: 从智识、道德和现实的角度来看，这一论点是站不住脚的。

11.def_en: (1)adj. hard to notice or see (2)adj. difficult to understand (3)adj. able to make fine distinctions
11.def_zh: 不易觉察的；难以理解的；敏锐的
11.ex_en: The job required a subtle mind.
11.ex_zh: 那项工作需要一个头脑敏锐的人去做。

11.def_en: v. to criticize very harshly
11.ex_en: They lambasted the report as a gross distortion of the truth.
11.ex_zh: 他们激烈批评该报告是严重歪曲事实。

11.def_en: adj. arrested in development or adjustment
11.ex_en: He is fixated on things that remind him of his childhood.
11.ex_zh: 他异常依恋那些使他回忆起童年生活的东西。

11.def_en: (1)adj. of little weight or importance (2)adj. lacking in seriousness
11.ex_en: The group says it wants politicians to stop wasting public money on what it believes are frivolous projects.
11.ex_zh: 这个团体表示希望从政者不要再把公共资金浪费在一些它认为无关痛痒的项目上。

11.def_en: adj. full of danger
11.ex_en: The journey through the jungle was perilous.
11.ex_zh: 穿过丛林的旅行充满了危险。

11.def_en: n. a main interest, quality, or goal
11.ex_en: The course is essentially theoretical in orientation.
11.ex_zh: 该课程的目标基本上是理论性的。

11.def_en: n. the belief that a country should not be involved with other counties
11.ex_en: Voices of economic isolationism do not represent the interests of the American people.
11.ex_zh: 经济孤立主义的声音并不代表美国人民的利益。

11.def_en: adj. fierce, cruel, terrible
11.ex_en: The witch is gloating over her fell scheme.
11.ex_zh: 女巫对自己想到的这个凶恶的诡计沾沾自喜。

11.def_en: (1)v. to examine in order to suppress or delete anything considered objectionable (2)n. a person who supervises conduct and morals
11.ex_en: Censor on film means you examine a film to see whether it can be released or not.
11.ex_zh: 审查电影就是检查一部电影是否能够发行。

11.def_en: n. a mania for great or grandiose performance
11.ex_en: Mr Kim, for all his megalomania and paranoia, is a shrewd tactician.
11.ex_zh: 尽管金正日偏执且妄自尊大，但他却是一个狡猾的谋略家。

11.def_en: adj. proceeding without a specific goal, purpose, or direction
11.ex_en: Don't waste time yours and your manager's with long preambles and rambling thoughts.
11.ex_zh: 不要用长篇大论和杂乱无章的想法来浪费你和经理的时间。

11.def_en: adj. of, relating to, or befitting a teacher or education
11.ex_en: Three aspects are included: its pedagogical idea, the teaching reform and practice, and the teaching effects.
11.ex_zh: 它从教育理念、教学改革与实践、教学效果三个方面展开。

11.def_en: n. the state or custom of being married to only one person at a time
11.ex_en: There are apparently some misconceptions about this whole monogamy thing.
11.ex_zh: 很多人显然对一夫一妻制存在着误解。

11.def_en: adj. leaning to one side
11.ex_en: His suit had shoulders that made him look lopsided.
11.ex_zh: 他那套西服的两肩不平，让他整个人看起来一边高一边低。

11.def_en: (1)v. to begin to fail or weaken (2)v. to hesitate in purpose or action
11.ex_en: The economy shows no signs of faltering.
11.ex_zh: 经济没有衰退的迹象。

11.def_en: adj. in a state of complete disorder and confusion
11.ex_en: Mullins began to rummage among th e chaotic mess of papers on his desk.
11.ex_zh: 马林斯开始在桌子上一堆乱七八糟的文件里翻来翻去。

11.def_en: n. tyro, beginner
11.ex_en: He is a neophyte at politics.
11.ex_zh: 他是个初涉政界的人。

11.def_en: adj. having corresponding points whose connecting lines are bisected by a given point or perpendicularly bisected by a given line or plane
11.ex_en: The two wings of the building are exactly symmetrical.
11.ex_zh: 大楼的两翼完全对称。

11.def_en: adj. the time at which something begins
11.ex_en: Since its inception the company has produced 53 different aircraft designs. 53
11.ex_zh: 该公司自成立以来已经完成了；种不同样式飞行器的设计。

11.def_en: adj. not easily upset or excited
11.ex_en: A placid parent makes a placid home.
11.ex_zh: 温和的父母创造温馨的家。

11.def_en: v. to descend or dip suddenly
11.ex_en: Some traders said the plunge put the market more in sync with the state of the USA.
11.ex_zh: 一些交易员说，此次大盘跳水令市场和美国经济现状更为协调。

11.def_en: n. an indispensable and fundamental basis
11.ex_en: The doctrine of surplus value is the c ornerstone of Marx's economic theor y.
11.ex_zh: 剩余价值学说是马克思经济理论的基石。

11.def_en: n. undivided rule or absolute sovereignty by a single person
11.ex_en: The monarchy in England plays an important role in British culture.
11.ex_zh: 英格兰的君主政体在英国文化中起重要作用。

11.def_en: v. to supply what is required or desired
11.ex_en: When companies try to cater for older customers, they do not always get it right.
11.ex_zh: 公司试着迎合老年客户，但他们并不总是采取正确方式。

11.def_en: adj. new and different from what has been known before
11.ex_en: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices.
11.ex_zh: 抗议者们找到一种新奇的示威方式来反对石油价格的飙升。

11.def_en: adj. treating all people and groups equally
11.ex_en: Careers officers offer impartial advice to all pupils.
11.ex_zh: 就业指导员向所有学生提供公正无私的建议。

11.def_en: n. a deed notable especially for courage
11.ex_en: The tunnel is a brilliant feat of engineering.
11.ex_zh: 这条隧道是工程方面的辉煌成就。

11.def_en: n. a person who hates or distrusts humankind
11.ex_en: You must be some kind of cynic or misanthrope to object to such a laudable goal.
11.ex_zh: 你一定是有点愤世嫉俗或反人类才会反对这个值得赞赏的目标。

11.def_en: adj. happening by chance
11.ex_en: Their success is the result of a fortuitous combination of circumstances.
11.ex_zh: 他们的成功是各种环境因素偶然联系在一起的幸运产物。

11.def_en: n. something that will make everything about a situation better
11.ex_en: Membership of the ERM is not a panacea for Britain's economic problems.
11.ex_zh: 加入欧洲汇率机制并不是解决英国经济问题的万灵丹。

11.def_en: adj. having or showing liveliness and enthusiasm
11.ex_en: Besides ebullient congratulant word, organizer brought a lot of exquisite gifts.
11.ex_zh: 除了热情洋溢的祝贺词外，主办方还带来了精美的小礼物。

11.def_en: v. to talk or write foolishly
11.ex_en: He waffled on about everything that didn't matter.
11.ex_zh: 他继续对所有无关紧要的事胡扯了一通。

11.def_en: adj. urgently important
11.ex_en: It is one of the most pressing problems facing this country.
11.ex_zh: 它是该国面临的最紧迫的问题之一。

11.def_en: adj. causing wonder
11.ex_en: We were driven across this wondrous vast land of lakes and forests.
11.ex_zh: 我们乘车穿越这片有着湖泊及森林的广袤而神奇的土地。

11.def_en: v. to convert into intelligible form
11.ex_en: All he had to do was decode it and pass it over.
11.ex_zh: 他需要做的就是将它破译然后转给他人。

11.def_en: v. strengthen or toughen
11.ex_en: After graduation, I served in the army and meanwhile I went through a lot of anneal.
11.ex_zh: 毕业后我去当兵，其间我在很多方面得到了锻炼。

11.def_en: n. one who practices a profession
11.ex_en: As a practitioner I discovered problem that I need to solve.
11.ex_zh: 作为从业者，我会发现我需要解决的问题。

11.def_en: v. to make greater, more numerous, larger, or more intense
11.ex_en: While searching for a way to augment the family income, she began making dolls.
11.ex_zh: 为了想法子增加家庭收入，她开始制作洋娃娃。

11.def_en: (1)adj. covering or including everything (2)adj. including the stated limits and everything in between
11.def_zh: 全包括的；包括首尾两项的
11.ex_en: An all-inclusive two-week holiday costs around £880 per person. 880
11.ex_zh: 为期两周、包括所有费用的度假大约每人花费；英镑。

11.def_en: n. a slight offense
11.ex_en: People are not tolerant of extra- marital peccadilloes by public figures.
11.ex_zh: 人们不能容忍公众人物婚外过失。

11.def_en: v. to secretly plan with someone to do something that is harmful or illegal
11.ex_en: She admitted conspiring with her lover to murder her husband.
11.ex_zh: 她承认与情夫密谋杀害亲夫。

11.def_en: (1)adj. having a thick edge or point (2)adj. being straight to the point
11.ex_en: He was sawing the bread with a blunt knife.
11.ex_zh: 他用一个很钝的小刀切面包。

11.def_en: adj. possessing or acting with bravery or boldness
11.ex_en: A valiant assault force does not fear a strong fortress.
11.ex_zh: 攻坚不怕堡垒硬。

11.def_en: adj. extremely old
11.ex_en: But as the years have passed, what were once fresh ideas have hardened into hoary dogmas.
11.ex_zh: 但是随着时间的流逝，一度新鲜的观念也变成了陈腐的教条。

11.def_en: (1)v. to change into a vapor or to cause to change into a vapor (2)v. to cause to become dissipated
11.ex_en: The benzene vaporized and formed a huge cloud of gas.
11.ex_zh: 苯蒸发了，形成了一大团气体。

11.def_en: n. a narrow exclusive circle or group of persons
11.ex_en: At university, Taylor had fallen in with a small clique of literature students.
11.ex_zh: 在大学里，泰勒曾经频繁参与一个文学小团体的活动。

11.def_en: n. a natural or inherent aptitude, impulse, or capacity
11.ex_en: I didn't have as strong a maternal instinct as some other mothers.
11.ex_zh: 我不像其他一些母亲那样有那么强烈的母性本能。

11.def_en: n. the technical terminology or characteristic idiom of a special activity or group
11.ex_en: The manual is full of the jargon and slang of self-improvement courses.
11.ex_zh: 手册里满是有关自修课程的行话术语。

11.def_en: n. a doctrine or practice that emphasizes direct vigorous action
11.ex_en: The hallmarks of our corporate culture include an emphasis on teamwork, meritocracry, client service, and activism in a wide variety of areas.
11.ex_zh: 我们企业文化的特色包括：强调团队协作、精英领导、客户服务，以及在广泛领域的行动主义。

11.def_en: adj. surpassing all others
11.ex_en: Some superlative wines are made in this region.
11.ex_zh: 一些上好的葡萄酒就是在这个地区酿造的。

11.def_en: n. a person who has just started learning or doing something
11.ex_en: I am a tyro in English.
11.ex_zh: 我是学英语的新手。

11.def_en: (1)v. to prevent from happening (2)v. to cause to decide not to do something
11.ex_en: Arrests and jail sentences have don e nothing to deter the protesters.
11.ex_zh: 逮捕和监禁都没能吓倒抗议者。

11.def_en: n. shelter or protection from danger or distress
11.ex_en: He regarded the room as a refuge from the outside world.
11.ex_zh: 他把这个屋子当作是逃避外界的避难所。

11.def_en: adj. traveling from place to place
11.ex_en: He is starting itinerant performance all over the world.
11.ex_zh: 他正在世界各地巡回演出。

11.def_en: v. to write or draw hastily and carelessly
11.ex_en: She can't write yet, but she loves to scribble with a pencil. , .
11.ex_zh: 她现在还不会写字；但她喜欢用铅笔乱涂

11.def_en: adj. tending to talk a lot
11.ex_en: My garrulous neighbor had given away the secret.
11.ex_zh: 我那喋喋不休的邻居已把秘密泄露了。

11.def_en: (1)adj. full of dust and unpleasant smells (2)adj. very old-fashioned
11.ex_en: The fusty organization refused to recognize the demand for popular music.
11.ex_zh: 这一古板的机构拒绝承认人们对流行音乐的需求。

11.def_en: v. to become bigger quickly
11.ex_en: In London, the use of the Tube has ballooned.
11.ex_zh: 在伦敦，坐地铁的人激增。

11.ex_en: Small local shops stop being economic when a supermarket opens up nearby.
11.ex_zh: 附近的一家超市开业后，当地的小商店就没有利润可赚了。

12.def_en: adj. hostile toward a rival or one believed to enjoy an advantage
12.ex_en: She was jealous of his wealth.
12.ex_zh: 她嫉妒他的富有。

12.def_en: adj. having a very sour or sharp taste
12.ex_en: Dissolved carbon dioxide makes the water more acidic.
12.ex_zh: 二氧化碳溶解后能使水的酸性增加。

12.def_en: n. a strong desire for money or possessions
12.ex_en: There was a glimmer of cupidity in those small, cunning eyes of his.
12.ex_zh: 他狡猾的小眼睛里露出了一丝贪婪的神情。

12.def_en: adj. of or relating to faction
12.ex_en: These factious groups are more violent than their predecessors and their fanaticism is even more irrational.
12.ex_zh: 这些宗教派组织比他们的前辈更残暴，他们的狂热变得更加丧失理性了。

12.def_en: n. a situation of perplexity or distress
12.ex_en: She found herself in desperate financial straits.
12.ex_zh: 她发觉自己经济状况极为窘迫。

12.def_en: adj. volunteering one's services where they are neither asked nor needed
12.ex_en: When people put on uniforms, their attitude becomes more confident and their manner more officious.
12.ex_zh: 人们穿上制服后会信心倍增，也更爱管闲事了。

12.def_en: adj. coolly and patronizingly haughty
12.ex_en: Her supercilious attitude enraged me.
12.ex_zh: 她的傲慢态度使我极为愤怒。

12.def_en: v. to call something to mind
12.ex_en: Ramona spoke with warmth when she recollected the doctor who used to be at the county hospital.
12.ex_zh: 拉蒙纳回忆起曾在乡村医院工作的那位医生时，言语中透着温情。

12.def_en: n. an unfortunate accident
12.ex_en: This mishap reminded me of a traffic accident I once experienced.
12.ex_zh: 这次小事故使我联想起我过去经历的一次交通事故。

12.def_en: n. false information that is given to people in order to make them believe something or to hide the truth
12.ex_en: They spread disinformation in order t o discredit politicians.
12.ex_zh: 他们散布假消息，企图败坏政治家的名声。

12.def_en: adj. very noticeable
12.ex_en: There has been a marked increase in crimes against property.

13.def_en: (1)adj. restrained in words and actions (2)adj. kept or set apart or aside for future or special use
13.ex_en: He was unemotional, quite quiet, and reserved.
13.ex_zh: 他感情淡漠，沉默寡言，性格内敛。

13.def_en: v. to have a very strong desire for
13.ex_en: We crave to have more of those deli cious moments we may have had with a romantic partner.
13.ex_zh: 我们渴望能与爱情伴侣一起拥有更多这样美好的时刻。

13.def_en: adj. characterized by friendly goodwill
13.ex_en: The two countries made settlement by amicable arrangement.
13.ex_zh: 两国以友好调解解决争端。

13.def_en: (1)v. to utter taunting words (2)v. to be in accord
13.ex_en: He made several cheap jibes at his opponent during the interview.
13.ex_zh: 在采访中他好几次对他的对手粗俗地加以嘲讽。

13.def_en: v. to list or rate (projects, goals, etc.) in order of priority
13.ex_en: The government is prioritising the service sector, rather than investing in industry and production.
13.ex_zh: 政府将优先投资服务行业，而非工业和生产行业。

13.def_en: n. one who insists on exactness or completeness in the observance of something
13.ex_en: Lucy was a stickler for perfection, and everything had to be exactly right, rehearsed down to a T.
13.ex_zh: 露西什么都追求十全十美，样样都不能出一点问题，要准备得滴水不漏。

13.def_en: adj. producing or characterized by gratification of the senses
13.ex_en: I'm drawn to the poetic, sensuous qualities of her paintings.
13.ex_zh: 我喜欢她的画中那种充满诗意、赏心悦目的特性。

13.def_en: v. to give up
13.ex_en: He was forced to relinquish control of the company.
13.ex_zh: 他被迫放弃对公司的控制权。

13.def_en: adj. having or showing knowledge that is learned by studying
13.ex_en: Even the most erudite native speake r does not know the meaning of ever y word.
13.ex_zh: 就算最博学的母语使用者也不可能知道每个字的意思。

13.def_en: adj. overstepping due bounds
13.ex_en: It would be presumptuous to judge what the outcome will be.
13.ex_zh: 现在就判断结果将会怎样未免有些冒昧。

13.def_en: n. a division among the members of a group that occurs because they disagree on something
13.ex_en: The church seems to be on the brink of schism.
13.ex_zh: 教会似乎处于分裂的边缘。

13.def_en: v. to get back again
13.ex_en: The police have managed to retrieve some of the stolen money.
13.ex_zh: 警方已经追回了部分被盗钱款。

13.def_en: v. to soothe or content (someone) by indulgence
13.ex_en: He told me to change my office layout, and I did it, mostly to humor my wife.
13.ex_zh: 他要我改变办公室的格局，我照做了，多半是为了迎合我太太

13.def_en: adj. very busy or full of activity
13.ex_en: My life was very hectic but empty before I met him.
13.ex_zh: 在遇到他之前，我的生活非常繁忙却很空虚。

13.def_en: n. something that naturally follows or results from another thing
13.ex_en: The corollary of this simplistic analys is is that if reforms stop now, so will growth.
13.ex_zh: 根据这种过分单纯的分析得出的推论是，如果现在停止改革，那么经济增长也将停顿。

13.def_en: v. to make something less boring, serious, or sad
13.ex_en: Her speech was leavened with a touch of humour.
13.ex_zh: 几分幽默使她的讲话更为有趣。

13.def_en: n. harsh or discordant sound
13.ex_en: We can always hear a cacophony of horns during the traffic jam.
13.ex_zh: 交通阻塞时，我们总能听到一片不和谐的喇叭声。

13.def_en: adj. different from each other
13.ex_en: The nine republics are immensely di sparate in size, culture and wealth. 9
13.ex_zh: 这；个共和国在面积、文化和财富上迥然不同。

13.def_en: adj. deserving attention, admiration, or respect
13.def_zh: 令人敬畏的，值得尊敬的
13.ex_en: While some of his peers might quarrel with the title, his credentials remain impressive.
13.ex_zh: 尽管他的一些同龄人也许并不认同这个称号，他的资历仍然令人钦佩不已。

13.def_en: adj. not harsh, severe, or strict
13.ex_en: He believes the government already is lenient with drug traffickers.
13.ex_zh: 他认为政府对毒贩已经很宽容了。

13.def_en: adj. difficult or impossible to reach, approach, or understand
13.def_zh: 难以到达的，难以理解的
13.ex_en: The route took us through scenery quite inaccessible to the motorist.
13.ex_zh: 这条路线带我们穿越了驾车者难以抵达的风景区。

13.def_en: v. to take the place of
13.ex_en: By the 1930s the wristwatch had almost completely supplanted the pocket watch. 20 30
13.ex_zh: 到了；世纪；年代，手表几乎完全取代了怀表。

13.def_en: n. the outline or outer edge of something
13.ex_en: She traced the contours of his face with her finger.
13.ex_zh: 她用手指描绘他的脸部轮廓。

13.def_en: adj. not able to be stopped or changed
13.ex_en: His own career continues its inexorable ascent
13.ex_zh: 他事业的上升势头锐不可当。

13.def_en: adj. of or relating to the worldly or temporal
13.ex_en: Cardinal Daly has said that churches should not be used for profane or secular purposes.
13.ex_zh: 戴利主教已经说过，教堂不应该用于非宗教或世俗的目的。

13.def_en: adj. being tough, stubborn, or uncompromising
13.ex_en: My uncle was a hard - nosed army officer who had seen service in two wars. , .
13.ex_zh: 我叔叔是位性格坚韧的军医；他曾身经两次大战

13.def_en: v. to keep within limits
13.ex_en: He did not confine himself to the one language.
13.ex_zh: 他没把自己局限于这一门语言。

13.def_en: (1)v. to cause confusion in ... (2)n. a state of confusion or disorder
13.ex_en: Later they may muddle up your names with those of your cousins.
13.ex_zh: 以后他们可能会把你的名字跟你堂兄弟们的名字相混淆。

13.def_en: n. a concealed or unexpected difficulty or obstacle
13.ex_en: The attack hit a snag and made no headway.
13.ex_zh: 进攻受阻，攻不进去。

13.def_en: adj. imaginable or possible
13.ex_en: Through the centuries, flowers have been used for cooking in every conc eivable way.
13.ex_zh: 几个世纪以来，人们以各种想象得到的方式将鲜花入菜。

13.def_en: v. to confront with assured power of resistance
13.ex_en: The towering pine and cypress trees defy frost and snow.
13.ex_zh: 松柏参天傲霜雪。

13.def_en: n. a person having a superficial interest in an art or a branch of knowledge
13.ex_en: Dilettante watch the scene of bustle, adept guard the entrance. ,
13.ex_zh: 外行看热闹；内行看门道。

13.def_en: adj. acting or intended to enhance one's power, wealth, position, or reputation
13.def_zh: 自我扩张的（仅用于抽象事物）
13.ex_en: Desperate Local families firmly believe Lakwena's self-aggrandizing claims to supernatural power, they begged her for help.
13.ex_zh: 当地绝望的家庭，迷信于拉奎那自我吹嘘的超能力，向她祈求帮助。

13.def_en: n. skillful handling of a situation : adroit maneuvering
13.ex_en: The chairman managed that situation with great finesse.
13.ex_zh: 主席应付那件事情很有手段。

13.def_en: adj. capable of being used or dealt with successfully
13.ex_en: She questioned whether it was feasi ble to stimulate investment in these r egions.
13.ex_zh: 她对在这些地区刺激投资是否可行表示怀疑。

13.def_en: n. something that causes great destruction, violence, etc.
13.ex_en: The Great Depression was an economic cataclysm on a scale hard to imagine.
13.ex_zh: 大萧条是一场规模难以想像的经济灾难。

13.def_en: (1)adj. capable of being discovered or perceived (2)adj. conspicuous
13.ex_en: Her hand was just visible by the light from the sitting room.
13.ex_zh: 借着起居室的灯光，勉强能看见她的手。

13.def_en: adj. beginning to come into being or to become apparent
13.ex_en: She felt for him an incipient tenderness, but scarcely any passion. ,
13.ex_zh: 她对他的好感只是一种刚刚萌芽的柔情；还根本谈不上什么爱情。

13.def_en: n. an impression or view of something brief or transitory
13.ex_en: Let me take a snapshot of you guys, so friends back home can see you.
13.ex_zh: 让我给你们大家拍张快照，这样家里的朋友们可以看到你们。

13.def_en: adj. expending or bestowing profusely
13.ex_en: He drew criticism for his lavish spending.
13.ex_zh: 他因挥霍无度而招致批评。

13.def_en: adj. exceeding the customary or appropriate limits in intensity, quality, amount, or size
13.ex_en: That seaside hotel charges exorbitant prices during the summer holidays.
13.ex_zh: 那家海滨旅馆在夏天休假期间漫天要价。

13.def_en: adj. very great in size or amount
13.ex_en: He saved up an enormous amount of money for his daughter.
13.ex_zh: 他为女儿存了一大笔钱。

13.def_en: n. a reflective looking inward
13.ex_en: Take as much time as you need to introspect upon the areas above.
13.ex_zh: 对以上方面请花尽可能多的时间来思考和反省。

13.def_en: adj. being out of proportion
13.ex_en: The punishment was grossly disproportionate to the crime.
13.ex_zh: 这种惩罚与罪行极不相称。

13.def_en: (1)adj. fashioned from whatever is immediately available (2)adj. formed or used for a special purpose
13.ex_en: For many companies, overhead reduction is the first line of attack when trying to reduce costs, yet many approach it in an ad hoc way.
13.ex_zh: 许多公司谈及精简成本，首先想到的是从裁员着手，这只能称得上是临时措施。

13.def_en: adj. pedestrian, itinerant
13.ex_en: Her father was in the army and the family led a peripatetic existence.
13.ex_zh: 她父亲是军人，所以全家人随军过着一种流动的生活。

13.def_en: n. language that describes something as better or worse than it really is
13.ex_en: American humor is founded largely on hyperbole. .
13.ex_zh: 美式幽默主要以夸张为基础

13.def_en: adj. suggesting that something bad is going to happen in the future
13.ex_en: There was an ominous silence at the other end of the phone
13.ex_zh: 电话那头出现了不祥的沉默。

13.def_en: v. to make cheerful and excited
13.ex_en: We were exhilarated by the cool, pine-scented air.
13.ex_zh: 凉爽的、带有松香味的空气振作起我们的精神。

13.def_en: (1)v. to make more important (2)n. an important position
13.def_zh: 使重要，使显眼；重要位置
13.ex_en: The play foregrounds the relationship between father and daughter.
13.ex_zh: 这部戏剧凸显了父女之间的关系。

13.def_en: v. to entreat or appeal earnestly
13.ex_en: She pleaded with him not to go.
13.ex_zh: 她恳求他不要离开。

13.def_en: v. to deprive of vital content or force
13.ex_en: The censors eviscerated the book to make it inoffensive to the President.
13.ex_zh: 审查员删去了该书的精华以取悦于总统。

13.def_en: adj. separate and different from each other
13.ex_en: Social structures are not discrete obj ects; they overlap and interweave.
13.ex_zh: 社会结构之间不是离散的，他们相互重叠交织。

13.def_en: (1)adj. tending to catch the interest or attention (2)adj. tricky
13.def_zh: 引人注意的；使人上当的
13.ex_en: If you can think of a catchy domain name, get it registered for less than $10. 10
13.ex_zh: 如果你能想到的一个引人注目的域名，注册用不了；美元。

13.def_en: v. to diminish or destroy by degrees
13.ex_en: The cliffs on this coast have been eroded by the sea.
13.ex_zh: 该海岸上的峭壁受到了海水的侵蚀。

13.def_en: (1)v. to fluctuate or veer between one point, position, or opinion and another (2)v. to exert a building or controlling influence on
13.ex_en: The branches were swaying in the wind.
13.ex_zh: 树枝在风中摇曳。

13.def_en: n. a cause or occasion of enticement
13.ex_en: I couldn't resist the temptation to open the letter.
13.ex_zh: 我控制不住诱惑把信打开了。

13.def_en: adj. marked by incisive sarcasm
13.ex_en: He delights in making caustic remarks.
13.ex_zh: 他说话刻薄，还以此为乐。

13.def_en: v. to give or be a sign of
13.ex_en: The incident is believed to presage war.
13.ex_zh: 这件事件据信是战争的前兆。

13.def_en: adj. matching or in agreement with something
13.ex_en: Our bilateral economic relationship i s anchored in the realization that our long- term interests are essentially congru ent and mutually reinforcing.
13.ex_zh: 我们的双边经济关系植根于两国的长期利益基本上是一致且相辅相成的。

13.def_en: adj. violently hostile or aggressive in temperament
13.ex_en: They look like the teeth of some fierce animal.
13.ex_zh: 它们看上去像某种猛兽的牙齿。

13.def_en: (1)n. an insulting or disparaging remark or innuendo (2)v. to make indistinct ...
13.ex_en: She had dared to cast a slur on his character.
13.ex_zh: 她竟敢对他的人品加以诋毁。

13.def_en: v. to make fun of
13.ex_en: He teased me mercilessly about going Hollywood.
13.ex_zh: 他无情地取笑我想去好莱坞的想法。

13.def_en: adj. feeling or showing a lack of interest or enthusiasm
13.ex_en: Joanna had made one or two half- hearted attempts to befriend Graham's young wife.
13.ex_zh: 乔安娜曾有一两次敷衍着去亲近格雷厄姆年轻的妻子。

13.def_en: adj. made up of parts that are different
13.ex_en: America has a very heterogeneous population.
13.ex_zh: 美国人口是由不同种族组成的。

13.def_en: (1)adj. very cruel or unfair (2)adj. overwhelming or depressing to the spirit or senses
13.ex_en: This country still had a deeply oppressive, unequal and divisive political system.
13.ex_zh: 这个国家的政治体制依然残暴异常，缺少平等，四分五裂。

13.def_en: v. to think deeply or carefully about
13.ex_en: The young surgeon contemplated the difficult operation of kidney transplant.
13.ex_zh: 年轻的外科医生为肾移植这一棘手的手术苦思冥想。

13.def_en: adj. willing to allow excessive leniency, generosity, or consideration
13.ex_en: His indulgent mother was willing to let him do anything he wanted.
13.ex_zh: 他母亲很纵容他，任由他想干什么就干什么。

13.def_en: n. something that is from a past time, place, culture, etc.
13.ex_en: The building stands as the last remaining relic of the town's cotton industry.
13.ex_zh: 这座建筑物是小镇棉纺业仅存的遗迹。

13.def_en: v. to show in an improper or selfish way that you are happy with you own success or another person s failure
13.ex_en: Do not gloat when your enemy falls.
13.ex_zh: 不要因为敌人的失败而幸灾乐祸。

13.def_en: adj. possible to verify
13.ex_en: This is not a romantic notion but verifiable fact.
13.ex_zh: 这不是一个不切实际的念头，而是一个可以证明的事实。

13.def_en: n. a state of intellectual or emotional balance
13.ex_en: For the economy to be in equilibrium , income must equal expenditure.
13.ex_zh: 经济要达到平衡，收支必须均衡。

13.def_en: (1)n. something that you say, give, or do to show respect or affection for someone (2)n. money or goods that a ruler or country gives to another ruler or country especially for protection
13.ex_en: At her funeral her oldest friend paid tribute to her life and work.
13.ex_zh: 在葬礼上，她最早的朋友对她的一生和工作给予了高度的赞扬。

13.def_en: adj. aiming for equal wealth, status, etc.
13.ex_en: I still believe in the notion of an egalit arian society.
13.ex_zh: 我仍然相信构建人人平等的社会的理念。

13.def_en: adj. having an odd and amusing quality
13.ex_en: The band have a droll sense of hum or.
13.ex_zh: 这个乐队有一种滑稽古怪的幽默感。

13.def_en: n. a large amount of something
13.ex_en: Olive groves, grapes, and citrus fruits grow in profusion.
13.ex_zh: 橄榄、葡萄和柑橘类水果产量丰富。

13.def_en: (1)adj. dull and ordinary (2)adj. relating to ordinary life on earth rather than to spiritual things
13.ex_en: I found the job very mundane.
13.ex_zh: 我觉得这工作非常单调。

13.def_en: adj. impossible to understand
13.ex_en: His feeling was confused and drifting, but deep unfathomable. , .
13.ex_zh: 这思绪是散乱而飘浮的；又是幽深而莫测的

13.def_en: v. to complain about peevishly
13.ex_en: I would crab about sand in my food on picnics.
13.ex_zh: 野餐时，我会为食物中有沙子而抱怨。

13.def_en: adj. not straight, short, and direct
13.ex_en: His explanation was circuitous and puzzling.
13.ex_zh: 他的解释在兜圈子，让人费解。

13.def_en: v. to bring into danger or peril
13.ex_en: It is illegal and could endanger other people's lives.
13.ex_zh: 这是非法的，可能会危及他人的生命。

13.def_en: (1)adj. wary, careful (2)adj. crafty, shrewd
13.def_zh: 小心的，谨慎的；狡猾的，机敏的
13.ex_en: The cagey fox could not be easily trapped by the farmer.
13.ex_zh: 那只狡猾的狐狸不会轻易落入农夫的陷阱。

13.def_en: v. conspire, plot
13.ex_en: Several local officials are in jail on charges of colluding with the Mafia.
13.ex_zh: 几位当地官员因被控勾结黑手党而入狱。

13.def_en: (1)n. salient or essential element or meaning (2)v. to cause to enter or pierce something by or as if by pushing
13.ex_en: It provides the thrust that makes the craft move forward.
13.ex_zh: 它提供了飞机前进所需的推力。

13.def_en: n. an indication of approval carrying great prestige
13.ex_en: No other shipping company had quite the cachet of Cunard.
13.ex_zh: 没哪家船运公司有肯纳德轮船公司这样的声望。

13.def_en: v. to make someone too afraid to do something
13.ex_en: I'm sure it was deliberately done to c ow us.
13.ex_zh: 我确信，这一事件经过精心策划，目的是恐吓我们。

13.def_en: adj. dealing with or knowing a subject thoroughly or completely
13.ex_en: She has an encyclopedic knowledge of natural history.
13.ex_zh: 她具有广博的自然史知识。

13.def_en: v. to give official authority or legal power to
13.ex_en: The new law empowered the police to search private house.
13.ex_zh: 新法律给予警察搜查私人住宅的权利。

13.def_en: adj. simple or plain
13.ex_en: He was a man of austere habits, in marked contrast to his more flamboyant wife.
13.ex_zh: 他朴素的作风与其张扬的妻子形成了鲜明的对比。

13.def_en: adj. not truly honest or sincere
13.ex_en: It would be disingenuous of me to cl aim I had never seen it.
13.ex_zh: 要说我从未看到过，那就是言不由衷了。

13.def_en: v. to be thought about or worried about by (someone) very often or constantly
13.ex_en: An intelligent man considers the prospect of failure, but he doesn't preoccupy himself with pointless worry.
13.ex_zh: 一个聪明的人会可能失败的情况，但他绝不让自己专注在无谓的担心之中。

13.def_en: adj. not clear
13.ex_en: The notions we children were able to form of the great world beyond were exceedingly nebulous.
13.ex_zh: 我们这些孩子对外部世界所能形成的认识是非常模糊的。

13.def_en: n. the development of friendlier relations between countries or groups of people who have been enemies
13.ex_en: We will not make UN entry a precondition for cross-strait rapprochement.
13.ex_zh: 我们不会将进入联合国作为两岸和解的先决条件。

13.def_en: (1)adj. extremely or unusually large (2)adj. extraordinarily ugly or vicious
13.ex_en: The killer committed monstrous acts.
13.ex_zh: 那个嗜杀成性的凶手犯下了骇人听闻的罪行。

13.def_en: adj. being in a position to incur
13.ex_en: Children are liable to catch cold.
13.ex_zh: 小孩易患感冒。

13.def_en: adj. extending in scope or effect to a prior time or to conditions that existed or originated in the past
13.ex_en: There are few precedents for this sort of retroactive legislation.
13.ex_zh: 这种有追溯力的法规鲜有先例。

14.def_en: v. to take the goods of by force (as in war)
14.ex_en: They plundered and burned the market town of Leominster.
14.ex_zh: 他们洗劫并焚烧了集镇莱姆斯特。

14.def_en: v. undermine
14.ex_en: Analysts say the recession in Japan has sapped investor confidence.
14.ex_zh: 分析家称日本的经济衰退已经打击了投资者的信心。

14.def_en: (1)n. the use of something (2)n. the utilization of economic goods in the satisfaction of wants or in the process of production resulting chiefly in their destruction, deterioration, or transformation
14.ex_en: Energy consumption rises as countri es industrialize.
14.ex_zh: 随着各国实现工业化，能源消费增加了。

14.def_en: adj. of or relating to a whole group or class
14.ex_en: Parmesan is a generic term used to describe a family of hard Italian cheeses.
14.ex_zh: 帕尔玛干酪是意大利硬奶酪的通称。

14.def_en: n. harshness of behavior or speech that expresses bitterness or anger
14.ex_en: He spoke to the boy with asperity.
14.ex_zh: 他严厉地对那男孩讲话。

14.def_en: adj. given or provided abundantly
14.ex_en: Mr Yang has a bountiful experience working with education.
14.ex_zh: 杨先生有着丰富的教育工作经验。

14.def_en: (1)adj. full of anger and disagreement (2)adj. hard to manage or control
14.ex_en: Children often get fractious and tearful when tired.
14.ex_zh: 孩子们疲倦时易烦躁好哭。

14.def_en: adj. having or showing no understanding of what is proper or acceptable

15.ex_zh: 戴维的妈妈情绪不稳定，心情也不好。

15.def_en: n. cheep falseness
15.ex_en: Are those real diamonds or only shams? ?
15.ex_zh: 那些是真钻石还是赝品

15.def_en: v. to cause to divide into two branches or parts
15.ex_en: The stream bifurcates into two narrow winding channels.
15.ex_zh: 那条小溪分成两股窄而弯曲的支流。

15.def_en: v. form the foundation of
15.ex_en: These ideas underlie much of his work.
15.ex_zh: 他的作品大部分都是以这些主题思想为基础。

15.def_en: v. to cause to do something
15.ex_en: Doctors said surgery could induce a heart attack.
15.ex_zh: 医生们说手术有可能引起心脏病发作。

15.def_en: v. to go to the aid of
15.ex_en: These refugees are very grateful to the government's succor.
15.ex_zh: 这些难民非常感激政府的救援。

15.def_en: n. a mutually advantageous conjunction or compatibility of distinct business participants or elements
15.ex_en: Of course, there's quite obviously a lot of synergy between the two companies.
15.ex_zh: 当然，这两家公司间非常明显地产生了巨大的协同效应。

15.def_en: adj. expressing harsh criticism especially in a way that is funny
15.ex_en: His mordant wit appealed to students.
15.ex_zh: 他那尖刻的妙语受到学生的欢迎。

15.def_en: n. glowing and warmly enthusiastic praise
15.ex_en: He pronounced a splendid encomium upon Alice in the forum.
15.ex_zh: 他在广场上为爱丽丝作了华丽的赞颂。

15.def_en: v. to give shape or form to
15.ex_en: She fashioned a pot from the clay.
15.ex_zh: 她用黏土制成一个罐。

15.def_en: v. to present again
15.ex_en: The atmosphere of the novel is successfully reproduced in the movie.
15.ex_zh: 小说的氛围在电影中得到了成功的再现。

15.def_en: v. to revolve rapidly
15.ex_en: The plane was spinning out of control.
15.ex_zh: 飞机失去控制，不停地旋转。

15.def_en: n. a distinguishing characteristic, trait, or feature
15.ex_en: Police said the explosion bore all the hallmarks of a terrorist attack.
15.ex_zh: 警方称这次爆炸具有恐怖分子袭击的所有特征。

15.def_en: adj. occurring occasionally, singly, or in irregular or random instances
15.ex_en: The sound of sporadic shooting could still be heard.
15.ex_zh: 仍能听见零星的枪声。

15.def_en: n. deception or trickery
15.ex_en: Charges of political chicanery were brought against him.
15.ex_zh: 他被指控行驶政治欺骗手段。

15.def_en: adj. tastelessly showy
15.ex_en: They climbed the garish purple- carpeted stairs.
15.ex_zh: 他们登上铺着俗艳的紫色地毯的楼梯。

15.def_en: (1)v. to become smaller or less (2)n. a time of phase of gradual decrease
15.ex_en: Her enthusiasm for the whole idea was waning rapidly.
15.ex_zh: 她对整个想法的热情迅速冷淡了下来。

15.def_en: n. the dispensing or receiving of reward or punishment
15.ex_en: People are seeking retribution for the latest terrorist outrages.
15.ex_zh: 人们在设法对恐怖分子最近的暴行进行严惩。

15.def_en: (1)adj. careful about doing something in an accurate and exact way (2)adj. complete or absolute
15.ex_en: The police carried out a thorough investigation.
15.ex_zh: 警方展开了全面的调查。

15.def_en: v. to be present in large numbers or in great quantity
15.ex_en: Natural resources abound in our country.
15.ex_zh: 我国自然资源丰富。

15.def_en: n. helpful information or criticism that is given to someone to say what can be done to improve a performance, product, etc.
15.ex_en: We need both positive and negative feedback from our customers.
15.ex_zh: 我们需要顾客正反两方面的反馈意见。

15.def_en: adj. used for decoration
15.ex_en: The stream was dammed up to form ornamental lakes. ,
15.ex_zh: 溪流用水坝拦挡起来；形成了装饰性的湖泊。

15.def_en: v. to make up for some defect or weakness
15.ex_en: To ease financial difficulties, farmers could be compensated for their loss of subsidies.
15.ex_zh: 为了缓解经济困难，农场主们损失的补贴会得到补偿。

15.def_en: v. to evaluate the worth, significance or status of
15.ex_en: In China, she said, workers are often asked to appraise their peers, but this turns out to be less feedback than snitching.
15.ex_zh: 她说，在中国，老板经常要求员工对同事进行评价，但结果往往是打小报告的成分多于反馈。

15.def_en: n. a league or compact for mutual support or common action
15.ex_en: They've entered this new confederacy because the central government's been unable to control the collapsing economy.
15.ex_zh: 由于中央政府无力控制逐渐崩溃的经济，所以他们加入了这个新联盟。

15.def_en: adj. agreeing with what seems naturally right
15.ex_en: Her perception of the right seemed almost intuitive.
15.ex_zh: 她对正确事物的理解几乎是凭借直觉的。

15.def_en: v. to transmit to another
15.ex_en: They rendered assistance to the disaster victims.
15.ex_zh: 他们给灾民提供了援助。

15.def_en: adj. growing quickly and in a way that is difficult to control
15.ex_en: Malaria is still rampant in some swampy regions.
15.ex_zh: 疟疾在一些沼泽地区仍很猖獗。

15.def_en: v. to get or win back
15.ex_en: He had realized the mistake he had made and wanted to redeem himself.
15.ex_zh: 他已经认识到了自己的错误，想要进行补救。

15.def_en: n. a minute or minor detail
15.ex_en: They are take great pains for the every minutia.
15.ex_zh: 他们为每个细节煞费苦心。

15.def_en: adj. lacking discretion, wisdom, or good judgment
15.ex_en: The Government of Jamaica consider it imprudent to abolish the death penalty.
15.ex_zh: 牙买加政府认为废除死刑是轻率之举。

15.def_en: (1)adj. extremely poisonous or venomous (2)adj. full of malice
15.ex_en: The media has waged a virulent hate campaign against her.
15.ex_zh: 新闻界向她发起了恶毒攻击。

15.def_en: (1)v. to stop from happening or to cause to happen at a later time (2)v. to act before in order to prevent something
15.ex_en: Try to anticipate what your child will do and forestall problems.
15.ex_zh: 尽量预见你的孩子会干什么，并预先阻止问题发生。

15.def_en: v. to cut off or cut back parts of for better shape or more fruitful growth
15.ex_en: He pruned the longer branches off the tree.
15.ex_zh: 他把较长的树枝剪掉了。

15.def_en: n. a ranting piece of writing
15.ex_en: The screed tired the audience.
15.ex_zh: 那篇冗长的演说使听众厌烦了。

15.def_en: v. to combine into a composite whole
15.ex_en: The two meanings conflated.
15.ex_zh: 这两个意思混在一起了。

15.def_en: v. to exceed in importance
15.ex_en: Hester is overshadowed by her younger and more attractive sister.
15.ex_zh: 赫斯特被她那更年轻而且更有魅力的妹妹超越了。

15.def_en: v. to divide and share out according to a plan
15.ex_en: They dispensed new clothes to the children in the orphanage.
15.ex_zh: 他们把新衣服发给孤儿院的小孩们。

15.def_en: n. idealizing or idolizing biography
15.ex_en: His call for an end to hagiography and the revived personality cult drove Maoists into a rage.
15.ex_zh: 茅于轼呼吁结束对毛泽东的神化和再度个人崇拜，这让毛泽东主义者们怒不可遏。

15.def_en: adj. valuable beyond estimation
15.ex_en: I was able to gain invaluable experience over that year.
15.ex_zh: 在那一年里我获得了十分宝贵的经验。

15.def_en: n. magnificence
15.ex_en: Venezuela is the ideal starting point to explore the grandeur and natural beauty of South America.
15.ex_zh: 委内瑞拉是探索南美的宏伟壮观与自然美景的理想出发点。

15.def_en: adj. aware of something
15.ex_en: We are cognizant of the problem.
15.ex_zh: 我们意识到了这个问题。

15.def_en: adj. not real or genuine
15.ex_en: The scholar produced some bogus documents to support her claim.
15.ex_zh: 该学者提出了一些伪造的文献来支持她的观点。

15.def_en: adj. marked by complexity, fullness of detail, or ornateness
15.ex_en: This is an elaborate management training scheme for graduates.
15.ex_zh: 这是一份针对毕业生的详尽的管理培训计划。

15.def_en: n. a line at the beginning of a news story, magazine article, or book giving the writer's name
15.ex_en: Finally, we wish to thank the author of this article which carries no byline.
15.ex_zh: 最后，我们要感谢这篇文章的那位没有署名的作者。

15.def_en: n. a prolonged lamentation or complaint
15.ex_en: Siegel's book is a jeremiad against the ills the Internet has visited upon our lives.
15.ex_zh: 西格尔的书是一本哀史，它反对祸害，反对网络，这些已经逗留在我们生命中的东西。

15.def_en: adj. belonging to the essential nature of a thing
15.ex_en: Diamonds have little intrinsic value and their price depends almost entirely on their scarcity.
15.ex_zh: 钻石没有多少本质价值，它们的价格几乎完全取决于其稀有程度。

15.def_en: n. subsequent development
15.ex_en: The police said the clash was a sequel to yesterday's nationwide strike...
15.ex_zh: 警方说这场冲突是昨天全国大罢工的余波。

15.def_en: (1)adj. yielding abundantly (2)adj. abundantly and often extravagantly rich and varied
15.ex_en: There were two very large oak trees in front of our house with wide spreading branches and luxuriant foliage.
15.ex_zh: 那时我们家门口有两棵枝广叶茂的大橡树。

15.def_en: (1)adj. of or relating to art or beauty (2)adj. pleasing in appearance
15.ex_en: Their furniture was more aesthetic than practical.
15.ex_zh: 他们的家具华而不实。

15.def_en: adj. exuding fragrance
15.ex_en: Their own yard is redolent with lilacs.
15.ex_zh: 他们家自己的院子里散发着丁香花的芬芳。

15.def_en: (1)v. to speak ill of (2)v. to take away

15.ex_zh: 那没有贬低他的功绩。

15.def_en: adj. written in or consisting of elegiac couplets
15.ex_en: The mourning hall is full of wreaths, and on all the walls elegiac scrolls ar e hung.
15.ex_zh: 灵堂里摆满了花圈，墙上也挂满了挽幛。

15.def_en: n. someone or something that has the same job or purpose as another
15.ex_en: It is not a unique instance, but has it s counterpart.
15.ex_zh: 无独有偶。

15.def_en: n. a feeling or belief that good things will happen in the future
15.ex_en: Optimism was gradually taking the place of pessimism.
15.ex_zh: 乐观情绪逐渐取代了悲观主义。

15.def_en: n. a measure around a body
15.ex_en: A girl he knew had upset him by commenting on his increasing girth.
15.ex_zh: 他认识的一位女孩对他越来越粗的腰身说三道四，这让他心里很不痛快。

15.def_en: adj. exaggerated or disposed to exaggerate one s own worth or importance often by an overbearing manner
15.ex_en: Trump said that the press had misrepresented him as arrogant and bullying.
15.ex_zh: 他说新闻媒体把他歪曲成了一个傲慢而又霸道的人。

15.def_en: v. to give joy to
15.ex_en: When the war ended, people finally had cause to rejoice.
15.ex_zh: 战争结束，人们终于可以欢欣鼓舞了。

15.def_en: v. to come together to form a group
15.ex_en: The passengers clustered together in small groups.
15.ex_zh: 乘客们三五成群聚在一起。

15.def_en: v. to hide or disguise
15.ex_en: She cloaked her embarrassment by rushing into speech.
15.ex_zh: 她急忙开口说话，以掩饰自己的尴尬。

15.def_en: adj. prevalent especially to an increasing degree
15.ex_en: Bribery and corruption were rife in the industry.
15.ex_zh: 在这个行业中，贿赂和腐败现象猖獗。

15.def_en: adj. devoted to or biased in support of a party, group, or cause
15.ex_en: The audience was very partisan, and refused to listen to the points she was making in her speech. ,
15.ex_zh: 观众们很有偏见；拒绝聆听她发言中的要点。

15.def_en: adj. of, relating to, involving, or forming a periphery or surface part
15.ex_en: Among high-income economies, those with most slack are those in the peripheral eurozone.
15.ex_zh: 在高收入经济体中，拥有最多闲置资源的是那些处于欧元区外围的经济体。

15.def_en: adj. beginning to exist
15.ex_en: Our manager discovered a nascent talent.
15.ex_zh: 我们经理发现了一个新人才。

15.def_en: adj. open to view
15.ex_en: There was little overt support for the project.
15.ex_zh: 对这个项目公开表示支持的很少。

15.def_en: v. to cause to be at a loss as to what to say, think, or do
15.ex_en: The professor is never at a nonplus, and never perplexed by a problem.
15.ex_zh: 那位教授从未感到困惑，也没有被任何问题所难倒。

15.def_en: adj. not able to be proved wrong
15.ex_en: The pictures provide irrefutable evidence of the incident.
15.ex_zh: 这些图片为该事件提供了无法反驳的证据。

15.def_en: (1)v. to talk loudly and in a way that shows anger (2)v. to scold vehemently
15.ex_en: As the boss began to rant, I stood up and went out.
15.ex_zh: 老板开始咆哮的时候，我起身走了出去。

15.def_en: adj. hortative, exhortatory
15.ex_en: In his speech, he quoted the hortatory moralism of many contemporary churchmen.
15.ex_zh: 在他的演讲中，他援引了来自许多当代牧师的劝诫格言。

15.def_en: adj. expressing a strong opinion
15.ex_en: Such tendentious statements are likely to provoke strong opposition.
15.ex_zh: 这种有倾向性的说法可能招致强烈的反对。

15.def_en: adj. feeling or showing anger because of something unjust or unworthy
15.ex_en: They were indignant that they hadn't been invited.
15.ex_zh: 他们因没有受到邀请而愤愤不平。

15.def_en: n. something that came before something else and may have influenced or caused it
15.ex_en: It was permissible to take account of antecedent legislation.
15.ex_zh: 先前的法律是允许被考虑进来的。

15.def_en: v. support, stimulate
15.ex_en: The result will inevitably fuel speculation about the Prime Minister's future.
15.ex_zh: 这一结果将不可避免地加剧人们对首相未来的揣测。

15.def_en: v. to thrust oneself in without invitation, permission, or welcome
15.ex_en: The press has been blamed for intruding into people's personal lives in an unacceptable way.
15.ex_zh: 新闻媒体因以一种令人无法接受的方式侵入人们的私生活而受到谴责。

15.def_en: n. a person who says something will not work or is not possible
15.ex_en: One naysayer pointed out that these athletes were simply reverting to the mean.
15.ex_zh: 一位反对者指出，这些运动员只不过是从巅峰状态回复到了平均水平。

15.def_en: adj. dealing with the problems that exist in a specific situation in a reasonable and logical way instead of depending on ideas and theories
15.ex_en: Robin took a pragmatic look at her situation.
15.ex_zh: 罗宾从务实的角度看待她的状况。

15.def_en: adj. subject to erratic behavior or unpredictable change
15.ex_en: Some people may think that this project whimsical, but with a few years ago, has substantially increased its feasibility.
15.ex_zh: 或许有人会认为这一项目异想天开，不过与几年前相比，其可行性已大幅提高。

15.def_en: v. to speak slightingly of
15.ex_en: It makes no sense to belittle the enormity of the disaster.
15.ex_zh: 没有理由轻视这场灾难的严重性。

15.def_en: adj. fit to be eaten
15.ex_en: The meat of the herbivore is, in comparison, far more edible and smell wise.
15.ex_zh: 相比之下，食草动物的肉更易食用，闻起来更美味。

15.def_en: n. a charitable act or gift
15.ex_en: The enterpriser's beneficence is well-known.
15.ex_zh: 这位企业家的善行是众所皆知的。

15.def_en: adj. very unusual in a way that does not seem natural
15.ex_en: Their parents had an almost preternatural ability to understand what was going on in their children's minds.
15.ex_zh: 他们的父母有着一种近乎神奇的能力，能够洞悉自己的孩子脑子里正在想什么。

15.def_en: adj. distasteful, unpalatable
15.ex_en: She refused to have a thin, brackish gruel.
15.ex_zh: 她拒绝喝稀而难以下咽的粥。

15.def_en: adj. complete in every detail
15.ex_en: It was one of the most consummate triumphs of David Beckham's career.
15.ex_zh: 这是贝克汉姆职业生涯中最完美的凯旋之一。

15.def_en: n. something offered for consideration or acceptance
15.ex_en: The proposition that democracies do not fight each other is based on a tiny historical sample.
15.ex_zh: 认为民主国家互不争斗的观点是以一个极小的历史样本为根据的。

15.def_en: v. to perplex or confuse especially by a complexity, variety, or multitude of objects or considerations
15.ex_en: The big city bewildered the old woman from the countryside.
15.ex_zh: 大城市把乡下来的老奶奶弄糊涂了。

15.def_en: adj. showing or suggesting that future success is likely
15.ex_en: With favorable weather conditions it was an auspicious moment to set sail.
15.ex_zh: 风和日丽，正是扬帆出海的黄道吉日。

15.def_en: adj. characterized by or manifesting unrest especially of mind
15.ex_en: The audience grew restless and inattentive.
15.ex_zh: 观众变得焦躁不安，注意力不集中。

15.def_en: adj. very small in amount or number
15.ex_en: Food was scarce and expensive.
15.ex_zh: 食物供不应求，而且价格昂贵。

15.def_en: n. egoism, egocentrism
15.ex_en: Those who suffer from narcissism become self-absorbed or chronic show-offs.
15.ex_zh: 被自恋症折磨的人会变得只专注于自己的事情，或者不断地自我炫耀。

15.def_en: v. to praise
15.ex_en: We celebrate somebody like a Steve Jobs, who has created different revolutionary products. •
15.ex_zh: 我们赞美像史蒂夫；乔布斯那样的人，他创造出了差异化的革命性产品。

15.def_en: adj. meticulously or excessively critical
15.ex_en: He is so hypercritical that he corrects every mistake his students made.
15.ex_zh: 他很苛刻，对于学生的每个错误都要纠正。

15.def_en: v. to publicly state that someone or something is bad or wrong
15.ex_en: The letter called for trade union free dom and civil rights, but did not open ly denounce the regime.
15.ex_zh: 这封信呼吁保障工会自由和公民权利，但没有公开谴责该政权。

15.def_en: n. the origin and the history of something
15.ex_en: She had an impeccable aristocratic pedigree.
15.ex_zh: 她有纯正的贵族血统。

15.def_en: v. to make nervous, worried, or upset
15.ex_en: The presence of the two policemen unsettled her.
15.ex_zh: 两名警察的出现让她感到不安。

15.def_en: v. to concentrate in a small or narrow space
15.ex_en: Trucks congested the tunnel.
15.ex_zh: 货车堵塞了通道。

15.def_en: (1)v. to treat in a harsh or harmful way (2)v. to use wrongly (3)n. a corrupt practice or custom
15.ex_en: Cases of child abuse often go unreported or ignored by uninformed citizens.
15.ex_zh: 虐待儿童案件常常没人举报，或者为缺乏相关知识的公民所忽略。

15.def_en: n. an act or instance of burning
15.ex_en: Soot is usually the product of the imperfect combustion of fuel.
15.ex_zh: 煤烟通常是燃料不完全燃烧的产物。

16.def_en: adj. not capable of being solved
16.ex_en: Life is a mystery, an inextricable mystery for human society.
16.ex_zh: 生命是一个谜，是红尘中的人永远也解不开的谜。

16.def_en: v. to lead astray: misdirect
16.ex_en: Low-quality auditing will misguide the voucher users to make decision and let them lose money.
16.ex_zh: 低质量的审计工作则会使报表使用者决策失误，从而使其利益遭受损失。

16.def_en: adj. given to or abounding in excessive moralizing
16.ex_en: His article is sententious and pomjpou.
16.ex_zh: 他写的文章是说教式的，华而不实。

16.def_en: v. to bring into a condition of decay or partial ruin
16.ex_en: The building had been dilapidated by neglect.
16.ex_zh: 这座大楼因失修而圮毁。

16.def_en: v. to follow as a pattern, model, or example
16.ex_en: Clarence screws up his face and imitates the Colonel again. ,
16.ex_zh: 克拉伦斯又板起面孔；模仿起上校来。

16.def_en: adj. causing a very large amount of damage
16.ex_en: Severe damage witnessed the destructive force of the storm.
16.ex_zh: 严重的损失表明了这场暴风雨巨大的破坏力。

16.def_en: adj. having a very noticeable quality that attracts a lot of attention
16.ex_en: Freddie Mercury was a flamboyant star of the British hard rock scene. ·
16.ex_zh: 弗雷迪；摩克瑞是英国硬摇滚乐界一颗耀眼的明星。

16.def_en: (1)adj. having a large estate or property (2)adj. amply or plentifully provided or fashioned often to the point of ostentation
16.ex_en: Most of the cash went on supporting his opulent lifestyle.
16.ex_zh: 大部分现金都花在了维系他挥金如土的生活方式上。

16.def_en: (1)adj. having a rough quality (2)adj. rude or offensive
16.ex_en: The young mother set her son on the bed and rubbed him down with a coarse towel.
16.ex_zh: 那位年轻的母亲让她的儿子躺到床上，用一条粗糙的毛巾给他擦干了全身。

19.ex_en: The chairman overrode the committee's objections and signed the agreement.
19.ex_zh: 主席不顾委员会的反对，径行签署了协议。

19.def_en: (1)n. one who is excessively fond of eating and drinking (2)n. one who is heartily interested in good food and drink
19.ex_en: As a gourmand known by everyone, Andy knows all the restaurants in the district.
19.ex_zh: 作为人人皆知的吃货，安迪知道这个地区所有的饭店。

19.def_en: adj. marked by grasping meanness and penuriousness
19.ex_en: He is miserly with both his time and his money.
19.ex_zh: 他对时间和金钱都非常吝啬。

19.def_en: n. extreme cruelty
19.ex_en: The pirates treated their captives with barbarity.
19.ex_zh: 盗们残暴地对待他们的俘虏。

19.def_en: adj. characterized by grotesqueness, extravagance, complexity or flamboyance
19.ex_en: Some of baroque architecture over the pursuit of luxury boldness, even to the point of tedious piling up.
19.ex_zh: 有些复杂的建筑过分追求华贵气魄，甚至到了繁琐堆砌的地步。

19.def_en: n. one having spiritual or ecclesiastical supervision
19.ex_en: He resigned from his post as bishop when the scandal broke.
19.ex_zh: 丑闻传开后他辞去了主教职务。

19.def_en: v. to cause to get caught in or twisted with something else
19.ex_en: He became entangled in a series of conflicts with the management.
19.ex_zh: 他卷入了与管理层的一系列冲突之中。

19.def_en: (1)n. very strong disapproval or criticism of a person or thing especially by a large number of people (2)n. something that brings disgrace
19.ex_en: His political opinions have attracted the opprobrium of the Left.
19.ex_zh: 他的政治观点遭到左派的抨击。

19.def_en: n. an enthusiastic advocate
19.ex_en: He is an evangelist of junk bonds.
19.ex_zh: 他是低档风险债券的鼓吹者。

19.def_en: (1)v. to give the necessary skill or knowledge to do a particular job or activity (2)v. to limit or modify the meaning of
19.ex_en: The test qualifies you to drive heavy vehicles.
19.ex_zh: 通过这一考试就有资格驾驶重型车辆。

19.def_en: v. to make longer or to grow longer
19.ex_en: Corn is treated when the stalk starts to elongate.
19.ex_zh: 在玉米秆开始拔节时，给玉米打药。

19.def_en: (1)adj. incapable of being realized or achieved (2)adj. having or marked by foresight and imagination
19.def_zh: 幻想的，不切实际的；有眼光的
19.ex_en: Ruth is a visionary girl, she spends her time daydreaming.
19.ex_zh: 露丝是个好幻想的女孩，她常把时间消磨于做白日梦。

19.def_en: v. to give a brief summary of something
19.ex_en: Let's just recapitulate the essential points.
19.ex_zh: 让我们只概述一下基本要点吧。

19.def_en: n. a route more direct than the one ordinarily taken
19.ex_en: He was always looking for a shortcut to fame and fortune. .
19.ex_zh: 他总是在找成名发财的捷径

19.def_en: v. to lay down a rule
19.ex_en: Many countries have yet to prescribe such limits.
19.ex_zh: 很多国家也对此类限制进行了规定。

19.def_en: adj. excessively grasping or covetous
19.ex_en: Rapacious developers soon bought up the land.
19.ex_zh: 不久贪婪的开发商就把这块地全部买下了。

19.def_en: adj. sharing a border, wall, or point
19.ex_en: The house adjacent to ours has been sold, so we have a new neighbour.
19.ex_zh: 与我们毗邻的房子卖出去了，因此我们有了一个新邻居。

19.def_en: (1)adj. consisting of or constituting a single unit (2)adj. constituting a massive undifferentiated and often rigid whole
19.ex_en: Mathematics is not a single monolithic structure of absolute truth!
19.ex_zh: 数学并不是绝对真理的单一整体结构。

19.def_en: v. to cause to enter
19.ex_en: The secretary ushered me into his office.
19.ex_zh: 秘书把我领进他的办公室。

19.def_en: v. to make nervous
19.ex_en: Officials are not normally rattled by any reporter's question.
19.ex_zh: 官员们一般不会因为任何记者的提问而紧张不安。

19.def_en: (1)v. to quickly move away from something shocking, frightening, or disgusting (2)v. to become smaller in amount, size, or value
19.ex_en: One child shrinks away from me when I try to talk to him.
19.ex_zh: 当我试图和一个孩子说话时，他避开了我。

19.def_en: adj. no longer useful or acceptable
19.ex_en: The tourists snigger at the locals' outdated ways and dress.
19.ex_zh: 游客们偷偷地取笑当地人过时的做法和衣着。

19.def_en: n. the unfair practice by a powerful person of giving jobs and other favors to friends
19.ex_en: Many small town mayor and city offi cial practice cronyism.
19.ex_zh: 许多小镇的市长和大城市的官员都有任人唯亲的行为。

19.def_en: n. an ancestor in the direct line
19.ex_en: He was also a progenitor of seven presidents of Nicaragua. 7
19.ex_zh: 他也是尼加拉瓜；任总统的祖先。

19.def_en: n. great brightness or luster
19.ex_en: Never in his life had he gazed on such splendor.
19.ex_zh: 他生平从没有见过如此辉煌壮丽的场面。

19.def_en: adj. careless, slovenly
19.ex_en: Slipshod work will never pass muster.
19.ex_zh: 草率的工作绝对经不起检查。

19.def_en: n. a written or typewritten composition or document as distinguished from a printed copy
19.ex_en: The lost manuscript was found in a repository in France.
19.ex_zh: 丢失的手稿在法国的一个存放处被找到了。

19.def_en: n. dishonest behavior that is meant to trick someone
19.ex_en: Samantha believed he was guilty of duplicity in his private dealings.
19.ex_zh: 萨曼莎认为他在为其私底下两面派的行为而心生愧疚。

19.def_en: v. to utter or pronounce with affectation
19.ex_en: The young lady didn't mince their words, and predicted the worst...
19.ex_zh: 这位女士直言相告，并做了最坏的预测。

19.def_en: (1)adj. causing no injury (2)adj. not likely to bother or offend anyone
19.ex_en: Even seemingly innocuous words are offensive in certain contexts.
19.ex_zh: 甚至看似毫无恶意的言辞在某些语境下都会引起冒犯。

19.def_en: n. the condition of being secluded
19.ex_en: In spite of the extremity of her seclusion she was sane
19.ex_zh: 尽管完全与世隔绝，她依然心智健全。

19.def_en: adj. Marked by unduly fearful of what is foreign and especially of people of foreign origin
19.ex_en: The French are proud and highly xenophobic when it comes to cooking.
19.ex_zh: 谈到烹饪，法国人会颇为得意并且极端排斥外国菜。

19.def_en: adj. having particles that easily move and change their relative position without a separation of the mass and that easily yield to pressure
19.ex_en: The forehand stroke should be fluid and well balanced.
19.ex_zh: 正手击球应该保证动作流畅和平稳。

19.def_en: n. noisy confusion
19.ex_en: She was distracted by a commotion across the street.
19.ex_zh: 她因街对面的骚动而心烦意乱。

19.def_en: adj. comically quaint
19.ex_en: Slowly each expression became more quizzical than the last as everyone tried to recollect my name from the New York Times Best Seller List.
19.ex_zh: 慢慢地，每个人的表情都变得古怪起来，他们努力回忆在《纽约时报》的畅销书作家中有没有我的名字。

19.def_en: adj. commonly spoken of
19.ex_en: The proverbial calm before the storm.
19.ex_zh: 俗话说这是暴风雨前的平静。

19.def_en: adj. given to grumbling
19.ex_en: Your grandmother has nothing to stop her from being bored, grouchy and lonely.
19.ex_zh: 你奶奶既无聊又孤独，总是没完没了地发牢骚。

19.def_en: adj. formal, stiff
19.ex_en: His delivery was stilted and occasionally stumbling.
19.ex_zh: 他的发言很生硬，有时还打结巴。

19.def_en: adj. very confident and daring
19.ex_en: Your plan of going abroad is an audacious decision.
19.ex_zh: 你计划出国是一项大胆的决定。

19.def_en: n. a feeling of guilt or regret
19.ex_en: He has no compunction about relating how he killed his father.
19.ex_zh: 他在讲述自己杀害父亲的过程时，没有感到丝毫的内疚。

19.def_en: adj. not compatible
19.ex_en: New computer software is often incompatible with older computers.
19.ex_zh: 新的计算机软件往往和旧式计算机不兼容。

19.def_en: v. to complain about
19.ex_en: The poor shouldn't underestimate their own capabilities and constantly bemoan their fate.
19.ex_zh: 穷人不应低估自身能力，也不要自怨自艾，哀叹命运。

19.def_en: v. to adjust to or keep in proper measure or proportion
19.ex_en: These chemicals modulate the effect of potassium.
19.ex_zh: 这些化学物质可以调节钾的功效。

19.def_en: adj. of a kink that is appropriate for the situation or purpose
19.ex_en: The research indicates that the adding quantity of each additive has a fitting range.
19.ex_zh: 研究表明各种添加剂的加入量都有一个适宜的范围。

19.def_en: (1)n. a symbol written above and to the right of a mathematical expression to indicate the operation of raising to a power (2)n. one that champions, practices, or exemplifies
19.ex_en: She was a leading exponent of free trade during her political career.
19.ex_zh: 她从政期间是自由贸易的主要倡导者。

19.def_en: v. to place (different things) side by side
19.ex_en: The technique Mr. Wilson uses most often is to juxtapose things for dramatic effect.
19.ex_zh: 威尔逊先生最常用的技巧是把事物并列起来以获得戏剧性效果。

19.def_en: adj. of or relating to the group of books, plays, poems, etc., that are traditionally considered to be very important
19.ex_en: This award strengthened Ballard's status as a canonical writer.
19.ex_zh: 这项奖巩固了巴拉德作为一名经典作家地地位。

19.def_en: adj. forestelling events
19.ex_en: This ominous warning soon proved prophetic.
19.ex_zh: 这个不祥的警告很快证明是有预见性的。

19.def_en: v. to spread abroad as though sowing seed
19.ex_en: It took years to disseminate information about Aids in Africa.
19.ex_zh: 在非洲传播关于艾滋病方面的知识耗时数年。

19.def_en: n. a mixture especially of incongruous elements
19.ex_en: A motley group of people attended the meeting.
19.ex_zh: 参会的人很杂。

19.def_en: adj. difficult to understand
19.ex_en: His impenetrable eyes and inscrutable countenance give little away.
19.ex_zh: 他让人捉摸不透的眼神和深不可测的表情几乎什么也没流露。

19.def_en: adj. impalpable
19.ex_en: There are intangible benefits beyond a rise in the share price.
19.ex_zh: 除股价上升之外还有无形利益。

19.def_en: v. to make a very loud and unpleasant sound
19.ex_en: We were woken by a high, snarling caterwaul, a sort of screaming wail.
19.ex_zh: 我们被一声尖厉的叫声惊醒，那是一种尖声的嚎叫。

19.def_en: v. to muster for a common purpose
19.ex_en: About three thousand people held a rally to mark international human rights day.
19.ex_zh: 大约三千人举行集会以纪念国际人权日。

19.def_en: n. a usually localized act of popular violence in defiance usually of an established government
19.ex_en: Isolated attacks in the north-east of the country have now turned into a full-scale uprising.
19.ex_zh: 该国东北部的零星袭击现在已经演变成为全面暴动。

19.def_en: adj. of or relating to taxation, public revenues, or public debt
19.ex_en: The party was torn apart by wrangles over fiscal policy.
19.ex_zh: 该党内部因为在财政政策上争执不休而出现了分裂。

19.def_en: n. something given up or lost
19.ex_en: He was willing to make any sacrifice for peace.
19.ex_zh: 他愿意为和平作出任何牺牲。

19.def_en: v. to throw into confusion
19.ex_en: The ambassador was clearly discon certed by the British reaction.
19.ex_zh: 显然，英国的反应让这位大使很不安。

19.def_en: (1)adj. not occupied or employed (2)adj. shiftless, lazy
19.def_zh: 不工作的，闲置的；懒散的
19.ex_en: Employees have been idle almost a month because of shortages.
19.ex_zh: 由于原料短缺，员工们已将近一个月无事可做。

19.def_en: v. to break or ignore without hiding what you are doing or showing fear of shame
19.ex_en: No one can flout the law with impunit y.
19.ex_zh: 任何人都不能不受惩罚地藐视法律。

19.def_en: adj. departing markedly from the natural, the expected, or the typical
19.ex_en: The Spanish Steps were crowded with the sellers of grotesque caricatures.
19.ex_zh: 西班牙阶梯上挤满了出售荒诞漫画的人。

19.def_en: (1)v. to exercise continuous sovereign authority over (2)v. to control or guide the actions of
19.ex_en: He accused the opposition party of being unfit to govern.
19.ex_zh: 他指责反对党不适合治理国事。

19.def_en: n. a strong feeling of dislike
