19.ex_zh: 我从未能够消除内心对君主政体的反感。

19.def_en: adj. having or showing an ability to understand things and to make good judgments
19.ex_en: He's a shrewd businessman and hard as nails.
19.ex_zh: 他是一个既精明又铁石心肠的生意人。

19.def_en: n. careful use of money so that it is not wasted
19.ex_en: They were rightly praised for their thrift and enterprise.
19.ex_zh: 他们勤俭节约，积极进取，得到了当之无愧的赞扬。

19.def_en: adj. overly persistent in request or demand
19.ex_en: His victory is an evidence of the power of importunate prayer.
19.ex_zh: 他的胜利说明了强求性祈祷的力量。

19.def_en: (1)v. to follow a winding or intricate course (2)v. to wander aimlessly or casually without urgent destination
19.ex_en: The stream meanders slowly down to the sea.
19.ex_zh: 这条小河弯弯曲曲缓慢地流向大海。

19.def_en: v. show, indicate
19.ex_en: He betrayed nervousness by stammering.
19.ex_zh: 他说话结结巴巴表明他胆子小。

19.def_en: v. to require as an antecedent in logic or fact
19.ex_en: His argument presupposes that it does not matter who is in power.
19.ex_zh: 他的论点前提是谁掌权都无关紧要。

19.def_en: adj. failing to give proper care and attention
19.ex_en: Rumor had it that although Louise lived in a derelict house, he was really very wealthy.
19.ex_zh: 传言说虽然路易斯住在破败的房子里，但他其实很有钱。

19.def_en: adj. extremely interesting
19.ex_en: This intriguing book is both thoughtful and informative.
19.ex_zh: 这本引人入胜的书既有思想性又富知识性。

19.def_en: (1)v. to get value or use form (2)v. to use in a way that helps you unfairly
19.ex_en: The government and its opponents compete to exploit the troubles to their advantage.
19.ex_zh: 政府及其反对派竞相利用这些问题为自己谋利。

19.def_en: v. to disagree politely with another person s statement or suggestion
19.ex_en: If even a few nations demur or cheat, the whole system can break down.
19.ex_zh: 若再有一些国家出现反对或欺骗的情况，那么整个系统都将崩溃。

19.def_en: adj. likely to have or produce good results
19.ex_en: It was not a propitious time to start a new business.
19.ex_zh: 那不是营业开张的吉时佳日。

19.def_en: v. to make rigidly conventional and opposed to change
19.ex_en: It reckons that rationing would ossify the farm industry
19.ex_zh: 人们认为实行配给制会使农业僵化。

19.def_en: v. to criticize harshly
19.ex_en: Marx never lost an opportunity to castigate colonialism.
19.ex_zh: 马克思抓住每一个机会严厉谴责殖民主义。

19.def_en: adj. behaving in a way that shows you think you are better than other people because you are from a higher social class or know more than they do
19.ex_en: They had a snobbish dislike for their intellectual and social inferiors.
19.ex_zh: 他们非常势利，不喜欢智力和社会地位不如自己的人。

19.def_en: (1)adj. gloomy and somber (2)adj. cold and cutting (3)adj. unsheltered and barren
19.ex_en: The weather can be quite bleak on the coast.
19.ex_zh: 沿海地区的天气会非常阴冷。

19.def_en: v. to ask questions or express doubt about
19.ex_en: We queried the bill as it seemed far too high.
19.ex_zh: 账单上的费用似乎太高了，我们对此表示怀疑。

19.def_en: adj. involving or expressing moral approval or disapproval
19.ex_en: The prime minister has a blind spot on ethical issues.
19.ex_zh: 这位首相无视道德问题。

19.def_en: v. to conform, submit, or adapt (as to a regulation or to another's wishes) as required or requested
19.ex_en: The commander said that the army would comply with the ceasefire.
19.ex_zh: 指挥官说军队会遵守停火协议。

19.def_en: adj. full of mystery and difficult to understand
19.ex_en: His reply was highly enigmatic.
19.ex_zh: 他的回答高深莫测。

19.def_en: (1)v. to cause to sleep or rest (2)v. to cause to feel safe and relaxed instead of careful and alert (3)n. a brief time when an action or activity stops
19.ex_en: The rhythm of the boat lulled her to sleep.
19.ex_zh: 小船有节奏的摇动将她送入了梦乡。

19.def_en: adj. showing dislike or opposition
19.ex_en: Cats and mouses are often antagonistic.
19.ex_zh: 猫和老鼠是敌对的。

19.def_en: (1)adj. done or experienced by everyone (2)adj. existing or true at all times or in all places
19.def_zh: 广泛的；普遍适用的，无处不在的
19.ex_en: There are no economic universals.
19.ex_zh: 没有普遍适用的经济学原理。

19.def_en: adj. relating to having a strict and simple way of living that avoids physical pleasure
19.ex_en: He lives an ascetic life.
19.ex_zh: 他过着苦行的生活。

19.def_en: v. to assert without proof or before proving
19.ex_en: The people arguing for an attack on Iran allege that containment is failing.
19.ex_zh: 主张打击伊朗的人断言，遏制政策正走向失败。

19.def_en: n. a method of employing forces in combat
19.ex_en: This was just the latest in a series of delaying tactics .
19.ex_zh: 这只是一系列拖延战术中的一个新花招。

19.def_en: adj. small or narrow in circumference or width in proportion to length or height
19.ex_en: Everybody of us admired her slender figure.
19.ex_zh: 我们人人都羡慕她的苗条身材。

19.def_en: v. to enter or escape through an opening usually by a fault or mistake
19.ex_en: Helium leaking slowly from the balloon.
19.ex_zh: 氦气慢慢地从气球中漏走

19.def_en: adj. hard to understand
19.ex_en: Einstein's theory of relativity is very abstruse.
19.ex_zh: 爱因斯坦的相对论非常难懂。

19.def_en: v. to state or do over again or repeatedly sometimes with wearying effect
19.ex_en: Obama will use a 30-minute speech in Wall Street today to reiterate the need for a fundamental shakeup of the banking sector, three months after he announced proposals for reform. 30
19.ex_zh: 奥巴马今天将在华尔街发表；分钟的演讲，重申对整顿金融部门进行大规模整顿的必要性，这距他上次提出金融改革不过三个月。

19.def_en: (1)adj. required by a law or rule (2)adj. always or often included as a familiar and expected part of something
19.ex_en: It is obligatory for all employees to wear protective clothing.
19.ex_zh: 所有员工必须穿防护服装。

19.def_en: v. to reflect in or as if in a mirror
19.ex_en: The book inevitably mirrors my own interests and experiences.
19.ex_zh: 这本书不可避免地反映出我个人的喜好与经历。

19.def_en: n. the act or an instance of conjoining
19.ex_en: Now this conjunction of an immense military establishment and a large arms industry is new in the American experience.
19.ex_zh: 在美国历史上，这种庞大的军事组织和庞大的军事工业的结合时前所未有的。

19.def_en: v. to hold onto tightly with your hand
19.ex_en: I staggered and had to clutch at a chair for support.
19.ex_zh: 我踉踉跄跄地，不得不抓住一把椅子稳住自己。

19.def_en: n. an element in experience or in artistic representation evoking pity or compassion
19.def_zh: 引起怜悯或同情的元素
19.ex_en: The music is full of pathos.
19.ex_zh: 这首曲子充满了哀伤的情调。

19.def_en: n. an interval of rest or relief
19.ex_en: It was some weeks now since they had had any respite from shellfire.
19.ex_zh: 他们已经好几周没有在炮火中获得任何喘息的机会了。

19.def_en: n. a religious discourse delivered in public usually by a member of the clergy as a part of a worship service
19.ex_en: At High Mass the priest preached a sermon on the devil.
19.ex_zh: 牧师在大弥撒上布道驱邪。

20.def_en: v. to take vengeance for or on behalf of
20.ex_en: He promised to avenge his father's murder.
20.ex_zh: 他发誓要报杀父之仇。

20.def_en: v. to greatly increase the size or amount of
20.ex_en: The president also called on nations to redouble their efforts to negotiate an international trade agreement.
20.ex_zh: 总统还呼吁各国就签订国际贸易协定加倍努力进行磋商。

20.def_en: adj. feeling or expressing humble or regretful pain or sorrow for sins or offenses
20.ex_en: For the sinful but penitent middle,however,there is the option of purgatory a bit of fiery cleansing before they are admitted to eternal bliss.
20.ex_zh: —；然而，对于负罪而有悔过之心的人，还有另外一种选择，即炼狱—在通往永生的天堂之乐前接受稍微激烈一点的净化。

20.def_en: n. the recorded events of one year
20.ex_en: The deed will live forever in the annals of infamy.
20.ex_zh: 这事将永远存在丑行史记载中。

20.def_en: v. to determine or influence the quality or nature of
20.ex_en: Too often we try to mold our children into something they do not wish to be.
20.ex_zh: 我们常常试图把孩子塑造成他们自己不想成为的样子。

20.def_en: adj. feeling a lack of energy or a lack of interest in doing things
20.ex_en: Anything longer will make you lethargic, but a short nap will refresh you.
20.ex_zh: 再睡久一点就会让你感到昏昏沉沉了，但是小睡片刻会让你神清气爽。

20.def_en: adj. lasting a very short time
20.ex_en: These paintings are in some ways a reminder that earthly pleasures are ephemeral.
20.ex_zh: 这些画在某种意义上提醒人们世俗的享乐是短暂的。

20.def_en: n. a setting forth of the meaning or purpose (as of a writing)
20.ex_en: His speech was an exposition of the genesis of the conflict.
20.ex_zh: 他的演讲阐述了冲突的起源。

20.def_en: (1)v. to spend or use up wastefully or foolishly (2)v. to cause to spread thin or scatter and gradually vanish
20.ex_en: The body must dissipate heat as fast as it produces it.
20.ex_zh: 人体散发热量必须和产生热量一样快。

20.def_en: adj. having great volume in proportion to wight
20.ex_en: He struggled out of his bulky jacket and threw it on to the back seat
20.ex_zh: 他费劲脱下他那件笨重的夹克，随手把它扔在后座上。

20.def_en: n. a great disaster
20.ex_en: Driving into Tripoli is to drive into a ghost city, you will feel like wondering in a set for a Hollywood apocalypse film.
20.ex_zh: 车进入的黎波里就好像进入鬼城，仿佛置身好莱坞灾难影片中的场景。

20.def_en: adj. consisting of documents: written down
20.ex_en: Last Sunday I watched a documentary program about Manchester United.
20.ex_zh: 上周日我看了有关曼彻斯特联队的一档纪实节目。

20.def_en: v. to make slow or difficult
20.ex_en: Heavy snow hindered construction work.
20.ex_zh: 大雪阻碍了建筑工程的进展。

20.def_en: v. to provide with a motive
20.ex_en: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
20.ex_zh: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

20.def_en: v. mishandle, botch
20.ex_en: I was afraid you would bungle this assignment but I had no one else to send.
20.ex_zh: 我担心这份工作给你搞砸了，可是我再也派不出别人了

20.def_en: (1)adj. not letting up or weakening in vigor or pace (2)adj. not softening or yielding in determination
20.ex_en: An unrelenting downpour of rain disturbed her.
20.ex_zh: 一场下不停的倾盆大雨让她心烦意乱。

20.def_en: n. a feeling of not wanting to do something
20.ex_en: They are showing a marked disinclin ation to pursue these opportunities.
20.ex_zh: 他们对争取这些机会明显表现出不乐意。

20.def_en: adj. causing laughter especially because of a startlingly or unexpectedly humorous impact
20.ex_en: Her expression is almost comical.
20.ex_zh: 她的表情近乎滑稽。

20.def_en: adj. full of or covered with grime: dirty
20.ex_en: They crept toward the grimy window and looked down.
20.ex_zh: 仍然披着隐形衣，悄悄走到满是污垢的窗前向下张望。

20.def_en: (1)adj. not liking or wanting to give or spend money (2)adj. small in size or amount
20.ex_en: Winston was not a stingy man.
20.ex_zh: 温斯顿不是个小气之人

20.def_en: adj. going beyond what is usual, regular, or customary
20.ex_en: She was a truly extraordinary woman.
20.ex_zh: 她是位非常杰出的女性。

20.def_en: adj. providing amusement or entertainment
20.ex_en: It was a witty and diverting program.
20.ex_zh: 这是个妙趣横生的娱乐节目。

20.def_en: adj. not fully worked out or developed
20.ex_en: It's just a tentative schedule.
20.ex_zh: 仅仅是个试验性的计划。

20.def_en: adj. noticeable in an unpleasant or annoying way
20.ex_en: The sofa would be less obtrusive in a paler color.
20.ex_zh: 沙发的颜色再浅一点就不那么扎眼了。

20.def_en: adj. talking a lot in an energetic and rapid way
20.ex_en: Evelyn was very voluble on the subject of women's rights.
20.ex_zh: 伊夫林谈起女权这个话题口若悬河。

20.def_en: (1)adj. angry or unhappy because of unfair treatment (2)adj. being the opposite of sweet
20.ex_en: Mary is very bitter about losing her job.
20.ex_zh: 玛丽丢掉了工作，心里很不服气。

20.def_en: adj. cannot be achieved or is not available
20.def_zh: 无法获得的，无法达到的
20.ex_en: Man approaches the unattainable truth through a succession of errors.
20.ex_zh: 人们通过不断犯错误接近不可企及的真理。

20.def_en: adv. up to this or that time
20.ex_en: The polytechnics have hitherto been at an unfair disadvantage in competing for pupils and money.
20.ex_zh: 到目前为止，理工专科学校在争取生源和资金方面一直处于劣势。

20.def_en: adj. cruel, severe
20.ex_en: There has been an overall growth in population, despite some draconian efforts to contain it. ,
20.ex_zh: 尽管有严厉的遏制措施；人口还是在全面增长。

20.def_en: v. to mislead the mind or judgment of
20.ex_en: He had been unwittingly deluded by their mystical nonsense.
20.ex_zh: 他不知不觉被他们故弄玄虚的胡说八道给骗了。

20.def_en: adj. heartbreaking
20.ex_en: Time dulls the most exquisite emotions and softens the most heartrending grief. .
20.ex_zh: 时间会缓和最激烈的情感，减轻最伤心的悲痛

20.def_en: v. to give or assume the appearance or effect of often with the intent to deceive
20.ex_en: I tried to simulate surprise at the news.
20.ex_zh: 听到这个消息后，我竭力装出一副吃惊的样子。

20.def_en: n. basis
20.ex_en: Honesty is the bedrock of any healthy relationship.
20.ex_zh: 诚实是维持一切良好关系的基础。

20.def_en: n. good-natured and usually witty and animated joking
20.ex_en: The soldiers bantered with him as though he was a kid brother.
20.ex_zh: 士兵们把他当作弟弟一样和他开着玩笑。

20.def_en: v. to drink a large amount of quickly
20.ex_en: He's quaffed many a glass of champagne in his time.
20.ex_zh: 他年轻时曾经开怀畅饮过不少香槟美酒。

20.def_en: n. descendants, children
20.ex_en: He was surrounded by his numerous progeny.
20.ex_zh: 众多的子孙簇拥着他。

20.def_en: n. someone or something that provides help or an advantage
20.ex_en: An anonymous benefactor stepped in to provide the prize money.
20.ex_zh: 一位匿名捐助者施以援手提供了奖金。

20.def_en: (1)n. someone or something that makes action or progress slower or more difficult (2)v. to pull (someone or something that is heavy or difficult to move)
20.ex_en: Larry was turning out to be a drag on her career.
20.ex_zh: 拉里最后成了她事业上的累赘。

20.def_en: v. to impute guilt to
20.ex_en: Someone placed the pistol in your room in order to inculpate you.
20.ex_zh: 有人把手枪放在你房间里是为了指控你。

20.def_en: v. to persist in a state, enterprise, or undertaking in spite of counterinfluences, opposition, or discouragement
20.ex_en: But we need to continue to strive, to learn from other countries and persevere.
20.ex_zh: 然而，我们也必须力争上游，借鉴其他国家的经验，学习他们不屈不挠的精神。

20.def_en: v. to hold supported or suspended without motion in a steady position
20.ex_en: She tried her best to poise herself.
20.ex_zh: 她尽全力使身体保持平衡。

20.def_en: (1)n. an action that is taken or an order that is given to force a country to obey international laws by limiting or stopping trade with that country, by not allowing economic aid for that country, etc. (2)v. to officially accept or allow
20.ex_en: He expressed his opposition to the lifting of sanctions.
20.ex_zh: 他对解除制裁表示反对。

20.def_en: adj. producing little or no vegetation
20.ex_en: He also wants to use the water to irrigate barren desert land.
20.ex_zh: 他也想用这些水灌溉荒漠。

20.def_en: adj. not able to be explained or understand
20.ex_en: His behavior was extraordinary and inexplicable... ,
20.ex_zh: 他的行为不同寻常；让人费解。

20.def_en: n. slant, bias
20.ex_en: The table is at a slight tilt.
20.ex_zh: 这桌子有点儿歪。

20.def_en: n. one who is legally appointed to transact business on another's behalf
20.ex_en: He needed to consult with an attorney
20.ex_zh: 他需要找个律师咨询一下。

20.def_en: n. a manner or the content of thinking characteristic of an individual, group, or culture
20.ex_en: Such an approach accords with the principles of socialist ideology.
20.ex_zh: 这种方法与社会主义意识形态的原则相符。

20.def_en: adj. impossible to understand
20.ex_en: He found his son's actions totally incomprehensible.
20.ex_zh: 他发现自己对儿子的行为完全无法理解。

20.def_en: n. a harsh rebuke
20.ex_en: I cant't accept such an unwarranted objurgation.
20.ex_zh: 我不会接受这样一种莫须有的责备。

20.def_en: adj. obvious and noticeable
20.ex_en: The tension in the room was almost palpable.
20.ex_zh: 屋子里的紧张气氛几乎能感觉到。

20.def_en: adj. sunk to or existing in a low state or condition
20.ex_en: Both of them died in abject poverty.
20.ex_zh: 他们两人都于穷困潦倒中死去。

20.def_en: adj. feeling or showing a lack of courage or confidence
20.ex_en: A timid child, Isabella had learned obedience at an early age.
20.ex_zh: 伊莎贝拉是一个羞怯的孩子，很小就学会了顺从。

20.def_en: v. repeat, imitate
20.ex_en: Their views often echo each other.
20.ex_zh: 他们常常你唱我和。

20.def_en: n. weariness or exhaustion from labor, exertion, or stress
20.ex_en: Winter weather can leave you feeling fatigued and tired.
20.ex_zh: 冬季会让人感觉疲乏无力。

20.def_en: n. something that indicates or fixes a limit or extent
20.ex_en: The boundaries between history and storytelling are always being blurred and muddled.
20.ex_zh: 历史和轶闻的分界向来是模糊而混乱的。

20.def_en: v. engage in sycophancy
20.ex_en: They came backstage afterward, cooing and toadying to him.
20.ex_zh: 她们随后来到后台，对他娇语谄媚。

20.def_en: v. to make usually small adjustments in or to
20.ex_en: He expects the system to get even better as the engineers tweak its performance.
20.ex_zh: 他预计在工程师对其性能稍加改进后，该系统会运行得更加良好。

20.def_en: n. the state or quality of being inexperienced or unsophisticated
20.ex_en: How foolish I was in treating such a profoundly important matter with such simple-minded naiveté.
20.ex_zh: 当时的我是多麽地愚蠢，竟然把这麽深远重大的事情，想得那麽天真。

20.def_en: n. someone who knows a lot about many different things
20.ex_en: Mr English, an associate editor of the Guardian, is a polymath who wears his learning lightly.
20.ex_zh: 英格力士先生是《卫报》的副编辑，是一位略显才华的博学者。

20.def_en: adj. happening at the correct or most useful time
20.ex_en: This has been a timely reminder to us all.
20.ex_zh: 对我们大家来说这个提醒非常及时。

20.def_en: adj. grandiloquent
20.ex_en: Before that oxymoron was a technical term describing a rhetorical device. oxymoron
20.ex_zh: 在此之前，；是一个技术术语，用来描述一种夸张的装置。

20.def_en: adj. marked by compact precise expression without wasted words
20.ex_en: The book gives an admirably succinct account of the technology and its history.
20.ex_zh: 这本书对该项技术及其历史作了极其简明的叙述。

20.def_en: n. a statement in which you express too much pride in yourself or in something you have, have done, or are connected to in some way
20.ex_en: Carol boasted about her costume.
20.ex_zh: 卡萝尔炫耀着自己的穿着打扮。

20.def_en: adj. covering completely or broadly
20.ex_en: The Rough Guide to Nepal is a com prehensive guide to the region.
20.ex_zh: 《尼泊尔概况》是一本全面介绍该地区的旅游指南。

20.def_en: n. a tactic intended to embarrass or frustrate an opponent
20.ex_en: Christmas should be a time of excitement and wonder, not a cynical marketing ploy.
20.ex_zh: 圣诞节应该是兴奋和美妙的时刻，而不该是一种肆无忌惮的营销策略。

20.def_en: adj. satisfied with how things are and not wanting to change them
20.ex_en: We must not become complacent about progress.
20.ex_zh: 我们决不能因进步变得自满。

20.def_en: adj. significantly serious
20.ex_en: Anxiously, she examined his unusually grave face.
20.ex_zh: 她忐忑不安地审视着他异常严肃的脸色。

20.def_en: v. put up with
20.ex_en: I could never stomach the cruelty involved in the wounding of animals.
20.ex_zh: 我永远都无法忍受伤害动物时的那种残忍。

20.def_en: adj. not based on facts or proof
20.ex_en: The allegations were totally unfounded.
20.ex_zh: 这些指控完全没有事实根据。

20.def_en: v. to give or leave by will
20.ex_en: He bequeathed all his money to his children after death.
20.ex_zh: 他死后把所有的钱都留给了孩子。

20.def_en: v. to permit as a right, privilege, or favor
20.ex_en: France has agreed to grant him political asylum.
20.ex_zh: 法国已经同意给予他政治避难。

20.def_en: (1)v. by please by or as if by attention or concern (2)v. relieve, alleviate
20.ex_en: It did not take long for the central bank to soothe investors' fears.
20.ex_zh: 中央银行很快便平息了投资者的担忧。

20.def_en: (1)n. a large number of harmful or annoying things (2)v. to cause constant or repeated trouble, illness, etc.
20.def_zh: 让人讨厌的东西；困扰，纠缠
20.ex_en: She was plagued by weakness, fatigue, and dizziness.
20.ex_zh: 她被虚弱、疲劳和眩晕折磨。

20.def_en: (1)n. a strong written or spoken attack against someone else s opinions, beliefs, practices, etc. (2)n. the art or practice of using language to defend or harshly criticize something or someone
20.def_zh: ’；猛烈抨击；态度鲜明（支持或者批评）
20.ex_en: The book is both a history and a passionate polemic for tolerance.
20.ex_zh: 这本书既是一段历史，也是一篇主张宽容的激情论辩。

20.def_en: adj. tawdrily and falsely attractive
20.ex_en: Advertisements convey an impression, however meretricious, of the importance of the goods being sold.
20.ex_zh: 商业广告尽管华而不实，却能使人对正在销售的商品的重要性留有印象。

20.def_en: adj. producing money or wealth
20.ex_en: She has a lucrative business selling leather goods. ,
20.ex_zh: 她做皮货生意；利润丰厚。

20.def_en: (1) adj. complete and total (2) adj. not limited in any way
20.ex_en: Mankind are the only beings who may be said to have gained an absolute control over the production of food.
20.ex_zh: 一切生物之中，只有人类达到了完全控制食物生产的地步。

20.def_en: (1)n. something that prevents people from acting freely (2)v. to put shackles on
20.ex_en: The trade unions are shackled by the law.
20.ex_zh: 工会受法律的制约。

20.def_en: v. to deviate from the truth
20.ex_en: British ministers continued to prevaricate.
20.ex_zh: 英国的大臣们仍然闪烁其词。

20.def_en: v. confuse, perplex
20.ex_en: masses of detail.
20.ex_zh: 不要拿一大堆琐事把我搞迷糊。

20.def_en: (1)v. to take a child of other parents legally as your own child (2)v. to begin to use or have
20.ex_en: The council is expected to adopt the new policy at its next meeting.
20.ex_zh: 委员会有望在下次会议上正式通过这项新政策。

20.def_en: adj. delayed beyond the usual time
20.ex_en: I'm sorry for this belated translation.
20.ex_zh: 对于这篇迟来的翻译，我很抱歉。

20.def_en: adj. not important
20.ex_en: I know it sounds trivial, but I'm worried about it.
20.ex_zh: 我知道这事听起来微不足道，但我还是放心不下

20.def_en: n. a person who spends improvidently or wastefully
20.ex_en: My mother warned me about marrying a spendthrift.
20.ex_zh: 我妈妈告诫我，不要与挥霍无度的人结婚。

20.def_en: adj. inflated
20.ex_en: The reporting of the hostage story was fair, if sometimes overblown.
20.ex_zh: 尽管这篇关于人质的报道有些夸大其词，但还算公正。

20.def_en: v. to make furious
20.ex_en: Their insults infuriated him.
20.ex_zh: 他们的侮辱激怒了他。

20.def_en: adj. having or showing sound judgment
20.ex_en: Far from being a dreamer, she's a level-headed pragmatist.
20.ex_zh: 她是个头脑冷静的务实派，绝不是一个不切实际的人。

20.def_en: (1)n. a statement saying that you are sorry about something (2)n. something that is said or written to defend something that other people criticize
20.ex_en: Union officials made no apologies for the threatened chaos.
20.ex_zh: 工会干部们对于迫在眉睫的混乱局面不予道歉。

20.def_en: v. to reduce or cause to contract
20.ex_en: The chancellor was forced to deflate the economy still further.
20.ex_zh: 财政大臣被迫更进一步紧缩经济。

20.def_en: adj. convinced of one's own righteousness especially in contrast with the actions and beliefs of others
20.ex_en: He is critical of the monks, whom he considers narrow-minded and self- righteous.
20.ex_zh: 他对僧侣们颇有微词，认为他们思想偏狭，自视清高。

20.def_en: adj. happening very soon
20.ex_en: The black clouds show that a storm is imminent.
20.ex_zh: 乌云预示暴风雨即将来临。

20.def_en: n. an alteration designed to correct or improve
20.ex_en: Chief editor finally accepted the textual emendations made by associate chief editor.
20.ex_zh: 主编最终接受了副编辑的修订文稿。

20.def_en: adj. based on testing or experience
20.ex_en: More than ever, economics today is an empirical discipline.
20.ex_zh: 如今，经济学比以往任何时候都是一门实证学科。

20.def_en: (1)v. to try to keep from happening (2)v. to kill by depriving of air
20.ex_en: She summoned up all her pity for him, to smother her self-pity.
20.ex_zh: 她抑制着心中的自怜，将满腔的怜悯之情都倾注在了他的身上。

20.def_en: adj. existing from the time someone is born
20.ex_en: It is clear that the ability to smile is inborn.
20.ex_zh: 显然，笑的能力是与生俱来的。

20.def_en: adj. strikingly, excitingly, or mysteriously different or unusual
20.def_zh: 外来的，异国风情的（含褒义）
20.ex_en: The chorus is given oriental coloring by the use of exotic instruments.
20.ex_zh: 使用外来乐器给合唱增添了东方色彩。

20.def_en: adj. of, relating to, or characteristic of a person inflexibly attached toa practice or theory
20.ex_en: He is not a doctrinaire socialist.
20.ex_zh: 他不是一个教条的社会主义者。

20.def_en: v. to cause great damage or harm to
20.ex_en: A few days before, a fire had devast ated large parts of Windsor Castle.
20.ex_zh: 几天前，温莎城堡的大部分被一场大火烧毁。

20.def_en: n. a small amount of something
20.ex_en: Even the film's impressive finale can't hide the first hour's paucity of imagination.
20.ex_zh: 这部电影的结局可圈可点，即使这样也无法掩盖前一个小时想象力贫乏的缺憾。

20.def_en: adj. exciting horror
20.ex_en: A government split would have dire c onsequences for domestic peace.
20.ex_zh: 政府的分裂将会给国内和平带来严重后果。

20.def_en: adj. done or used when necessary
20.ex_en: Magistrates were given wider discret ionary powers.
20.ex_zh: 地方法官被赋予了更广泛的自由决定权。

20.def_en: v. to discover or notice the presence of
20.ex_en: Arnold could detect a certain sadnes s in the old man's face.
20.ex_zh: 阿诺德能觉察到老人脸上的一丝悲伤。

20.def_en: adj. separated from other people or cultures
20.ex_en: Having lived in one place all his life, his views are insular.
20.ex_zh: 他一辈子住在一个地方，所以思想狭隘。

20.def_en: adj. rude and showing a lack of respect
20.ex_en: I don't like strangers who ask impertinent questions.
20.ex_zh: 我不喜欢冒昧提问的陌生人。

20.def_en: (1)v. to make as small as possible ... (2)v. to treat or describe as smaller or less important than it is
20.ex_en: Concerned people want to minimize the risk of developing cancer.
20.ex_zh: 相关人员希望尽可能降低罹癌风险。

21.def_en: v. to keep separate from something unpleasant, dangerous, etc.
21.ex_en: Is there any way we can insulate our home from the noise?
21.ex_zh: 有什么办法可以使我们的住宅隔音吗？

21.def_en: n. the reason or explanation for something
21.ex_en: However, the rationale for such initiatives is not, of course, solely economic.
21.ex_zh: 然而，这种提议的根据当然并不仅仅是经济方面的。

21.def_en: v. to begin
21.ex_en: The academic year commences at t he beginning of October. 10
21.ex_zh: 学年于；月初开始。

21.def_en: n. a predicament affording no obvious escape
21.ex_en: The proposal offered both sides a way out of the diplomatic impasse.
21.ex_zh: 这一提议使双方都能摆脫外交僵局。

21.def_en: adj. feeling or showing doubt about doing something: not willing or eager to do something
21.ex_en: Scientific institutions have been reluctant to take corrective action.
21.ex_zh: 科学机构一直不愿作出更正。

21.def_en: (1)v. to leave and never return to (2)v. to give over unrestrainedly
21.ex_en: The scheme's investors, fearful of bankruptcy, decided to abandon the project.
21.ex_zh: 因为担心破产，该计划的投资者决定放弃这个项目。

21.def_en: n. a change or a set of changes that corrects or improves something
21.ex_en: The phase of writing that is actually most important is revision.
21.ex_zh: 实际上写作过程中最重要的阶段是修改。

21.def_en: v. to get ahead of
21.ex_en: He can outstrip his friend both in sports and in studies.
21.ex_zh: 他能在体育和学习方面胜过他的朋友。

21.def_en: adj. working very hard
21.ex_en: The Chinese are industrious.
21.ex_zh: 中国人是勤劳的。

21.def_en: n. an emotion variously combining dread, veneration, and wonder that is inspired by authority or by the sacred or sublime
21.ex_en: While Diana was in awe of her grandfather, she adored her grandmother.
21.ex_zh: 黛安娜敬畏她的祖父，但敬佩她的祖母。

21.def_en: adj. strongly critical or condemnatory
21.ex_en: This was a dreadful crime and a severe sentence is necessary.
21.ex_zh: 这一罪行十分恶劣，必须要重判。

21.def_en: n. a disease or illness
21.ex_en: He tried the baths there for an internal malady.
21.ex_zh: 他到那儿洗温泉对他的内科病进行浴疗。

21.def_en: v. to place in a very strong position that cannot easily be changed
21.ex_en: These dictators have entrenched the mselves politically and are difficult to move.
21.ex_zh: 这些独裁者在政治上已经站稳了脚跟，很难推翻他们。

21.def_en: v. to make worse
21.ex_en: It may even compound the problem t hat it purports to solve and encourage parents to reveal still less.
21.ex_zh: 该提议的执行甚至有可能加重其原本要解决的问题，促使父母们更加隐瞒孩子的身世。

21.def_en: n. a formal inquiry into or discussion of a subject
21.ex_en: Built on the significant findings of the disquisition , this thesis raises some correlative and effective suggestions.
21.ex_zh: 据研究得出的相关结论，本文提出了有效的相关政策建议。

21.def_en: adj. acting in a silly or funny way
21.ex_en: The antics of wildebeests are often clownish and entertaining.
21.ex_zh: 姿态古怪的牛羚常常叫人忍俊不禁。

21.def_en: v. to stop fighting an enemy or opponent
21.ex_en: In less than two hours Cohen capitulated to virtually every demand.
21.ex_zh: 还不到两个小时，科恩就投降了，接受了几乎一切要求。

21.def_en: v. to shape a soft substance by pressing or rolling it or by putting it into a mould
21.ex_en: Using 2 spoons, mould the cheese mixture into small balls or ovals.
21.ex_zh: 用两把小匙将奶酪混合物塑成圆球或椭圆球形状。

21.def_en: adj. fashionable, stylish
21.ex_en: She is always crazy at modish things.
21.ex_zh: 她疯狂热爱流行物品。

21.def_en: n. symbol, emblem
21.ex_en: Black is a token of mourning.
21.ex_zh: 黑衣是居丧的表征。

21.def_en: n. the quality or state of being equal or equivalent
21.ex_en: Women have yet to achieve wage or occupational parity in many fields.
21.ex_zh: 女性在很多领域还没能争取到薪金、职位方面的平等。

21.def_en: (1)v. to talk or act with noisy swaggering threats (2)n. loud, arrogant speech, often full of empty threats
21.ex_en: The lady simply ignored his bluster as empty rhetoric.
21.ex_zh: 那位女士把他的咆哮只当作虚张声势的言词而不予理睬。

21.def_en: n. someone who does not specialize in a particular area, activity, field of research, etc.
21.ex_en: The nonspecialist will be able to obtain at least a notion of the sorts of data and argument that support evolutionary theory.
21.ex_zh: 非专业人士至少可以了解支持进化论的各种数据和观点。

21.def_en: v. to officially require (something)
21.ex_en: He'd been mandated by the West African Economic Community to go in and to enforce a ceasefire
21.ex_zh: 他受西非经济共同体的命令介入并执行停火协定。

21.def_en: n. an undoubted or self- evident truth
21.ex_en: Whilst this might sound like a truism, it is nevertheless a crucial problem to address.
21.ex_zh: 尽管这可能听起来像是老生常谈，但却是待解决的重要问题。

21.def_en: n. something that clothes or adorns
21.ex_en: This shop sells sports apparel.
21.ex_zh: 这家商店卖运动服。

21.def_en: n. something used to slow down or stop movement or activity
21.ex_en: She braked sharply to avoid another car.
21.ex_zh: 她为了躲另一辆车而紧急刹车。

21.def_en: (1)v. to state or declare positively and often forcefully or aggressively (2)v. the demonstrate the existence of
21.ex_en: The defendants, who continue to assert their innocence, are expected to appeal.
21.ex_zh: 各被告仍然宣称自己无辜，并会提起上诉。

21.def_en: n. a rapid expansion or increase
21.ex_en: Living standards improved rapidly during the post-war boom.
21.ex_zh: 在战后那段繁荣昌盛的时期里，生活水平得到了迅速提高。

21.def_en: v. to file or collect in or as if in an archive
21.ex_en: This vast archive has been indexed and made accessible to researchers.
21.ex_zh: 这个存量巨大的档案室的所有文件都已编了索引，可供研究人员使用。

21.def_en: n. a person who argues for or supports something
21.ex_en: Halsey was identified as a leading proponent of the values of progressive education.
21.ex_zh: 哈尔西被认为是进步教育价值观的主要拥护者。

21.def_en: n. the quality or state of someone or something that will never die or be forgotten
21.ex_en: The flame is a quasi-religious emblem of immortality.
21.ex_zh: 火焰可以算作不朽的宗教象征。

21.def_en: (1)adj. lamentable (2)adj. deserving censure or contempt
21.ex_en: The judge said that discrimination against homosexuals is deplorable.
21.ex_zh: 法官说对同性恋者的歧视应予以谴责。

21.def_en: v. to assail vigorously or persistently
21.ex_en: The town has been heavily bombarded by the army backed by the airforce.
21.ex_zh: 该镇遭到了有空军掩护的陆军部队的猛烈攻击。

21.def_en: v. to gain favor or favorable acceptance for by deliberate effort
21.ex_en: He did his best to ingratiate himself with the royal family.
21.ex_zh: 他竭力向王室献媚。

21.def_en: (1)v. to claim to be or do a particular thing when this claim may not be true (2)n. the main or general meaning of something
21.ex_en: His plans are not what they purport to be.
21.ex_zh: 他的计划并不如他们所声称的那样。

21.def_en: adj. in favor of using peaceful and diplomatic methods to achieve something, rather than using force and violence
21.ex_en: The defense minister is a little bit more dovish than other people in the ruling elite.
21.ex_zh: 国防大臣比上层统治集团中其他成员都要温和。

21.def_en: n. a ruler who exercises absolute power oppressively or brutally
21.ex_en: Since 1804 the country has mostly been ruled by tyrants. 1804
21.ex_zh: 自；年以来，该国大部分时间都处于暴君的统治之下。

21.def_en: n. a terrible disaster
21.ex_en: From all points of view, war would be a catastrophe.
21.ex_zh: 不管从哪方面说，战争都将是场灾难。

21.def_en: adj. consisting of many different small parts
21.ex_en: Any action on the basis of such fragmentary evidence would be foolish.
21.ex_zh: 基于如此不完整的证据采取的任何行动都是愚蠢的。

21.def_en: v. to cause to feel angry or irritated especially for a long time
21.ex_en: Their refusal to sell the country arms in 1937 still rankled with him. 1937
21.ex_zh: 他们在；年拒绝向该国出售武器一事仍然令他愤愤不平。

21.def_en: n. an irrational abject attitude of mind toward the supernatural, nature, or God resulting from superstition
21.ex_en: According to superstition, breaking a mirror brings bad luck.
21.ex_zh: 按照迷信的说法，摔碎镜子会带来噩运。

21.def_en: v. to destroy completely
21.ex_en: An atomic bomb can annihilate a city.
21.ex_zh: 一枚原子弹能毁灭一个城市。

21.def_en: n. a feeling of weariness and dissatisfaction
21.ex_en: He decided to take up a hobby to relieve the ennui of ret irement.
21.ex_zh: 他决定养成一种嗜好以消除退休后的无聊。

21.def_en: v. to refrain deliberately and often with an effort of self-denial from an action or practice
21.ex_en: His doctor ordered him to abstain from beer and wine.
21.ex_zh: 他的医生嘱咐他戒酒。

21.def_en: adj. of, relating to, or occurring in the night
21.ex_en: When there is a full moon, this nocturnal rodent is careful to stay in its burrow.
21.ex_zh: 月圆之夜，这种夜间活动的啮齿类动物会小心地呆在地洞里不出来。

21.def_en: v. to take something away from
21.ex_en: This law will deprive us of our most b asic rights.
21.ex_zh: 这条法律将剥夺我们最基本的权利。

21.def_en: v. to feel astonishment or perplexity at or about
21.ex_en: We all marveled at his success.
21.ex_zh: 我们对他的成功感到惊奇。

21.def_en: adj. boring and too slow or long
21.ex_en: The journey soon became tedious.
21.ex_zh: 那次旅行不久就变得乏味起来。

21.def_en: n. the people who have the most wealth and status in a society
21.ex_en: A tiny, educated elite profited from th e misery of their two million fellow countrymen. 200
21.ex_zh: 一小撮受过良好教育的精英分子从他们；万同胞的贫苦生活中获取利益。

21.def_en: n. competition
21.ex_en: In this way, it effectively shut out all price rivalry.
21.ex_zh: 用这种方法有效地排斥了一切价格竞争。

21.def_en: adj. telling private information about a person s life
21.ex_en: Their first album was painfully frank to the point of being confessional.
21.ex_zh: 他们的第一张专辑是那么的坦率，近乎自白。

21.def_en: v. to discourage
21.ex_en: But the reality of these formidable ch allenges should not dishearten us.
21.ex_zh: 但是，这些巨大挑战的现实不应使我们心灰意冷。

21.def_en: adj. using too many words
21.ex_en: Her writing style is tediously prolix.
21.ex_zh: 她写的文章冗长而乏味。

21.def_en: adj. consisting of two parts
21.ex_en: The machine does the calculations in binary.
21.ex_zh: 这台机器采用二进制进行计算。

21.def_en: adj. if you describe something as unwarranted, you are critical of it because there is no need or reason for it
21.ex_en: He accused the police of using unwarranted brutality.
21.ex_zh: 他指控警方无端施暴。

21.def_en: n. a state in which you feel excited or very alert
21.ex_en: This type of rumination and agitation ignites stress hormones that keep us in a state of perpetual arousal.
21.ex_zh: 这类沉思和忧虑激发压迫性荷尔蒙，使我们处在一种永久的唤醒状态。

21.def_en: v. to make young or youthful again: give new vigor to
21.ex_en: Shelley was advised that the Italian climate would rejuvenate him...
21.ex_zh: 有人建议雪莱去意大利，那里的天气会使他恢复活力。

21.def_en: adj. eminent beyond comparison
21.ex_en: All this fully demonstrates the incomparable superiority of the socialist system.
21.ex_zh: 这一切充分显示了社会主义制度的无比优越。

21.def_en: n. a method of writing rapidly by substituting characters, abbreviations, or symbols for letters, sounds, words, or phrases
21.ex_en: Ben took notes in shorthand.
21.ex_zh: 本用速记法记笔记。

21.def_en: adj. causing or related to a great complete change
21.ex_en: Invented in 1951, the rotary engine is a revolutionary concept in internal combustion. 1951
21.ex_zh: 年发明的旋转引擎是内燃领域的一个革命性观念。

21.def_en: v. to go through very carefully in order to find something useful or valuable
21.ex_en: Sift out the wheat from the chaff.
21.ex_zh: 把小麦的壳筛出来。

21.def_en: (1)v. to make dark or to become dark or darker in color (2)v. to make less happy or to become less happy
21.ex_en: The sky darkened abruptly.
21.ex_zh: 天突然暗了下来。

21.def_en: adj. not bound by formal rules, procedures, or guidelines
21.def_zh: 随心所欲的，自由放纵的
21.ex_en: He has given up his freewheeling lifestyle to settle down with his baby daughter.
21.ex_zh: 他放弃了自由放纵的生活方式，和幼小的女儿安顿下来。

21.def_en: adj. acting to defeat its own purpose
21.ex_en: Paying children too much attention when they misbehave can be self- defeating.
21.ex_zh: 孩子有不良行为时，小题大做可能适得其反。

21.def_en: (1)n. someone or something that comes before another (2)n. a sign of something that is going to happen
21.ex_en: Dr. Sun Yat-sen was the forerunner of Chinese revolution.
21.ex_zh: 孙中山先生是中国革命的先行者。

21.def_en: (1)adj. impermeable to air or nearly so (2)adj. having no noticeable weakness, flaw or loophole
21.ex_en: Store the peppercorns in an airtight container and grind the pepper as you need it.
21.ex_zh: 将胡椒粒储存在密封容器中，在需要的时候磨成粉。

21.def_en: n. the act of making atonement
21.ex_en: Jesus made expiation for our sins on the cross.
21.ex_zh: 耶稣在十字架上为我们赎了罪。

21.def_en: v. to keep secret
21.ex_en: Robert could not conceal his relief.
21.ex_zh: 罗伯特无法掩饰自己如释重负的心情。

21.def_en: v. to make more violent, bitter, or severe
21.ex_en: Utter waste, together with inefficient use of water reserves exacerbate the crisis.
21.ex_zh: 浪费加水资源的非有效利用更加加剧了水危机。

21.def_en: (1)n. the study of ideas about knowledge, truth, the nature and meaning of life, etc. (2)n. a set of ideas about how to do something or how to live
21.ex_en: Annie's work reflects her philosophy that life is full of mysteries.
21.ex_zh: 安妮的作品反映了她的人生哲学，即生活充满神秘色彩。

21.def_en: adj. having a mysterious, holy, or spiritual quality adj. supernatural, mysterious
21.def_zh: 神圣的；超自然的，神秘的
21.ex_en: They led me to a numinous place on that day.
21.ex_zh: 那天他们领着我去了一个神秘的地方。

21.def_en: n. a convinced adherent of a school or individual
21.ex_en: He was an ardent disciple of Gandhi.
21.ex_zh: 他是甘地的忠实信徒。

21.def_en: adj. having or marked by great volume or bulk
21.ex_en: The FBI kept a voluminous file on Pablo Picasso. ·
21.ex_zh: 联邦调查局保存了有关巴勃罗；毕加索的大量档案。

21.def_en: v. to play or act so as to impress onlookers
21.ex_en: The grandstand play caught attention of the crowd just as they were leaving.
21.ex_zh: 就在观众正要离场的时候，那个吸引人的表演引起了他们的注意。

21.def_en: v. to appease by indulging to the full
21.ex_en: Nothing could sate the careerist's greed for power.
21.ex_zh: 什么也满足不了这个野心家的权力欲。

21.def_en: v. to supply or fill with people
21.ex_en: Grass's novels are peopled with outlandish characters.
21.ex_zh: 格拉斯的小说里都是些稀奇古怪的人物。

21.def_en: adj. easily frightened or excited
21.ex_en: The declining dollar gave heart to skittish investors.
21.ex_zh: 美元的衰落给总是担惊受怕的投资者们带来了信心。

21.def_en: n. a person's relatives
21.ex_en: I sent my other son to the country to stay with kinfolk.
21.ex_zh: 我把另一个儿子送到乡下和亲戚住在一起。

21.def_en: v. to break apart into many small parts or pieces
21.ex_en: During October 1918 the Austro- Hungarian Empire began to disintegr ate. 1918 10
21.ex_zh: 在；年；月间，奥匈帝国开始瓦解。

21.def_en: adj. not new or original
21.ex_en: A lot of what you see in stand- up comedy today is very derivative.
21.ex_zh: 如今人们看到的单人喜剧表演好多内容都是沿袭前人。

21.def_en: adj. very large or great
21.ex_en: There has been a colossal waste of public money.
21.ex_zh: 一直存在巨大的公款浪费。

21.def_en: n. a prying observer who is usually seeking the sordid or the scandalous
21.ex_en: A voyeur was seen lurking around the girl's dormitory. .
21.ex_zh: 有人看到一位偷窥狂躲藏在女生宿舍附近

21.def_en: v. to exhibit especially in an attractive or favorable aspect
21.ex_en: Restored films are being showcased this month at a festival in Paris.
21.ex_zh: 本月的巴黎电影节将展映一些修复版的电影。

21.def_en: adj. very small or unimportant
21.ex_en: His suggestion is always considered as negligible to her.
21.ex_zh: 对她而言，他的建议总是微不足道的。

21.def_en: adj. very surprising, shocking, or frightening
21.ex_en: Sometimes the results may be rather startling.
21.ex_zh: 有时结果可能会令人吃惊。

21.def_en: n. a sudden change or disturbance that affects a country, organization, etc.
21.ex_en: The country was in ruin and convulsion.
21.ex_zh: 这个国家没落于动乱之中。

21.def_en: n. a state of agreement
21.ex_en: They expressed the hope that he wo uld pursue a neutral and balanced p olicy for the sake of national concord.
21.ex_zh: 他们希望，为了国家的和谐，他会奉行中立、不偏不倚的政策。

21.def_en: adj. of or relating to money
21.ex_en: She denies obtaining a pecuniary advantage by deception.
21.ex_zh: 她否认通过欺骗手段获得经济利益。

21.def_en: n. the ability to see what will or might happen in the future
21.ex_en: They had the foresight to invest in new technology.
21.ex_zh: 他们有投资新技术的远见。

21.def_en: v. to take the place of by or as if by force
21.ex_en: The Congress wants to reverse the reforms and usurp the power of the presidency.
21.ex_zh: 议会企图颠覆改革，夺取总统权力。

21.def_en: n. the quality of seeming real
21.ex_en: To add verisimilitude, the stage is covered with sand for the desert scenes.
21.ex_zh: 为了更加逼真，舞台上铺满了沙子作为沙漠的场景。

21.def_en: adj. having a loud resonant metallic sound
21.ex_en: Based on reasons mentioned above, the artist endows the work with such the clangorous and glorious title.
21.ex_zh: 这幅作品基于上述理念而拥有了这个响亮而充满光辉的名字。

21.def_en: (1)n. an amount of money that is used for a special purpose (2)v. to provide money for
21.ex_en: The Bush Foundation has funded a variety of faculty development programs.
21.ex_zh: 布什基金会已经资助了许多教员发展项目。

21.def_en: adj. expressing harsh or sharp criticism in a clever way
21.ex_en: The playwright allows an acerbic tone to pierce through arid or flowery prose.
21.ex_zh: 剧作家允许在枯燥或华丽的散文中插入刻薄的语调。

21.def_en: v. to describe as unimportant, weak, bad, etc.
21.ex_en: Do not disparage anyone's contributi on.
21.ex_zh: 不要贬低任何人的贡献。

21.def_en: (1)adj. possessing or characterized by life (2)v. to give spirit and support
21.ex_en: We are animate beings, living creatures.
21.ex_zh: 我们是有生命的存在，有生命的动物。

21.def_en: adj. not eating and drinking too much
21.ex_en: Already someone trying to live well would seem eccentrically abstemious in most of the US.
21.ex_zh: 美国大部分地方，那些尝试过简朴生活的人，已经看起来象怪物了。

21.def_en: adj. easily moved to often unreasonable or excessive anger
21.ex_en: He was affable at one moment, choleric the next.
21.ex_zh: 他时而友善和蔼，时而暴躁易怒。

21.def_en: (1)v. to produce an effect upon (2)v. to make a display of liking or using (3)v. to put on a pretense of
21.ex_en: Poor housing and family stress can affect both physical and mental health.
21.ex_zh: 住房条件差、家庭压力大会影响身心两方面的健康。

21.def_en: adj. no longer used by anyone
21.ex_en: With technological changes many traditional skills have become obsolete.
21.ex_zh: 随着技术的革新，许多传统技艺已被淘汰。

21.def_en: adj. composed of elements drawn from various sources
21.ex_en: There are more and more anecdotal examples of an eclectic art taste dev eloping in the Asian region.
21.ex_zh: 来越多的逸闻例证表明，兼收并蓄的艺术品味已在亚洲地区逐渐显现出来。

21.def_en: (1)v. to associate as a member (2)n. an organization that is a member of a larger organization
21.ex_en: Our New York company has an affiliate in Los Angeles.
21.ex_zh: 我们的纽约公司在洛杉矶有一个下属企业。

21.def_en: adj. continuing or following without interruption
21.ex_en: The noise of bombs and guns was incessant.
21.ex_zh: 炸弹和枪炮接连不断。

21.def_en: adj. of the nature of a paradox
21.ex_en: Some sedatives produce the paradoxical effect of making the person more anxious.
21.ex_zh: 一些镇静剂产生出使人更紧张这样自相矛盾的结果。

22.def_en: (1)adj. having a huge appetite (2)adj. excessively eager
22.ex_en: Joseph Smith was a voracious book collector. ·
22.ex_zh: 约瑟夫；史密斯是个如饥似渴的藏书家。

22.def_en: v. to assume or affirm the existence of
22.ex_en: Several writers have posited the idea of a universal consciousness.
22.ex_zh: 有几个作者都假设存在普遍意识。

22.def_en: adj. not likely to upset or embarrass other people

23.def_en: adj. appealing to the emotions: sensational

23.ex_zh: 他戏剧化的夸张架势使她忍不住想笑。

23.def_en: adj. not feeling or showing emotions such as affection or kindness
23.ex_en: She's hard-boiled, tough and funny.
23.ex_zh: 她冷峻、坚韧而风趣。

23.def_en: (1)v. to ask for something in a serious way (2)n. a quality that causes people to like someone or something
23.ex_en: The United Nations has appealed for help from the international community.
23.ex_zh: 联合国已经呼吁国际社会提供援助。

23.def_en: adj. having great magnitude, force, or power
23.ex_en: The earth buckled under the titanic stress.
23.ex_zh: 在巨大的压力下，地面下陷了。

23.def_en: n. a small amount
23.ex_en: They should win, given a modicum of luck.
23.ex_zh: 只要有一点点运气，他们就会赢。

23.def_en: adj. lasting for only a short time
23.ex_en: Each moment in history is a fleeting t ime, precious and unique.
23.ex_zh: 历史上的每一刻都是飞逝的时光，珍贵而独特。

23.def_en: n. strength or force gained by motion or by a series of events
23.ex_en: They began to lose momentum in the second half of the game.
23.ex_zh: 在比赛的下半场，他们的势头就逐渐减弱。

23.def_en: (1)v. to weaken or destroy gradually (2)v. to slowly break apart and destroy through a chemical process
23.ex_en: Engineers found the structure had b een corroded by moisture.
23.ex_zh: 工程师们发现该建筑已经受潮腐蚀。

23.def_en: v. to reverse in position, order, or relationship
23.ex_en: The cook inverted the cake onto a serving plate.
23.ex_zh: 厨师把蛋糕倒扣过来放到一个盘子上。

23.def_en: adj. serious, boring, or old- fashioned
23.ex_en: Her thoughts were staid and solemnly adapted to a condition. , .
23.ex_zh: 她的思想已经定形；安于一板一眼地顺应现实

23.def_en: n. amazement or dismay that hinders or throws into confusion
23.ex_en: As the ball hurtles through the air, the varying air flow around it can send it on unexpected paths, to the consternation of many soccer players.
23.ex_zh: 当球在空中疾驰时，球表面变化多样的气流可以将它送往意料之外的路径，让许多足球运动员惊愕不已。

23.def_en: adj. coming before and usually forming a necessary prelude to something else
23.ex_en: A preliminary analysis of regional components was conducted for the Bombus fauna of this Province.
23.ex_zh: 另外，作者对该地区的熊蜂区系成分进行了初步的分析。

23.def_en: (1)adj. having worldwide rather than limited or provincial scope or bearing (2)adj. composed of persons, constituents or elements from all or many parts of the world
23.ex_en: The family are rich, and extremely s ophisticated and cosmopolitan.
23.ex_zh: 这家人很富有，老于世故，而且见多识广。

23.def_en: adj. fit for or used for the growing of crops
23.ex_en: The soil proved too infertile to sustain real pasture or arable crops.
23.ex_zh: 这土壤被证明太贫瘠，不能真正用作放牧或耕种作物。

23.def_en: n. an overwrought expression of concern or guilt
23.ex_en: There's also been much hand- wringing over ballooning mortgage debt. .
23.ex_zh: 不断膨胀的抵押贷款债务也令人坐立不安

23.def_en: n. a feeling of doubt or suspicion especially concerning a future event
23.ex_en: She had some misgivings about what she was about to do.
23.ex_zh: 她对自己要做的事有些疑虑。

23.def_en: adj. looking rather plain or ordinary
23.ex_en: We eventually located the cottage- tucked away behind an unprepossessing row of shops.
23.ex_zh: 我们终于找到了那座小屋，它隐藏在一排不引人注目的店铺后面。

23.def_en: (1)v. to cause to happen quickly or suddenly (2)n. a solid substance that is separated from al liquid especially by a chemical process (3)adj. happening very quickly or too quickly without enough thought or planning
23.def_zh: 引发，加速；沉淀；冲动的，鲁莽的
23.ex_en: A slight mistake could precipitate a disaster.
23.ex_zh: 小错误可能会招致大灾难。

23.def_en: v. to give support or encouragement to
23.ex_en: Bryan Sutton seconded the motion against fox hunting. ·
23.ex_zh: 布赖恩；萨顿赞同反对猎狐动议。

23.def_en: n. a hackneyed theme, characterization or situation
23.ex_en: Stay away from stock and cliche ans wers if you want to leave a lasting im pression on your interviewer.
23.ex_zh: 如果你想给面试官留下深刻的印象，就要避免那些陈腐，陈词滥调的回答。

23.def_en: adj. not important
23.ex_en: Seemingly inconsequential details can sometimes contain significant clues.
23.ex_zh: 貌似无足轻重的细节有时可能隐含着重大的线索。

23.def_en: n. an outward sign
23.ex_en: Only occasionally did the telltale redness around his eyes betray the fatigue he was suffering.
23.ex_zh: 只有从他发红的眼圈上偶尔能看出他非常疲惫。

23.def_en: n. a source of danger
23.ex_en: A new report suggests that chewing- gum may be a health hazard.
23.ex_zh: 一份新报告指出，口香糖可能对健康有害。

23.def_en: adj. extremely good
23.ex_en: What a terrific idea!
23.ex_zh: 多么好的主意！

23.def_en: (1)n. something that is very special, important, or valuable (2)v. to value very much
23.ex_en: She treasures her memories of those joyous days.
23.ex_zh: 她珍视那段快乐时光的记忆。

23.def_en: v. to close up or block off
23.ex_en: The tourniquet should occlude venous and lymphatic return. .
23.ex_zh: 止血带应阻断静脉及淋巴回流

23.def_en: v. to establish by proof or competent evidence
23.ex_en: There is little scientific evidence to substantiate the claims.
23.ex_zh: 这些主张几乎找不到科学依据来证实。

23.def_en: adj. not decreasing or becoming weaker
23.ex_en: His unflagging enthusiasm was an inspiration for all of us.
23.ex_zh: 他经久不衰的热情鼓舞了我们所有人。

23.def_en: adj. made to be useful rather than to be decorative or comfortable
23.ex_en: This basic utilitarian model gives a relatively unsophisticated account of human behavior.
23.ex_zh: 这个实用的基础模型较为简略地解释了人类的行为。

23.def_en: n. the quality or state of being faithful
23.ex_en: He believed in marital fidelity.
23.ex_zh: 他认为婚内应该忠诚。

23.def_en: adj. willing to do dishonest things in return for money
23.ex_en: A venal moving-van company had revealed her address.
23.ex_zh: 一家唯利是图的搬运汽车公司还是把她的住址泄露了。

23.def_en: adj. of the same mind or habit of thought
23.ex_en: Some like-minded people got together and set up a group.
23.ex_zh: 一些志趣相投的人聚在一起，成立了一个小组。

23.def_en: n. a feigning to be what one is not or to believe what one does not
23.ex_en: He called it 'rank hypocrisy' that the government was now promoting equal rights.
23.ex_zh: 他把目前政府提倡平等权利的举措称为“彻头彻尾的伪善”。

23.def_en: v. to overwhelm with shock, surprise, or wonder
23.ex_en: He is flabbergast when he hears that his friend has been accused of murder.
23.ex_zh: 他听说朋友被控谋杀罪，大吃一惊。

23.def_en: n. a general agreement about something
23.ex_en: There seems to be a consensus that the plan should be rejected.
23.ex_zh: 看来人们一致同意放弃这一计划。

23.def_en: (1)adj. in good health (2)adj. free from mistakes (3)adj. solid and strong
23.ex_en: I am not sure that this is sound democratic practice.
23.ex_zh: 我不能肯定这是正确的民主行为。

23.def_en: n. the quality or state of being accurate and correct
23.ex_en: They cannot determine their optimum price and output with neat exactitude.
23.ex_zh: 他们不能精确无误地知道最优价格和产量。

23.def_en: n. one inclined to raise or excite alarms especially needlessly
23.ex_en: The senator is just a scaremonger, his political act won't realistically result in changed behavior.
23.ex_zh: 这名议员仅仅是个危言耸听者，他的政治举措并不能解决实际问题。

23.def_en: v. to reach its highest altitude
23.ex_en: In just a few days, a century- long struggle will culminate in a histo ric vote.
23.ex_zh: 几天之后，在历史性的投票中，长达一个世纪的努力即将达到高潮

23.def_en: (1)adj. basic or simple (2)adj. not very developed or advanced
23.ex_en: They are deprived of the ability to exercise the most rudimentary workers' rights.
23.ex_zh: 他们被剥夺了行使最基本的工人权利的资格。

23.def_en: adj. arranged or organized in a logical or regular way
23.ex_en: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
23.ex_zh: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

23.def_en: (1)v. to weaken or destroy the effect of (2)v. to show or prove to be false or incorrect
23.ex_en: An official decree invalidated the vote in the capital.
23.ex_zh: 一项官方法令使首都的投票失去了效力。

23.def_en: v. to draw back or in
23.ex_en: They tried to persuade me to retract my words.
23.ex_zh: 他们试图说服我收回我的话。

23.def_en: adj. affording a general view of a whole
23.ex_en: There are many vortex patterns on synoptic maps.
23.ex_zh: 摘要天气图上有许多种涡旋型式。

23.def_en: adj. willing to believe that other people are good and honest
23.ex_en: Perhaps I was too trusting.
23.ex_zh: 也许我太轻信了。

23.def_en: (1)v. to reach above or beyond (2)v. to try to do more than you have the power, ability, or money to do
23.def_zh: 过度伸张；试图做力不所及的事
23.ex_en: In making these promises, the company had clearly overreached itself.
23.ex_zh: 这家公司作出这些承诺，显然是不自量力。

23.def_en: v. to frustrate the progress or efforts of
23.ex_en: John is stumped by an unexpected question.
23.ex_zh: 一个意想不到的问题把约翰难住了。

23.def_en: n. loyalty to a person, group, etc.
23.ex_en: They owed fealty to the Earl rather than the King.
23.ex_zh: 与其说他们应效忠国王，还不如说他们该效忠伯爵。

23.def_en: (1)v. to check or go counter to (2)v. to occur or develop as a consequence
23.ex_en: Austria has sent three army battalions to its border with Hungary to stem the flow of illegal immigrants. 3
23.ex_zh: 奥地利已派出；个营的兵力去本国和匈牙利交界的边境地区阻止非法移民的流入。

23.def_en: (1)v. to impede or stop the development of (2)v. to stop the respiration of
23.ex_en: The governor's proposals would actually cost millions of jobs and suffocate the economy.
23.ex_zh: 总督的计划可能会造成上百万人失业，并抑制经济发展。

23.def_en: n. something that is joined or added to another thing but is not an essential part of it
23.ex_en: The Party was certainly not an official adjunct of the police department.
23.ex_zh: 该党派肯定不是公安部门的官方附属机构。

23.def_en: adj. having the characteristics of a platitude
23.ex_en: The whole speech was platitudinous nonsense.
23.ex_zh: 整篇讲话都是陈谷子烂芝麻。

23.def_en: adj. cruel, savage
23.ex_en: Custer was an idiot and a brute and he deserved his fate.
23.ex_zh: 卡斯特是个愚蠢而粗暴的人，他应该有这样的下场。

23.def_en: adj. big and very impressive
23.ex_en: This grand building lies in the center of town.
23.ex_zh: 这幢宏伟建筑位于市中心。

23.def_en: adj. not having or providing enough of what is needed
23.ex_en: He decided there was insufficient evidence to justify criminal proceedings...
23.ex_zh: 他认定证据不充分无法提起刑事诉讼。

23.def_en: adj. not confined, limited, or impeded
23.ex_en: When his schoolmate made the last goal, the boy gave out with an untrammeled yell.
23.ex_zh: 那个男孩在他的同学踢进最后一球时不禁纵声欢呼。

23.def_en: (1)n. a loss of power, success, popularity, etc. (2)v. to make less important or popular
23.ex_en: The gramophone had been eclipsed by new technology such as the compact disc.
23.ex_zh: 激光唱片等新技术使留声机黯然失色。

23.def_en: v. to disturb the quiet of
23.ex_en: Remove the bowl from the ice and stir in the cream.
23.ex_zh: 从冰里把碗取出，搅入奶油。

23.def_en: adj. not wanting or willing to do something
23.ex_en: He was loath to admit his mistake.
23.ex_zh: 他不愿承认自己的错误。

23.def_en: adj. lacking proper respect or seriousness
23.ex_en: He now dismisses that as a flippant comment.
23.ex_zh: 他现在把那当作轻率的随口一说不再理会了。

23.def_en: n. freedom of action or choice
23.ex_en: He would be given every latitude in forming a new government.
23.ex_zh: 他将被给予高度自由来建立一个新政府。

23.def_en: adj. similar in some way
23.ex_en: The relationship of a teacher and his students is analogous to that of a director and the actors.
23.ex_zh: 老师和学生之间的关系就像导演和演员之间的关系。

23.def_en: adj. impossible to see or notice
23.ex_en: The slight change in the taste was imperceptible to most people.
23.ex_zh: 这种味道的细微变化对大多数人而言是无法觉察的。

23.def_en: v. to breathe out
23.ex_en: She exhaled the smoke through her nose.
23.ex_zh: 她从鼻子里喷出烟雾。

23.def_en: (1) n. a comment or remark (2) n. something you notice by watching and listening (3) n. an act or instance of observing a custom, rule, or law
23.ex_en: In hospital she'll be under observation all the time. 24
23.ex_zh: 医院会对她；小时密切观察。

23.def_en: adj. of, relating to, or resembling a labyrinth
23.ex_en: The streets of the Old City are narrow and labyrinthine.
23.ex_zh: 老城区的街道狭促曲折，好似迷宫一般。

23.def_en: v. to make a sudden, unsteady movement forward or sideways
23.ex_en: As the car sped over a pothole she lurched forward.
23.ex_zh: 车子飞驶过一个坑洼时，她身子猛地向前一倾。

23.def_en: v. inveigle
23.ex_en: She inveigles Paco into a plot to swindle Tania out of her savings.
23.ex_zh: 她引诱帕科一起合谋来骗取塔妮娅的积蓄。

23.def_en: adj. having a good or helpful result especially after something unpleasant has happened
23.ex_en: The team's defeat is a salutary warning before the World Cup. .
23.ex_zh: 这次失利是在世界杯比赛之前对整个队的一个有益警示

23.def_en: adj. involving two people or two sides who oppose each other
23.ex_en: There is almost an adversarial feeling between businesses and consumers.
23.ex_zh: 在商家和消费者之间几乎产生了一种敌对的情绪。

23.def_en: n. the process or result of being slowly destroyed by natural precesses
23.ex_en: The bodies buried in the fine ash slo wly decayed.
23.ex_zh: 埋在灰烬里的尸体慢慢地腐烂了。

23.def_en: adj. harshly and haughtily arrogant
23.ex_en: He's so overbearing that no one wants to work for him.
23.ex_zh: 他那么专横，没人愿为他工作。

23.def_en: adj. easily broken or destroyed
23.ex_en: The fragile economies of several southern African nations could be irreparably damaged.
23.ex_zh: 一些南非国家的脆弱经济可能会被彻底破坏，无法挽回。

23.def_en: v. to rescind or annul by authoritative act
23.ex_en: Many voted for the repeal of that property law.
23.ex_zh: 许多人投票赞成废止那项财产法。

23.def_en: adj. lacking conviction: half-hearted
23.ex_en: The study received a lukewarm response from the Home Secretary.
23.ex_zh: 内政大臣对这项研究反应不是很热烈。

23.def_en: adj. causing great fear
23.ex_en: I still find it terrifying to find myself surrounded by large numbers of horses
23.ex_zh: 我仍旧觉得被一大群马包围很可怕。

23.def_en: v. to feel or show deep respect for
23.ex_en: My father venerated General Eisenhower.
23.ex_zh: 我父亲十分敬仰艾森豪威尔将军。

23.def_en: (1)n. morally good behavior or character (2)n. a commendable quality or courage
23.ex_en: His virtue is patience.
23.ex_zh: 耐心是他的美德。

23.def_en: adj. fawning, obsequious
23.ex_en: We heard the sound of sycophantic laughter.
23.ex_zh: 我们听到了谄媚的笑声。

23.def_en: v. to steal things that are not very valuable or to steal a small amount of something
23.ex_en: When food stores close, they go to work, pilfering food for resale on the black market.
23.ex_zh: 食品店关门后，他们就行动起来，偷食品拿到黑市上出售。

23.def_en: adj. doing something that has not been done before
23.ex_en: The school has won awards for its pioneering work with the community.
23.ex_zh: 该校因与社区开创性合作而获奖。

23.def_en: adj. of or relating to the countryside or to the lives of people who live in the country
23.ex_en: We watched from the train window as the pastoral landscapes of Burgundy unfolded.
23.ex_zh: 透过火车车窗，勃艮第的乡村风光展示在我们眼前。

23.def_en: adj. involving two or more academic, scientific, or artistic disciplines
23.ex_en: We will have an interdisciplinary educational infrastructure in order to create and disseminate knowledge.
23.ex_zh: 我们将有一个跨学科的教育基础设施，以创造和传播知识。

23.def_en: adj. lacking sharpness or quickness of sensibility or intellect
23.ex_en: I've really been very obtuse and stupid.
23.ex_zh: 我实在笨得不可理喻。

23.def_en: adj. not proud or haughty
23.ex_en: He gave a great performance, but he was very humble.
23.ex_zh: 他的表演非常出色，但他却很谦虚。

23.def_en: n. insulting or contemptuous action or speech
23.ex_en: This action makes a mockery of the Government's continuing protestations of concern.
23.ex_zh: 这一行动是对一再声明表示关注的政府的嘲弄。

23.def_en: adj. not fresh or original
23.ex_en: The movie is teeming with obvious and trite ideas.
23.ex_zh: 这部电影充满着明显而陈腐的观点。

23.def_en: v. to no longer have any hope or belief that a situation will improve or change
23.ex_en: He does despair at much of the pres s criticism.
23.ex_zh: 面对媒体的诸多批评他的确感到绝望。

23.def_en: v. to make glorious by bestowing honor, praise, or admiration
23.ex_en: Singing hymns is one of the ways to glorify God.
23.ex_zh: 唱圣歌是赞美上帝的一种方式。

23.def_en: n. movement away from a place or situation especially because it is dangerous, unpleasant, etc.
23.ex_en: The army was forced to retreat after suffering heavy losses.
23.ex_zh: 部队因伤亡惨重被迫撤退。

23.def_en: v. imprison
23.ex_en: He was immured in a dark room.
23.ex_zh: 他被禁闭在一间暗室中。

23.def_en: adj. carefully noticing problems or signs of danger
23.ex_en: The dog kept a vigilant guard over the house.
23.ex_zh: 这只狗警醒地守护着这所房屋。

23.def_en: v. to throw out especially by physical force, authority, or influence
23.ex_en: Officials used guard dogs to eject th e protesters.
23.ex_zh: 官员们用警犬驱散抗议人群。

23.def_en: adj. not forming a necessary part of something
23.ex_en: We ought not to bring in extraneous matters in trying to find a basis for a settlement.
23.ex_zh: 我们努力寻求解决问题的基础时，不应该牵扯进无关的事情。

23.def_en: adj. having a gradual and cumulative effect
23.ex_en: They focus on overt discrimination rather than insidious aspects of racism.
23.ex_zh: 他们关注的是公开的歧视，而不是种族主义的一些潜在问题。

23.def_en: v. to make lucid especially by explanation or analysis
23.ex_en: Haig went on to elucidate his person al principle of war.
23.ex_zh: 海格继续解释他个人的战争原则。

23.def_en: v. to restore to a former state
23.ex_en: Considerable efforts have been made to rehabilitate patients who have suffered in this way.
23.ex_zh: 为使受这种苦的病人康复已经付出了相当大的努力。

23.def_en: adj. friendly and easy to talk to
23.ex_en: My boss is affable enough when she is not preoccupied with business problems.
23.ex_zh: 我的老板不忙于公事的时候还是和蔼可亲的。

23.def_en: adj. occurring, appearing, or changing at usually irregular intervals
23.ex_en: My memories of childhood are hazy and episodic.
23.ex_zh: 我儿时的回忆是一些朦朦胧胧的松散片段。

23.def_en: adj. having or showing a slow and stolid temperament
23.ex_en: Her phlegmatic response itself is now a driver in this financial crisis, and people will rightly blame her for any serious accident.
23.ex_zh: 默克尔冷漠反应的本身，如今就是此次金融危机的舵手，如果出现重大事故，人们责备她也理所应当。

23.def_en: n. a group of retainers or attendants
23.ex_en: Mind trainers are now part of a tennis star's retinue.
23.ex_zh: 现在，网球明星的随行人员中有些是心理培训师。

23.def_en: adj. very complicated and difficult to understand
23.ex_en: Despite its length and convoluted plo t, Asta's Book is a rich and rewardin g read.
23.ex_zh: 虽然篇幅很长，而且情节复杂，但是《阿斯塔的书》仍不失为一部内容丰富、值得一读的作品。

23.def_en: adj. done in haste without regard for consequences
23.ex_en: On stage she seems hard, brash and uncompromising. ,
23.ex_zh: 在舞台上；她显得冷酷、自以为是而且不妥协。

23.def_en: v. to change to an opposite state or condition
23.ex_en: Because the normal word order is reversed in passive sentences, they are sometimes hard to follow.
23.ex_zh: 由于正常语序在被动句中被颠倒过来了，所以有时很难理解。

23.def_en: adj. involving or having information that disagrees with other information
23.ex_en: The contradictory statements are sy mptoms of disarray in the administra tion.
23.ex_zh: 这些互相矛盾的说法反映了管理的混乱。

24.def_en: v. to make unclear or difficult to see or remember
24.ex_en: The writing blurred and danced before his eyes.
24.ex_zh: 字迹变得一片模糊，在他眼前晃动。

24.def_en: n. a scheming or crafty action or artful design intended to accomplish some usually evil end
24.ex_en: They are attempting to counter o enemy's machination.
24.ex_zh: 他们在试图反击敌人的阴谋。

24.def_en: v. to praise highly
24.ex_en: They kept extolling my managerial s kills.
24.ex_zh: 他们不停地赞美我的管理技能。

24.def_en: adv. absolutely
24.ex_en: Staff are often discourteous and sometimes downright rude.
24.ex_zh: 职员常常态度很不礼貌，有时候极其蛮横。

24.def_en: n. the place or point of entering or beginning
24.ex_en: He stopped at the threshold of the bedroom.
24.ex_zh: 他在卧室门口停住了。

24.def_en: v. to abuse or censure severely or abusively
24.ex_en: Human is not God. God is reasoning, human isn't, human would rather vituperate than reasoning. , ,
24.ex_zh: 人不是上帝；上帝是讲道理的；人更易通过谩骂的方式而不是讲道理。

24.def_en: adj. having or showing a desire to cause harm to someone
24.ex_en: These are not necessarily hateful, malicious people.
24.ex_zh: 这些人不一定心怀仇恨，恶意伤人。

24.def_en: adj. in the past
24.ex_en: Erstwhile workers may have become managers.
24.ex_zh: 过去的工人可能已经成了经理。

24.def_en: (1)v. to relate to someone or something (2)v. to belong as a part, member, accessory or product
24.ex_en: His remark did not pertain to the question.
24.ex_zh: 他的话同这个问题不相干。

24.def_en: adj. appealing to or expressing emotion
24.ex_en: These comparisons are emotive rather than analytic.
24.ex_zh: 这些比较带有个人感情色彩，而不是客观分析。

24.def_en: v. to set apart
24.ex_en: This jury is expected to be sequestered for at least two months.
24.ex_zh: 预计这个陪审团将至少被隔离两个月。

24.def_en: adj. of or relating to an enemy
24.ex_en: The West has gradually relaxed its hostile attitude to this influential state.
24.ex_zh: 西方对这个颇具影响力的国家的敌视态度已逐渐缓和。

24.def_en: adj. characterized by firmness or obduracy
24.ex_en: The authorities proved unyielding on one crucial opposition demand.
24.ex_zh: 面对反对党这一重大诉求，当局立场坚定。

24.def_en: n.
24.ex_en: Mr. Grandet is a profitmonger, all he cares is money, not his family.
24.ex_zh: 葛朗台先生是个唯利是图的人，他只关心钱，而不是他的家人。

24.def_en: n. the belief that your country, race, etc., is better than any other
24.ex_en: It may also appeal to the latent chauvinism of many ordinary people.
24.ex_zh: 它可能也迎合了许多普通人心中的沙文主义情结。

24.def_en: v. to use or change in a skillful way or for a particular purpose
24.ex_en: The technology uses a pen to manipulate a computer.
24.ex_zh: 这项技术使用笔来操控计算机。

24.def_en: v. to check by or as if by pressure
24.ex_en: People who repress their emotions risk having nightmares...
24.ex_zh: 压抑情感的人容易做噩梦。

24.def_en: adj. having superior weight, force, or influence
24.ex_en: This is still a possible outcome but no longer the preponderant probability.
24.ex_zh: 这仍是一个可能的结果，但不再具有占优势的可能性。

24.def_en: adj. likely to betray trust
24.ex_en: He publicly left the party and denounced its treacherous leaders...
24.ex_zh: 他公开脱离该党，并谴责该党领袖背信弃义。

24.def_en: n. the right of voting
24.ex_en: He was an advocate of universal suffrage as a basis for social equality.
24.ex_zh: 他提倡普选权，认为这是社会公平的基础。

24.def_en: n. a crown of laurel awarded as an honor
24.ex_en: she has rightly won laurels for this brilliantly perceptive novel.
24.ex_zh: 她因为这部极具洞悉力的小说无愧地赢得了荣誉。

24.def_en: adj. having or resulting from a weak character or nature
24.ex_en: He regarded the young man as feckless and irresponsible.
24.ex_zh: 他认为这个年轻人不光无能，还不负责任。

24.def_en: adj. having many different parts
24.ex_en: Critical reflection is a multifaceted construct requiring a multifaceted approach. ,
24.ex_zh: 批判性思考是一个多面向的建构；需要多面向的方法。

24.def_en: v. to make timid or fearful
24.ex_en: Jones had set out to intimidate and dominate Paul.
24.ex_zh: 琼斯开始恐吓并控制保罗。

24.def_en: adj. limited to only the things that affect your local area
24.ex_en: He is rather too parochial in his outlook.
24.ex_zh: 他的眼界未免过於狭隘了。

24.def_en: (1)adj. used, made, or sold only by the particular person or company that has the legal right to do so (2)adj. kept private by an owner
24.ex_en: We had to take action to protect the proprietary technology.
24.ex_zh: 我们必须采取措施保护专利技术。

24.def_en: n. to form an opinion or to make an estimate about something from known facts
24.ex_en: We have extrapolated these results from research done in other countries.
24.ex_zh: 我们从其他国家所作的研究中推断出这些结果。

24.def_en: v. to give life and energy to
24.ex_en: Take a deep breath in to invigorate you.
24.ex_zh: 深吸一口气来提提神。

24.def_en: adj. energetic, quick
24.ex_en: Taking a brisk walk can often induce a feeling of well-being.
24.ex_zh: 轻快的散步经常能使人心旷神怡。

24.def_en: adj. free of encumbrance
24.ex_en: Unencumbered capital would flow to its most productive use, boosting economic growth and improving welfare.
24.ex_zh: 不受阻碍的资本将流向其运用效率最高的地方，结果促进经济增长并提高整体福利。

24.def_en: v. to feed on growing herbage, attached algae, or phytoplankton
24.ex_en: There were cows grazing beside the river.
24.ex_zh: 有些牛在河边吃草。

24.def_en: n. characteristic or habitual inclination or mode of emotional response
24.ex_en: His impulsive temperament regularly got him into difficulties...
24.ex_zh: 他容易冲动，经常因此惹麻烦。

24.def_en: (1)adj. relating to or involving general ideas or qualities rather than specific people, objects, or actions (2)adj. difficult to understand (3)n. a brief written statement of the main points or facts in a longer report, speech, etc. (4)v. to obtain or remove from a source (5)v. to draw away the attentionof
24.def_zh: 笼统的；抽象的，深奥的；摘要；提取；分散注意力
24.ex_en: His painting went through both representational and abstract periods.
24.ex_zh: 他的绘画经历了具象风格和抽象风格两个阶段。

24.def_en: n. passive assent or agreement without protest
24.ex_en: Mike claimed that he did it under the acquiescence of his boss.
24.ex_zh: 迈克声称他是在上司的默许下做这件事的。

24.def_en: adj. insulting to someone or something
24.ex_en: I agree I am ambitious, and I don't see that as a pejorative term
24.ex_zh: 。我承认我有野心，但我不认为这是个贬义词。

24.def_en: v. engross, absorb
24.ex_en: Don't immerse yourself in the infliction too long.
24.ex_zh: 不要长时间沉浸在痛苦经历中。

24.def_en: adj. existing or accepted for the present time but likely to be changed
24.ex_en: If you have never held a driving licence before, you should apply for a provisional licence.
24.ex_zh: 如果你从未有过驾照，那就应该申请一个临时的驾照。

24.def_en: n. exclusive ownership through legal privilege, command of supply, or concerted action
24.ex_en: In the past central government had a monopoly on television broadcasting.
24.ex_zh: 过去，中央政府对电视节目播放实行垄断。

24.def_en: adj. not capable of bing mistaken or misunderstood
24.ex_en: Black clouds are an unmistakable sign of coming rain.
24.ex_zh: 乌云是下雨的明显先兆。

24.def_en: adj. free from fault or error
24.ex_en: She had impeccable taste in clothes.
24.ex_zh: 她的穿衣品位无可挑剔。

24.def_en: v. subdue completely
24.ex_en: He tried to vanquish his fears. .
24.ex_zh: 他努力克服恐惧心理

24.def_en: v. to avoid being stopped by
24.ex_en: They found a way of circumventing the law.
24.ex_zh: 他们找到了规避法律的途径。

24.def_en: v. to make stronger or more secure
24.ex_en: Chile is ready to work with China to further consolidate and develop bilateral comprehensive cooperative partnership.
24.ex_zh: 智利愿同中国一道，进一步巩固和发展两国全面合作伙伴关系。

24.def_en: adj. extremely light, delicate, or tenuous
24.ex_en: When you think about silk, you probably think of gossamer fibers woven into lustrous garments.
24.ex_zh: 当你想到丝绸的时候，你可能想到是那些织成华丽服饰的薄纱。

24.def_en: adj. recurrence in an organism of a trait or character typical of an ancestral form and usually due to genetic recombination
24.ex_en: We all have an atavistic fear of snakes.
24.ex_zh: 我们都有对蛇的原始恐惧。

24.def_en: v. to understand in a particular way
24.ex_en: What may seem helpful behavior to you can be construed as interference by others.
24.ex_zh: 在你看来似乎是施助的行为在别人眼中可能就会被解读成一种干涉。

24.def_en: (1)adj. refusing to change your ideas or to stop doing something (2)adj. difficult to deal with, remove, etc.
24.ex_en: He is a stubborn character used to getting his own way.
24.ex_zh: 他性格固执，惯于一意孤行。

24.def_en: adj. willing to end a disagreement with someone
24.ex_en: They approached the talks in a conci liatory spirit.
24.ex_zh: 他们抱一种和解的态度去参加谈判。

24.def_en: n. a state of wild disorder
24.ex_en: It's difficult to winnow out the truth amidst this welter of confusing signals.
24.ex_zh: 在杂乱无章的信号之中，要辨别真相很困难。

24.def_en: adj. forming or relating to the most important part of something
24.ex_en: But on this question, the two leaders have very fundamental differences.
24.ex_zh: 但在这个问题上，两位领导人有着根本性的分歧。

24.def_en: (1)v. to learn so that it is fully understood and can be used (2)v. to make similar
24.ex_en: French Jews generally had been assimilated into the nation's culture.
24.ex_zh: 法裔犹太人已经大体上被这个国家的文化同化了。

24.def_en: v. to bring to view, attention, or use again
24.ex_en: It is said that this medicine can resurrect the dead.
24.ex_zh: 据说这种药能起死回生。

24.def_en: v. to shorten in duration or extent
24.ex_en: Book publisher may alter or abridge a work with the permission of the copyright owner. ,
24.ex_zh: 图书出版者经作者许可；可以对作品修改、删减。

24.def_en: adj. hard to understand, explain, or deal with
24.ex_en: The problem is not as complicated a s he imagined.
24.ex_zh: 问题没他想像的那么复杂。

24.def_en: n. an expression or mode of expression that occurs in ordinary speech rather than formal writing
24.ex_en: Most of these new sermons were recorded in literary Sanskrit rather than in vernacular language.
24.ex_zh: 这些新的布道稿本大部分是用书面梵语而不是方言记载的。

24.def_en: adj. approaching death
24.ex_en: Imperialism is monopolistic, parasitic and moribund capitalism.
24.ex_zh: 帝国主义是垄断的、寄生的、垂死的资本主义。

24.def_en: n. the performance of a lawful action in an illegal or improper manner
24.ex_en: The wisdom of the common law's stress on the crucial distinction between misfeasance and nonfeasance.
24.ex_zh: 普通法的智慧在于，它重点强调了违法行为与消极不行为之间的区别。

24.def_en: v. to call by a distinctive title, epithet, or nickname
24.ex_en: He should be dubbed Sir Hubert.
24.ex_zh: 他应被授予休伯特爵士称号。

24.def_en: n. a difference especially between things that should be the same
24.ex_en: Several explanations spring to mind for the discrepancy between perceived opportunities and actual behavior.
24.ex_zh: 有些理由可以解释理想的机会和现实的行为之间存在的矛盾。

24.def_en: v. to avoid especially because you do not think it is right, proper, etc.
24.ex_en: A wise person eschews bad company.
24.ex_zh: 聪明人远避恶友。

24.def_en: adj. widely and unfavorably known
24.ex_en: The lawyer has defended some of the most notorious criminals.
24.ex_zh: 这名法官已为一些最臭名昭著的罪犯当过辩护律师。

24.def_en: v. to have an intense desire
24.ex_en: I've always had a yen to travel around the world.
24.ex_zh: 我一直非常渴望周游世界。

24.def_en: adj. of or relating to a judgment, the function of judging, the administration of justice, or the judiciary
24.ex_en: Hearing the case in open court is only one part of the judicial process.
24.ex_zh: 公开审理这一案件只是司法程序的一部分。

24.def_en: adj. happy and lively in a way that is attractive
24.ex_en: The vivacious girl made a good cheer-leader.
24.ex_zh: 这个活泼的女孩做了啦啦队队长。

24.def_en: adj. making it easy, possible, or likely for something to happen or exist ...
24.ex_en: Fresh air is conducive to health.
24.ex_zh: 新鲜空气有利于健康。

24.def_en: adj. impervious to external influence
24.ex_en: The hermetic seal on the packet means that the food lasts longer.
24.ex_zh: 封袋上的密封印表明食物能保存更长的时间。

24.def_en: adj. existing or valid in equity as distinguished from law
24.ex_en: He has urged them to come to an equitable compromise that gives Hughes his proper due.
24.ex_zh: 他已敦促他们达成公平合理的妥协，给休斯应得的权益。

24.def_en: v. to represent falsely
24.ex_en: The charges against him include fra ud, bribery, and falsifying business r ecords.
24.ex_zh: 对他的指控包括诈骗、行贿和伪造商业记录。

24.def_en: v. to come together to form one group or mass
24.ex_en: Cities, if unrestricted, tend to coalesce into bigger and bigger conurbations.
24.ex_zh: 如果不加限制，城市往往会联合发展成越来越大的集合城市。

24.def_en: adj. capable of continuing or renewing oneself indefinitely
24.ex_en: Revenge leads to a self-perpetuating cycle of violence.
24.ex_zh: 怨怨相报会导致永不休止的暴力。

24.def_en: v. to oppose directly and stubbornly
24.ex_en: He wants to be the tough rebel who bucks the system.
24.ex_zh: 他想成为抵制体制的强硬叛逆者。

24.def_en: adj. fast and typically superficial
24.ex_en: The Government should not be pressured into making hasty decisions.
24.ex_zh: 政府不应该迫于压力仓促作出决定。

24.def_en: n. a test or criterion for determining the quality or genuineness of a thing
24.ex_en: Job security has become the touchstone of a good job for many employees.
24.ex_zh: 对许多雇员来说，工作的稳定性已经成了一份好工作的标准。

24.def_en: v. to allow to exist or happen
24.ex_en: Jenny would brook no criticism of Matthew.
24.ex_zh: 珍妮不会容忍任何对马修的批评。

24.def_en: (1)adj. opposite in nature or effect (2)n. something that is the opposite of something else
24.def_zh: 相反的；相反事物，相反数（数学）
24.ex_en: The tension grew in inverse proportion to the distance from their final destination.
24.ex_zh: 拉力的增加与到达它们最终点的距离成相反的比例。

24.def_en: v. to cause to feel less angry about something
24.ex_en: I tried to placate her by offering to pay for the repairs.
24.ex_zh: 我提出支付修理费来抚慰他。

24.def_en: adj. resisting control or authority
24.ex_en: He has a refractory pony.
24.ex_zh: 他有一匹匹桀骜不驯的马驹

24.def_en: v. to get possession of (something)
24.ex_en: She managed to procure a ticket for the concert.
24.ex_zh: 她好不容易弄到一张音乐会入场券。

24.def_en: adj. accepted, done, or happening often or over a large area at a particular time
24.ex_en: These prejudices are particularly prevalent among people living in the North.
24.ex_zh: 这些偏见在北方人中尤为常见。

24.def_en: adj. marked by or concerned about precise accordance with the details of codes or conventions
24.ex_en: The mistake was spotted immediately by their punctilious lawyer.
24.ex_zh: 这个错误马上被他们一丝不苟的律师发现了。

24.def_en: adj. firmly restraining response to pain or distress
24.ex_en: To a stoic believer, the human soul was a divine spark.
24.ex_zh: 对于禁欲主义者来说，人的灵魂是神圣的火花。

24.def_en: n. the quality or state of having many different forms, types, ideas, etc.
24.ex_en: Few countries have as rich a diversit y of habitat as South Africa.
24.ex_zh: 几乎没有哪个国家像南非那样拥有如此多样化的动植物栖生地。

24.def_en: (1)v. to contaminate morally (2)v. to affect with putrefaction (3)n. something that causes a person or thing to be thought of as bad, dishonest, etc.
24.ex_en: The air was tainted by fumes from the cars.
24.ex_zh: 空气被汽车排出的废气所污染。

24.def_en: adj. lasting a very short time
24.ex_en: I had some momentary misgivings that were quickly resolved.
24.ex_zh: 我曾有过短暂的疑虑，但很快都烟消云散了。

24.def_en: (1)v. to move faster (2)v. to cause to happen sooner or more quickly
24.ex_en: The government is to accelerate its privatization programs.
24.ex_zh: 政府将加快其私有化计划的进程。

24.def_en: v. to cause someone to be no longer friendly or close to another person or group
24.ex_en: He became estranged from his family after the argument.
24.ex_zh: 那场争吵后他便与家人疏远了。

24.def_en: adj. very clear
24.ex_en: She has a pair of pellucid blue eyes.
24.ex_zh: 她有一双清澈的蓝眼睛。

24.def_en: adj. deadly or pernicious in influence
24.ex_en: They must do more to deal with the baleful legacy of communism, build trust in public institutions and fight against corruption.
24.ex_zh: 它们必须付出更多努力来应对共产主义的贻害，构建对公共机构的信任，并打击腐败。

24.def_en: (1)v. to cause to do something (2)adj. performed readily or immediately
24.ex_en: Japan's recession has prompted consumers to cut back on buying cars.
24.ex_zh: 日本的经济衰退已促使消费者们削减购车花销。

24.def_en: adj. capable of being understood or appreciated
24.ex_en: The director believed that program can make science more accessible to young people.
24.ex_zh: 该负责人认为这项计划能让年轻人更容易理解科学。

24.def_en: (1)adj. coming from the imagination (2)adj. existing in fancy only
24.ex_en: The Moon Maiden is one of a number of fanciful lunar inhabitants.
24.ex_zh: 嫦娥是人们臆造出来的诸多月球居住者之一。

24.def_en: adj. lacking in physical strength or substance
24.ex_en: The storm flattened the flimsy wooden huts that the villagers lived in.
24.ex_zh: 风暴刮平了村民们居住的脆弱的木屋。

24.def_en: adj. fruitful in offspring or vegetation
24.ex_en: The pampas are still among the mos t fecund lands in the world.
24.ex_zh: 南美大草原仍然是世界上最肥沃的土地之一。

24.def_en: v. to make indirect reference
24.ex_en: Many passages in Scripture allude to this concept.
24.ex_zh: 圣经中有许多经文间接地提到这样的概念。

24.def_en: adj. skillful and clever
24.ex_en: The pianist has deft fingers.
24.ex_zh: 钢琴家有灵巧的双手。

24.def_en: v. to make less painful, difficult, or severe
24.ex_en: Tranquilizers help alleviate the distressing symptoms of anxiety.
24.ex_zh: 镇静剂有助于减轻焦虑所带来的不安症状。

24.def_en: n. lacking of honesty
24.ex_en: Politicians are often accused of mendacity.
24.ex_zh: 政客们常被斥为扯谎成性。

24.def_en: (1)v. to subdue or deaden (the body, bodily appetites, etc.) (2)v. to cause someone to feel extremely embarrassed or ashamed
24.ex_en: Jane mortified her family by leaving her husband.
24.ex_zh: 简离开丈夫的做法使她的家庭蒙羞。

24.def_en: adj. aggressively malicious
24.ex_en: He was died of a malignant tumor.
24.ex_zh: 他死于恶性肿瘤。

24.def_en: n. bitter deep-seated ill will
24.ex_en: I have no rancor against him.
24.ex_zh: 我对他毫无怨恨。

24.def_en: adj. of a happy lighthearted character or disposition
24.ex_en: Face everyday in your life with a blithe spirit , try to experience , to taste , to appreciate.
24.ex_zh: 以愉快的心态去面对你生命中的每一天，尝试着去体会，去品味，去感激。

24.def_en: n. a drawing position in chess in which a player is not in checkmate but has no legal move to play
24.ex_en: The talks ended in (a) stalemate.
24.ex_zh: 谈判陷入僵局，无果而终。

24.def_en: n. edge
24.ex_en: The country is teetering on the brink of civil war.
24.ex_zh: 这个国家正处在内战的边缘。

24.def_en: (1)v. to form an opinion about something without definitely knowing the truth (2)n. a thought or idea based on scanty evidence
24.ex_en: From the looks on their faces, I surmised that they had had an argument.
24.ex_zh: 看他们的脸色，我猜想他们之间发生了争执。

24.def_en: adj. causing envy: very desirable
24.ex_en: She learned to speak foreign langua ges with enviable fluency.
24.ex_zh: 她学会了说几种外语，其流利程度令人羡慕。

26.ex_zh: 我知道葆拉自从我叔叔彼得去世后情绪一直很不稳定。

26.def_en: adj. very serious about doing things in a direct and efficient way without any foolishness or nonsense

26.ex_zh: 她视自己为一个率直、高效干练的现代女性。

26.def_en: v. to cause to be upside down

26.ex_zh: 研究结果颠覆了我们的一些基本假设。

26.def_en: v. to avoid giving a promise or direct answer

26.ex_zh: 他们闪烁其词，不愿回答有关此次行动的各种问题。

26.def_en: v. to increase in amount

26.ex_zh: 有几个小时，紧张局势有所加剧。

26.def_en: adj. having no meaning, purpose, or effect

26.ex_zh: 没有观众，表演也就没有意义了。

26.def_en: adj. perfectly typical or representative of a particular kind of person or thing

26.ex_zh: 尽管布莱尔在很多方面反映出他属于典型的战后婴儿潮一代，他身上却也有着些许遗世独立的气质。

26.def_en: v. to torment by or as if by constant attack

26.ex_zh: 整个星期她都受到新闻界的不断烦扰。

26.def_en: v. to put things in an orderly form
26.ex_en: The latest draft of the agreement co difies the panel's decision.
26.ex_zh: 最新的协议草案把专家小组的决定加以整理，形成了条文。

26.def_en: (1)adj. not capable of being affected or disturbed (2)adj. not allowing entrance or passage
26.def_zh: 不受影响的；不能渗透的

26.ex_zh: 对于来自各方的指责，她似乎无动于衷。

26.def_en: v. to lose turgor from lack of water

26.ex_zh: 她买的玫瑰第二天就凋谢了。

26.def_en: v. to make it work again after a period in which it has not been working

26.ex_zh: 美国政府推行了一系列旨在复苏经济的经济改革。

26.def_en: (1)n. a feeling of uneasiness about a point especially of conscience or propriety (2)n. a sudden feeling of usually disturbing emotion (such as doubt or fear)
26.ex_en: I have no qualms about recommending this approach.
26.ex_zh: 我会毫不犹豫地推荐这一方法。

26.def_en: adj. expressing opinions and feelings in an honest and sincere way
