26.ex_zh: 我对他并非完全坦诚

26.def_en: adj. owing gratitude or recognition to another

26.ex_zh: 我深深感激我的家人给我的所有帮助。

26.def_en: v. to make powerless or ineffective

26.ex_zh: 在战斗中他们能瘫痪敌人的意志，在对付经验相对较少的敌人时轻易地取得战斗优势。

26.def_en: adj. self-evident

26.ex_zh: 人年纪越大通常灵活性越差，这是不言而喻的。

26.def_en: n. something that comes before something else and that often leads to or influences its development

26.ex_zh: 韦斯特伍德始终是朋克革命的先驱者，她的目标就是向时装界的传统服饰挑战。

26.def_en: v. to make or adapt to suit a special need or purpose
26.ex_en: Most travel agents are prepared to tailor travel arrangements to meet individual requirements.
26.ex_zh: 为了满足个别需要，大多数旅行社都愿意做出专门的旅游安排。

26.def_en: n. a condition characterized by the excessive accumulation and storage of fat in the body

26.ex_zh: 该研究还表明了肥胖症和死亡率之间存在直接的联系。

26.def_en: n. an animal or plant much below normal size

26.ex_zh: 在大部分的故事中，小矮人有神奇魔法。

26.def_en: adj. marked by fast and nervous, disordered, or anxiety-driven activity

26.ex_zh: 一只鸟被关进了笼子，到现在它都十分狂躁。

26.def_en: v. to make known to many people
26.ex_en: The shipping industry promulgated a voluntary code.
26.ex_zh: 航运业对自律守则进行了宣传。

26.def_en: adj. completely unwilling to change

26.ex_zh: 他们向政府施压以迫使其改变不妥协的立场。

26.def_en: adj. dull or ordinary

26.ex_zh: 他的老师对利率的急剧上升给出了一个更枯燥乏味的解释。

26.def_en: n. a confusing or difficult problem

26.def_en: adj. secret or mysterious

26.ex_zh: 在群体里大家有着共同的目标和信仰，不会使用那些晦涩难懂的许可条款来保护某些公司的移动市场。

26.def_en: n. a comprehensive presentation of a subject
26.ex_en: The tower offers a breathtaking panorama of Prague.
26.ex_zh: 从塔上可看到壮丽的布拉格全景。

26.def_en: n. a place, employment, status, or activity for which a person or thing is best fitted

26.ex_zh: 最后他在体育新闻界找到了理想的工作。

26.ex_zh: …马克；莫里斯，被吹捧为他那一代的舞蹈奇才

26.ex_zh: 卡迈勒是埃及露天集市里的一个小贩。

26.def_en: n. a large amount of something

26.ex_zh: 南方多水；利于灌溉。

26.def_en: adj. lacking remembrance, memory, or mindful attention

26.ex_zh: 他已经忘却发生什么事了。

26.def_en: n. a right or immunity granted as a peculiar benefit, advantage, or favor

26.ex_zh: 他的作品被认为是电影艺术的巅峰之作。

26.def_en: v. to pay attention to

26.def_en: adj. requiring much time, effort, or attention

26.ex_zh: 他将莫里斯描述为一个过度苛刻和挑剔的导师。

26.def_en: n. the smallest part or particle imaginable

26.ex_zh: 这声明里没有丝毫的真实性。

26.def_en: (1)n. a feeling of closeness and understanding that someone has for another person because of their similar qualities, ideas, or interests (2)n. likeness based on relationship or causal connection (3)n. liking for or an attraction to something

26.ex_zh: 他正视自己儿时所受的创伤，努力消除心中的痛苦。

26.def_en: v. to surprise or upset very much

26.ex_zh: 在峰顶看到的景色使他们惊叹不已。

26.def_en: adj. having a strong influence on ideas, works, events, etc., that come later

26.ex_zh: 这些改革已成为英国国民保健制度史上一件具有开创性的大事。

26.def_en: adj. having or exhibiting self-importance

26.ex_zh: 他有些爱摆架子，并且高估自己的能力。

26.def_en: (1)v. to say or declare openly (2)v. to believe in (a particular religion)

26.ex_zh: 她仍然声称自己无辜。

26.def_en: n. a standard for making a critical judgment

26.ex_zh: 考试结果不是衡量学校水平的唯一标准。

26.def_en: adj. not wavering or weakening

26.ex_zh: 如果你有坚定的决心，你就一定会成功！

26.def_en: adj. not able to be doubted

26.ex_zh: 他的合法地位是不容置疑的。

26.def_en: v. to offset

26.ex_zh: 你应该加点蜂蜜来调和酸味。

26.def_en: n. an original model on which something is patterned

26.ex_zh: 金属轮战车是现代战争中坦克的原型。

26.def_en: n. a surrounding area or district

26.ex_zh: 成群结队的人聚集在特拉法尔加广场周围。

26.def_en: n. quickness of motion

26.ex_zh: 爱因斯坦的理论把能量同质量和光速联系起来

26.ex_zh: 比较擅长贸易的文明其财富也随之增长。

26.def_en: n. a state of perplexity or doubt

26.ex_zh: 政府似乎陷入了左右为难的境地，不知道该拿这么多人怎么办。

26.def_en: n. absence of order

26.ex_zh: 经济混乱使得战后的世界陷入水深火热之中。

26.def_en: v. to completely suppress

26.ex_zh: 该公司增加了其在生意中的股份，这样就压制住了被收购的谣言。

26.def_en: adj. not usual or normal

26.ex_zh: 在；英尺的高度飞行时，他听到旋翼发出一种奇怪的噪音。

26.def_en: n. an act of bidding farewell

26.ex_zh: 他在毕业典礼上发表了动人的告别辞。

26.def_en: adj. of or relating to centralized control by an autocratic leader or hierarchy

26.ex_zh: 东欧民族国家最终抛弃了极权统治。

26.def_en: adj. not modern or current

26.ex_zh: 罗马尼亚迫切需要援助以对其过时的产业进行现代化。

26.def_en: n. connection, link

26.ex_zh: 祈祷书为各信仰之间建起了足够灵活的联系纽带，以期将各个不同教派凝聚在一起。

26.def_en: v. to cause to seem inferior

26.ex_zh: 那样的行为有损你的名誉。

26.def_en: v. to leave or get rid of quickly or without concern

26.ex_zh: 政府宣称并未将放射性废料倾倒在海里。

26.def_en: adj. of or relating to ancient times

26.ex_zh: 可以说社会哲学是一个古老的概念又是一个新兴的研究领域。

26.def_en: n. a cure or solution for any illness or problem

26.ex_zh: 玛格丽特一直是个早熟的孩子。

26.def_en: adj. extremely excited

26.ex_zh: 那些叛乱者知道真相；并且想办法来挑起革命。

27.def_en: adj. naively innocent and trusting
27.ex_en: She and Dan were still dewy-eyed enough to think that they would get full compensation.
27.ex_zh: 她和丹仍然非常天真，以为他们可以得到全额的补偿。

27.def_en: (1)v. to cause to feel very excited or happy (2)n. a quivering or trembling caused by sudden excitement or emotion
27.ex_en: It gave me a big thrill to meet my favorite author in person.
27.ex_zh: 能见到我最喜欢的作者本人使我感到兴奋不已。

27.def_en: v. to stir up
27.ex_en: The Second World War kindled his enthusiasm for politics.
27.ex_zh: 第二次世界大战激发了他的政治热情。

27.def_en: n. malicious or defamatory gossip
27.ex_en: There has been no hint of scandal during his time in office.
27.ex_zh: 他在任期间没有任何丑闻。

27.def_en: n. excessive or slavish admiration or flattery
27.ex_en: Despite his performance at the Oscars ceremony and being caught up in all the glitz and adulation, Rahman is a low-key star.
27.ex_zh: 尽管他在奥斯卡盛典上的表现及为奢华与恭维所包围，拉曼仍是个低调的明星。

27.def_en: adj. always right and accurate
27.ex_en: She has an unerring instinct for people's weak spots.
27.ex_zh: 她能准确地把握他人的弱点。

27.def_en: v. to cause to separate widely
27.ex_en: The explosion scattered a flock of birds roosting in the trees.
27.ex_zh: 爆炸声把栖息在树丛中的鸟群惊散了。

27.def_en: adj. giving exact rules, directions, or instructions about how you should do something
27.ex_en: The son of a mandarin has no prescriptive right to succeed his father.
27.ex_zh: 高级官员的儿子没有法定的权力继承他的父亲。

27.def_en: adj. tediously uniform or unvarying
27.ex_en: It's monotonous work, like most factory jobs.
27.ex_zh: 与工厂大部分工作一样，这份工作也很单调乏味。

27.def_en: (1)v. to cause to happen or be created (2)v. to cause someone to have (a feeling or emotion)
27.ex_en: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause.
27.ex_zh: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

27.def_en: v. to give, transfer or deliver into the hands or control of another
27.ex_en: The father consigned the child to his sister's care.
27.ex_zh: 那位父亲把孩子托付给他妹妹照看。

27.def_en: v. to fill or build up again
27.ex_en: The government is trying to replenish supplies by airlifting food.
27.ex_zh: 政府正试图通过空投食品补充供应。

27.def_en: n. pain or suffering affecting the body, a bodily part, or the mind
27.ex_en: Marie felt her distress ebbing away.
27.ex_zh: 玛丽感到她的痛苦渐渐减退了。

27.def_en: v. to present for acceptance
27.ex_en: The army has not yet proffered an explanation of how and why the accident happened.
27.ex_zh: 军队还没有对这次事件发生的经过和原因给出解释。

27.def_en: n. an arbitrary constant whose value characterizes a member of a system
27.ex_en: Each input parameter should have the variable name and its value.
27.ex_zh: 各输入参数应该有自己的变量名和值。

27.def_en: adj. deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behavior
27.ex_en: I would feel rebellious against all life.
27.ex_zh: 我觉得对所有的生活都有一种反抗的情绪。

27.def_en: v. to obscure the existence or true state or character of
27.ex_en: It is impossible to disguise the fact that finance is bad.
27.ex_zh: 财政困难这一事实是无法隐瞒的。

27.def_en: adj. having requisite or adequate ability or qualities
27.ex_en: I was deemed to be a competent shorthand typist.
27.ex_zh: 我被视为是一名能干的速记打字员。

27.def_en: (1)adj. relating to a scientific experiment or to scientific experiments in general (2)adj. using a new way of doing or thinking about something
27.ex_en: The experimental results show that the syntaxic method is effective.
27.ex_zh: 实验结果表明该综合性方法效果良好。

27.def_en: v. to check or control
27.ex_en: we do need to act convincingly to curb future deficits.
27.ex_zh: 我们需要采取令人信服的行动来控制将来的赤字。

27.def_en: adj. having little value or importance
27.ex_en: Outside California these difficulties may seem fairly trifling.
27.ex_zh: 在别处，加利福尼亚的这些困难可能看起来相当微不足道。

27.def_en: adj. characterized by resolute fearlessness, fortitude, and endurance
27.ex_en: Intrepid pioneers settled the American West.
27.ex_zh: 无所畏惧的先驱者们在美国西部定居。

27.def_en: v. to establish by legal and authoritative act
27.ex_en: The king could not enact laws without the sanction of Parliament.
27.ex_zh: 未经议会批准，国王不能制定法律。

27.def_en: adj. having or showing an ability to notice and understand things that are difficult or not obvious
27.ex_en: It was very perspicacious of you to find the cause of the trouble so quickly.
27.ex_zh: 你真是明察秋毫，问题的原因这麽快就找出来了。

27.def_en: v. to make confused
27.ex_en: Jokes about raccoon hunting in the book may bemuse international readers.
27.ex_zh: 书中提到了捉浣熊的笑话或许会令海外读头雾水。

27.def_en: v. to fasten or restrain by or as if by a tether
27.ex_en: The officer dismounted, tethering his horse to a tree.
27.ex_zh: 这位军官下了马，把马拴在一棵树上。

27.def_en: adj. awkward or inefficient in use or construction
27.ex_en: He is still smarting over criticism of his victorious but clumsy performance.
27.ex_zh: 别人批评他尽管最终胜出但表现笨拙，他为这样的批评感到闷闷不乐。

27.def_en: v. to evade the point of an argument by caviling about words
27.ex_en: He quibbled about the price.
27.ex_zh: 他为价格争论。

27.def_en: v. to offer for discussion or consideration
27.ex_en: Zoologist Eugene Morton has propounded a general theory of the vocal sounds that animals make. ·
27.ex_zh: 动物学家尤金；莫顿提出了一个有关动物发声的概括性理论。

27.def_en: v. to bring into peril
27.ex_en: Conservationists say the oil leak could imperil the long-term survival of the creatures.
27.ex_zh: 自然保护协会人士认为石油泄露将长期威胁海龟的生存。

27.def_en: adj. existing in a state of intellectual, moral, or social darkness
27.ex_en: Listen to both sides and you will be enlightened; heed only one side and you will be benighted.
27.ex_zh: 听则明，偏信则暗。

27.def_en: adj. making you feel less worried or frightened
27.ex_en: They tried to reassure her, but she still felt anxious.
27.ex_zh: 他们设法让她放心，可她还是焦虑不安。

27.def_en: v. to stir to activity
27.ex_en: The proposal would spark a storm of protest around the country.
27.ex_zh: 这一提案将引发全国性的抗议浪潮。

27.def_en: (1)adj. not sincere (2)adj. humanly contrived often on a natural model
27.ex_en: It was the first commercially available machine to employ artificial intelligence.
27.ex_zh: 这是第一台作为商品出售的采用人工智能技术的机器。

27.def_en: n. an angry and usually long speech or piece of writing that strongly criticizes someone or something
27.ex_en: The book is a diatribe against the ac ademic left.
27.ex_zh: 该书对学界左派进行了抨击。

27.def_en: n. the quality of a person who is completely honest
27.ex_en: Her probity and integrity are beyond question.
27.ex_zh: 她的诚实和正直是无可争辩的。

27.def_en: v. to catch
27.ex_en: Allied troops captured over 300 enemy soldiers. 300
27.ex_zh: 盟军俘虏了；多名敌方士兵。

27.def_en: adj. irregular, unusual
27.ex_en: Jamie is an atypical English schoolboy.
27.ex_zh: 杰米跟一般的英国男学生不太一样。

27.def_en: adj. requiring immediate attention
27.ex_en: It has becoming an exigent task to fi nd a "new continent" of species reso urces.
27.ex_zh: 寻找生物种质资源的“新大陆”已经成为了一个迫切的问题。

27.def_en: n. a narrow opening or crack of considerable length and depth usually occurring from some breaking or parting
27.ex_en: Just ahead of us there was a huge fissure. ,
27.ex_zh: 离我们不远处；出现一个大裂缝。

27.def_en: v. to free from or as if from a tether
27.ex_en: Only better regulation can untether economies from the fickle fortunes of finance.
27.ex_zh: 只有更好的监管，才能把经济体从金融业变幻无常的命运中解脱出来。

27.def_en: n. a model or pattern for something that may be copied
27.ex_en: He had become the paradigm of the successful man.
27.ex_zh: 他已经成为成功人士的典范。

27.def_en: (1)adj. incidental, indirect (2)adj. oblique in direction; slanting or deflected
27.ex_en: Certainly, no all-round knowledge can be acquired merely by glancing this way and that and relying on hearsay.
27.ex_zh: 东张西望，道听途说，绝然得不到什么完全的知识。

27.def_en: v. to twist out of the true meaning or proportion
27.ex_en: The media distorts reality and categorizes people as all good or all bad.
27.ex_zh: 媒体会歪曲事实，将人说得不是完美无缺就是一无是处。

27.def_en: v. to leave out
27.ex_en: Did you omit some small but vital factor from one of your Columns?
27.ex_zh: 是不是你在某一列中遗漏了一些微小却关键的因素？

27.def_en: adj. brilliantly or showily bright, colorful, or impressive
27.ex_en: The evening was crowned by her dazzling performance.
27.ex_zh: 她那令人炫目的表演把晚会的气氛推向高潮。

27.def_en: adj. marked by extreme calm, impassivity, and steadiness
27.ex_en: He remained imperturbable in spite of the hysteria and panic all around him.
27.ex_zh: 尽管他周围的人歇斯底里地惊慌失措，但他仍保持冷静。

27.def_en: adj. impossible to deny
27.ex_en: It is an undeniable fact that crime is increasing.
27.ex_zh: 犯罪在增加是无可争辩的事实。

27.def_en: v. to ignore in a deliberate and insulting way
27.ex_en: He snubbed her in public and made her feel an idiot
27.ex_zh: 他当众冷落她，让她觉得自己像一个白痴似的。

27.def_en: adj. deeply felt
27.ex_en: We would like to take this opportunity to convey our heartfelt condolences to the families of the victims.
27.ex_zh: 我们谨此向受害人家属表达我们衷心的慰唁。

27.def_en: n. a combination or mixture of things
27.ex_en: His previous fusions of jazz, pop and African melodies have proved highly successful.
27.ex_zh: 事实证明他先前融合了爵士乐、流行乐和非洲旋律的作品非常成功。

27.def_en: v. to deprive of vital elements or resources, such as personnel, equipment or funding, for use elsewhere
27.ex_en: Margins are eroding because new products cannibalize the market and customers of older products.
27.ex_zh: 利润率也在下降，因为新产品侵占了老产品的市场和消费者。

27.def_en: adj. alike or similar
27.ex_en: I recall many discussions with her on these and kindred topics.
27.ex_zh: 我回想起多次同她就这些问题及类似话题进行的讨论。

27.def_en: adj. dull, boring, and ordinary
27.ex_en: They all appeared to be lost in the humdrum and routine of their work.
27.ex_zh: 他们好像在一个个单调的工作中迷失了。

27.def_en: v. to make a hole through
27.ex_en: I refused to wear headphones because they can perforate your eardrums.
27.ex_zh: 我不愿戴耳机，因为它可能会使鼓膜穿孔。

27.def_en: adj. having no example or parallel
27.ex_en: In recent years, with the rapid development of economic construction in our country, high- grade highway construction is evolving with unexampled speed.
27.ex_zh: 近些年来，随着国民经济持续高速发展，高等级公路的建设正以前所未有的发展速度向前推进。

27.def_en: v. to damage or ruin the force or effectiveness of
27.ex_en: If he becomes the major opposition leader, he could hamstring a conservative-led coalition.
27.ex_zh: 如果他成为主要反对党的领袖，可能会导致保守党领导的联合政府陷于瘫痪。

27.def_en: n. a very small difference in color, tone, meaning, etc.
27.ex_en: We can use our eyes and facial expressions to communicate virtually every subtle nuance of emotion.
27.ex_zh: 我们可以用眼睛和面部表情来如实地传达情感上的每一丝细微差别。

27.def_en: (1)v. to get secure usually lasting possession or control of (2)adj. protected from danger or harm
27.ex_en: The team managed to secure a place in the finals.
27.ex_zh: 球队拼得了决赛的一席之地。

27.def_en: v. to indulge oneself immoderately
27.ex_en: I wanted only to wallow in my own grief.
27.ex_zh: 我只想沉湎于自己的悲伤中。

27.def_en: adj. marked by or calling for energy or stamina
27.ex_en: Strenuous efforts had been made to improve conditions in the jail.
27.ex_zh: 为改善那家监狱里的条件已做了艰苦的努力。

27.def_en: adj. requiring maximum effort or ability
27.ex_en: The most testing time is undoubtedly in the early months of your return to work.
27.ex_zh: 最考验人的时候无疑是在你重返工作岗位的头几个月。

27.def_en: adj. not willing to tell people about things
27.ex_en: He was extremely reticent about his personal life.
27.ex_zh: 他对自己的个人生活讳莫如深。

27.def_en: v. to gain or regain the favor or goodwill of
27.ex_en: Sacrifices were made to propitiate the gods.
27.ex_zh: 人们供奉祭品以求神灵息怒。

27.def_en: adj. not lasting long
27.ex_en: In most cases, pain is transient.
27.ex_zh: 大多数情况下，疼痛是短暂的。

27.def_en: adj. without deliberation
27.ex_en: Do not leap headlong into decisions.
27.ex_zh: 不要轻率地作决定。

27.def_en: (1)v. to make fit, suitable, or congruous (2)v. to make room for
27.ex_en: The runway of this airport is undergoing expansion to accommodate large planes.
27.ex_zh: 这个机场的跑道正在扩建以适应大型飞机起落。

27.def_en: adj. not original or special
27.ex_en: For god sake, this is a canned soap opera.
27.ex_zh: 上帝啊，这简直就是一出千篇一律的肥皂剧。

27.def_en: v. to transfer (a sports team) to a lower ranking division
27.ex_en: If Leigh lose, they'll be relegated.
27.ex_zh: 如果利失球，他们将会降级。

27.def_en: adj. notably or brilliantly outstanding because of dignity or achievements or actions
27.ex_en: The composer was one of many illustrious visitors to the town.
27.ex_zh: 那位作曲家是许多造访过这个城市的杰出人物之一。

27.def_en: n. a name that someone uses instead of his or her real name
27.ex_en: Both plays were published under the pseudonym of Philip Dayre. ·
27.ex_zh: 两个剧本都是以菲利普；戴尔的笔名出版的。

27.def_en: adj. not to be endured: intolerable
27.ex_en: The heat and humidity were insufferable.
27.ex_zh: 高温和潮湿让人难以忍受。

27.def_en: v. to restrain from movement, progress, or action
27.ex_en: He was manacled by the police.
27.ex_zh: 他被警察上了镣铐。

27.def_en: v. to sing in a low soft voice
27.ex_en: He would much rather have been cr ooning in a smoky bar.
27.ex_zh: 他宁愿在烟雾缭绕的酒吧里哼唱歌曲。

27.def_en: adj. protracted excessively
27.ex_en: he reviewer padded out his review with a lengthy biography of the author.
27.ex_zh: 评论者在他的评论中添加了冗长的作者生平以拉长篇幅。

27.def_en: adj. designed to be used once or only a limited number of times and then thrown away
27.ex_en: It's estimated that around 80 per cent of babies wear disposable nappies. 80%
27.ex_zh: 据估计约；的婴儿使用一次性尿布。

27.def_en: adj. pretending to be morally better than other people
27.ex_en: He writes smug, sanctimonious waffle.
27.ex_zh: 他写的满篇都是自鸣得意、道貌岸然的废话。

27.def_en: adj. having no relevant component removed or destroyed
27.ex_en: The money was returned intact by its finder.
27.ex_zh: 钱原封未动地被捡拾者送还。

27.def_en: adj. very foolish or stupid
27.ex_en: The president denounced the witless, nasty piece of journalism.
27.ex_zh: 总统痛斥了那份极为肤浅、令人作呕的新闻报道。

27.def_en: adj. having or showing the ability or desire to do new and difficult things
27.ex_en: He invented the Nobel Prize for ente rprising scientists.
27.ex_zh: 他为有进取心的科学家创设了诺贝尔奖。

27.def_en: adj. showing strong and often angry feelings
27.ex_en: One vehement critic is Michael Howard. ·
27.ex_zh: 其中一位言辞激烈的评论家是迈克尔；霍华德。

27.def_en: n. one that follows
27.ex_en: He set out several principles that he hopes will guide his successors. ,
27.ex_zh: 他制定出了几条原则；希望能指导其继任者。

27.def_en: v. to proceed slowly or with difficulty
27.ex_en: I wasn't badly hurt, but I injured my thigh and had to limp.
27.ex_zh: 我伤得不重，但一条大腿伤到了，只好一瘸一拐地走。

27.def_en: n. the act of retaining
27.ex_en: The company needs to improve its training and retention of staff.
27.ex_zh: 公司需要改进对员工的培训和留用工作。

27.def_en: adj. self-proclaimed
27.ex_en: Two of those arrested are said to be self-styled area commanders...
27.ex_zh: 据说在那些被捕的人员中有两人自称是地区指挥官。

27.def_en: adj. low in spirit
27.ex_en: Barbara looked increasingly downcast as defeat loomed.
27.ex_zh: 当败象逼近时，芭芭拉看上去越来越沮丧。

27.def_en: adj. marked by or given to speech or writing that is given exaggerated importance by artificial or empty means
27.ex_en: The once bombastic orator had himself lapsed into silence.
27.ex_zh: 那个曾经夸夸其辞的演说家缄默不语。

27.def_en: v. to move in a confused or disordered manner
27.ex_en: They had jumbled it all up into a heap.
27.ex_zh: 他们把所有的东西胡乱堆成了一堆。

27.def_en: (1)adj. capable of becoming real (2)n. a chance or possibility that something will happen or exist in the future (3)n. an ability that someone has that can be developed to help that person become successful
27.ex_en: The meeting has the potential to be a watershed event.
27.ex_zh: 这次会议有可能成为一次分水岭事件。

27.def_en: adj. marked by inactivity or repose
27.ex_en: The rapid development of the economy turns the quiescent town into a noisy city.
27.ex_zh: 经济的迅速发展使这个宁静的小镇成为闹市。

27.def_en: adj. accustomed, used
27.ex_en: He was wont to fall asleep after supper.
27.ex_zh: 他习惯吃完晚饭就打盹。

27.def_en: adj. not limited in any way
27.ex_en: His ambition is unbounded.
27.ex_zh: 他的野心毫无止境。

27.def_en: v. to put into a state of agitated confusion
27.ex_en: She was put in a fluster by the unexpected guests.
27.ex_zh: 不速之客的到来弄得她很慌张。

27.def_en: adj. disposed to arouse or take part in or guilty of sedition
27.ex_en: He distributed a seditious pamphlet called The Rights of Man.
27.ex_zh: 他散发了名叫《人的权利》的带有煽动性的小册子。

27.def_en: adj. not easily governed, managed, or directed
27.ex_en: The economy still faces intractable problems.
27.ex_zh: 经济仍然面临着一些棘手的问题。

27.def_en: adj. regulated or determined in size or degree with reference to proportions
27.ex_en: The value of a fraction is inversely proportional to that of the denominator.
27.ex_zh: 分数值与分母值成反比例。

27.def_en: n. the exact opposite of something or someone
27.ex_en: I cannot vote for a candidate who stands for the antithesis of what I believe.
27.ex_zh: 我不能选一个与我的信仰相反的候选人。

27.def_en: (1)v. to engage in argument (2)v. to call into question
27.ex_en: He disputed the allegations.
27.ex_zh: 他对指控表示怀疑。

27.def_en: n. the power to produce a desired result or effect
27.ex_en: There is little information on the efficacy of this treatment.
27.ex_zh: 关于此法的疗效目前所知甚少。

27.def_en: (1)adj. not interesting or exciting (2)adj. showing no emotion, concern, etc.
27.ex_en: It tasted bland and insipid, like warmed cardboard.
27.ex_zh: 这吃起来淡而无味，像加热过的纸板。

27.def_en: adj. having or showing an ability to think clearly
27.ex_en: It lies in the blend of clearheaded log ic and powerful intuition.
27.ex_zh: 它是清晰的逻辑和强有力的直觉的融合。

27.def_en: n. a calculated move: stratagem
27.ex_en: He sees the proposal as more of a diplomatic gambit than a serious defense proposal.
27.ex_zh: 在他看来，与其说这是一项精心筹划的国防动议，倒不如说是外交上的一着妙棋。

27.def_en: v. to give evidence of displeasure or disapproval by or as if by facial expression
27.ex_en: This practice is frowned upon as being wasteful
27.ex_zh: 这种行为被认为是浪费而不获认可。

28.def_en: adj. lacking originality, freshness, or novelty
28.ex_en: The script is utterly banal. It is incredible that human minds can put such muck on to paper.
28.ex_zh: 这个剧本是十足的平庸之作，难以想象有人会写出这样的垃圾。

28.def_en: (1)adj. capable of adapting to varying conditions (2)adj. not real or sincere
28.ex_en: TV game show hosts with their banal remarks and plastic smiles.
28.ex_zh: 语言陈腐、笑容刻板的电视竞赛节目主持人

28.def_en: v. to encroach upon in a way that violates law or the rights of another
28.ex_en: The film exploited his image and infringed his copyright.
28.ex_zh: 这部电影使用了他的形象，侵犯了他的肖像权。

28.def_en: v. to depart secretly and hide oneself

29.ex_zh: 很难去说这样一个武断的目标能有多靠谱，但环保领袖们和其他一些人却对此保持乐观。

29.def_en: adj. not intended or planned
29.ex_en: He became an unwitting accomplice in the crime.
29.ex_zh: 他糊里糊涂地成了犯罪的帮凶。

29.def_en: n. a strong natural liking for something that is usually bad
29.ex_en: His proclivity for alcohol was almost as well-known as his poetry.
29.ex_zh: 他的酗酒倾向几乎和他的诗作一样有名。

29.def_en: adj. widely acclaimed and highly honored
29.ex_en: She's a renowned landscape painter.
29.ex_zh: 她是一位很有名的风景画画家。

29.def_en: adj. made, done, or formed on or as if on the spur of the moment
29.ex_en: The children put on an impromptu concert for the visitors.
29.ex_zh: 孩子们为来访者即兴献上了一场音乐会。

29.def_en: (1)v. to take an oblique course (2)v. to distort especially from a true value or symmetrical form
29.ex_en: The ball skewed off at a right angle.
29.ex_zh: 球呈直角偏离弹了出去。

29.def_en: v. to scold or condemn vehemently and at length
29.ex_en: Marion berated Joe for the noise he made.
29.ex_zh: 玛丽昂严厉斥责乔吵吵闹闹。

29.def_en: adj. not affected by personal or emotional involvement
29.def_zh: 公正客观的，冷静客观的
29.ex_en: We, as prosecutors, try to be dispas sionate about the cases we bring.
29.ex_zh: 作为检察官，我们对经手的案件会尽力做到不偏不倚。

29.def_en: v. to influence or gently urge by caressing or flattering
29.ex_en: He tried to coax the secret from me.
29.ex_zh: 他试图哄骗我说出秘方。

29.def_en: adj. showing or demanding excessive delicacy or care
29.def_zh: 挑剔的，极其注重细节的
29.ex_en: He was fastidious about his appearance.
29.ex_zh: 他非常讲究仪表。

29.def_en: (1)adj. clear and easy to read (2)adj. easy and enjoyable to read
29.def_zh: 清晰易懂的；可读性强的
29.ex_en: This is an impeccably researched and very readable book.
29.ex_zh: 这本书中的研究缜密透彻，可读性很强。

29.def_en: v. to deny the existence or truth of
29.ex_en: Alcohol negates the effects of the drug.
29.ex_zh: 酒使药失去了效力。

29.def_en: (1)adj. bitingly sarcastic (2)adj. tending or having the power to corrode
29.ex_en: Sodium and sulphur are highly corrosive.
29.ex_zh: 钠和硫磺腐蚀性很强。

29.def_en: adj. not like talking about themselves or drawing attention to themselves
29.ex_en: As women we tend to be self- effacing and make light of what we have achieved.
29.ex_zh: 作为女性我们往往不喜夸耀，对自己获得的成功轻描淡写。

29.def_en: adj. full or loud in sound
29.ex_en: The sonorous voice of the speaker echoed round the room. .
29.ex_zh: 那位演讲人洪亮的声音在室内回荡

29.def_en: (1)n. an outbreak of a disease that occurs over a wide geographic area and affects an exceptionally high proportion of the population (2)adj. occurring over a wide geographic area and affecting an exceptionally high proportion of the population
29.ex_en: They feared a new cholera pandemic.
29.ex_zh: 他们担心一种新的霍乱流行病。

29.def_en: adj. removed or distant either physically or emotionally
29.ex_en: The Government is keeping aloof from the controversy.
29.ex_zh: 政府对争论保持置身事外的态度。

29.def_en: adj. capable of devising ways and means
29.ex_en: He was amazingly inventive and resourceful, and played a major role in my career.
29.ex_zh: 他极具创造力，而且足智多谋，在我的职业生涯中起到了重要的作用。

29.def_en: adj. caring only about making money
29.ex_en: Mercenary men lust for wealth.
29.ex_zh: 唯利是图的人贪求财富。

29.def_en: adj. having the power to horrify
29.ex_en: The film showed the most horrific murder scenes.
29.ex_zh: 那部影片有极恐怖的谋杀场面。

29.def_en: adj. causing, marked by, or expressing misery or grief
29.ex_en: He used dolorous tone, chaotic style of painting showing extreme grief of our life.
29.ex_zh: 他以忧伤的色调，纷乱的笔触，表达出人生的最大悲痛。

29.def_en: adj. lacking power or strength
29.ex_en: Without the chairman's support, the committee is impotent.
29.ex_zh: 没有主席的支持，委员会是无能为力的。

29.def_en: n. one that is eccentric
29.ex_en: His mother and father thought Jim was a bit of an oddball too.
29.ex_zh: 吉姆的父母也认为他有些古怪。

29.def_en: n. good-natured easy friendliness
29.ex_en: He was full of bonhomie.
29.ex_zh: 他非常友善。

29.def_en: (1)adj. not named or identified (2)adj. lacking individuality, distinction, or recognizability
29.def_zh: 无名的，匿名的；无个性的
29.ex_en: An anonymous caller told police what had happened.
29.ex_zh: 有人打匿名电话向警方报告了所发生的事。

29.def_en: v. to sing especially with a high or shaky voice
29.ex_en: He warbled his way through the song.
29.ex_zh: 整个歌曲他是用高颤音唱的。

29.def_en: adj. having or showing sad thoughts and feelings about something that you want to have or do and especially about something that made you happy in the past
29.ex_en: I can't help feeling slightly wistful about the perks I'm giving up.
29.ex_zh: 我不禁对自己将要放弃的津贴感到有点儿不舍。

29.def_en: adj. carelessly and foolishly spending money, time, etc.
29.ex_en: Prodigal habits die hard.
29.ex_zh: 大手大脚的习惯很难改掉。

29.def_en: v. to get rid of
29.ex_en: The crew jettisoned excess fuel and made an emergency landing.
29.ex_zh: 机组人员丢弃了多余的燃料，紧急着陆。

29.def_en: n. the use of few words to say something
29.ex_en: Brevity is the soul of English.
29.ex_zh: 简洁是英语的精华。

29.def_en: (1)n. an expression of approval (2)v. to praise or honor
29.ex_en: His new book received accolade from the papers. .
29.ex_zh: 他的新书受到报纸的热烈赞扬

29.def_en: adj. using more words than are needed
29.ex_en: His writing is difficult and often verbose.
29.ex_zh: 他的文章很晦涩，而且往往篇幅冗长。

29.def_en: (1)v. speak evil of (2)adj. evil in nature, influence, or effect
29.ex_en: Either the managers have been maligned or they are not telling the truth.
29.ex_zh: 要么是经理们受到了污蔑，要么就是他们在撒谎。

29.def_en: (1)adj. lacking dexterity or skill (2)adj. lacking the right proportions, size, or harmony of parts (3)adj. causing embarrassment (4)adj. not easy to handle or deal with
29.def_zh: 笨拙的；不合适的；尴尬的；棘手的
29.ex_en: Amy made an awkward gesture with her hands.
29.ex_zh: 艾米笨拙地做了个手势。

29.def_en: (1)adj. able to change into many different forms or able to do many different things (2)adj. displaying great diversity or variety
29.def_zh: 变化多端的；多才多艺的
29.ex_en: He is a protean stylist who can move from blues to ballads and grand symphony.
29.ex_zh: 他是一位多才多艺的艺术家，能从布鲁斯转换到民谣以及雄壮的交响乐。

29.def_en: v. to think carefully and deeply about something
29.ex_en: As people grow older, they begin to ruminate on the uncertainty of life. , .
29.ex_zh: 随着年龄的增长；人们开始对生活的变化无常冥思苦想

29.def_en: v. to lose freshness, strength, or vitality
29.ex_en: All color had faded from the sky.
29.ex_zh: 天上的颜色都退去了。

29.def_en: adj. present in all places at all times
29.ex_en: The sound of sirens was an omnipresent background noise in New York.
29.ex_zh: 在纽约，警报声是无处不在的背景噪音。

29.def_en: v. to give prominence to
29.ex_en: These colors are used as accent colors in the rest of the website.
29.ex_zh: 网站的其他部分将这个颜色用作强调色。

29.def_en: adj. having significant consequences
29.ex_en: The report discusses a number of consequential matters that are yet to be decided.
29.ex_zh: 这份报告讨论了许多有待决定的重大问题。

29.def_en: v. to take the place or position of
29.ex_en: Hand tools are relics of the past that have now been superseded by the machine.
29.ex_zh: 手工工具是历史的遗物，现在已经被机器所取代。

29.def_en: n. a businessperson of exceptional wealth, power, and influence
29.ex_en: The tycoon is on the verge of bankruptcy.
29.ex_zh: 那名大亨濒临破产的边缘。

29.def_en: adj. disapproving

29.ex_zh: 从弗兰克不愿意提起“人们”欠他钱的态度来看，她一直以为这笔钱为数不多。

29.def_en: n. any of the definable aspects that make up a subject (as of contemplation) or an object (as of consideration)

29.ex_zh: 种姓制度几乎影响着印度生活的方方面面。

29.def_en: v. to exist or happen at an earlier time than
29.ex_en: His troubles predated the recession.
29.ex_zh: 他的麻烦早在经济衰退前就出现了。

29.def_en: (1)adj. not knowing or caring about people and events in other places (2)adj. of, relating to, or coming from a province

29.ex_zh: 湖南省的省会是长沙。

29.def_en: n. the use of an unnecessarily large number of words to express an idea
29.ex_en: He is a master at circumlocution.
29.ex_zh: 他讲话很会兜圈子。

29.def_en: n. polite actions and words
29.ex_en: Staff members are trained to treat customers with civility at all times.
29.ex_zh: 全体职员接受训练，以便在任何时候对顾客都以礼相待。

29.def_en: adj. easily broken or destroyed
29.ex_en: She lay in bed looking particularly frail.
29.ex_zh: 她躺在床上，看上去特别虚弱。

29.def_en: v. to choose not to do
29.ex_en: The fans could not forbear crying out at the wonderful goal.
29.ex_zh: 一记精彩的进球使球迷们禁不住叫喊起来。

29.def_en: (1)adj. not very important (2)adj. not included in the main part of society or of a group
29.ex_en: The tribunals were established for the well-integrated members of society and not for marginal individuals.
29.ex_zh: 这个特别法庭是为社会中的主流人群设立的，而不是为了无足轻重的小人物。

29.def_en: v. to gain or attain usually by planned action or effort
29.ex_en: Only with mass direct action will we obtain such change.
29.ex_zh: 只有采取大规模直接行动，我们才会取得这样的改变。

29.def_en: n. a new word, usage, or expression

29.ex_zh: 高新技术产业里有一个新词：游戏化。

29.def_en: v. to reproach or challenge in a mocking or insulting manner

29.ex_zh: 一伙小混混嘲笑一位残疾人。

29.def_en: v. to cause pain or suffering to

29.ex_zh: 几十年来意大利一直饱受政治腐败之苦。

29.def_en: adj. big and heavy

29.ex_zh: 唐的腰间沉甸甸地坠着一圈赘肉。

29.def_en: adj. following in time, order, or place

29.ex_zh: 后来发生的事证实了我们的怀疑。

29.def_en: adj. able to become strong, happy, or successful again after a difficult situation or event
29.ex_en: George Fraser was clearly a good soldier, calm and resilient. ·
29.ex_zh: 乔治；弗雷泽显然是个好士兵，沉着冷静且适应力强。

29.def_en: v. to satisfy (a need, a desire, etc.) fully or to excess

29.ex_zh: 晚餐足以让这些美食家们大饱口福。

29.def_en: v. to make clear and easier to understand

29.ex_zh: 我们这位有趣的老师几乎能解释清楚我们所学的所有科目

29.def_en: adj. characterized by or expressive of a concern with morality

29.ex_zh: 对我来说，说教电影简直难以忍受。

29.def_en: adj. causing people to be offended

29.ex_zh: 我觉得他理论中的种族主义含意令人厌恶。

29.def_en: (1)v. to have particular meaning or importance for someone (2)v. to continue to produce a loud, clear, deep sound for a long time (3)v. to relate harmoniously
29.def_zh: 对某人有重要性；共振；一致
29.ex_en: What are the issues resonating with voters?
29.ex_zh: 什么是投票者特别关心的问题？

29.def_en: v. to thoroughly overwhelm and reduce to submission or passivity

29.ex_zh: 已调集了增援警力来平定骚乱。

29.def_en: adj. tending to create a favorable impression
29.ex_en: A prepossessing performer with a beautiful baritone, Murray is tall, blond and Midwestern-looking.
29.ex_zh: 一个很吸引人的表演者和一个漂亮的男中音，莫利高大、金发碧眼，有着中西部人的外貌。

29.def_en: (1)adj. not precise or fixed in meaning: ambiguous, elusive (2)adj. not to be trusted
29.def_zh: 难以抓住的，棘手的；不可靠的

29.ex_zh: 事实上，企业个性是一种奇怪的而且靠不住的说法。

29.def_en: (1)adj. not false or artificial (2)adj. lacking art, knowledge, or skill

29.ex_zh: 她的表情和寥寥几句质朴无华的语言已充分表达了她的感激与高兴。

29.def_en: v. to criticize sharply
29.ex_en: The president rebuked the House and Senate for not passing those bills within 100 days. 100
29.ex_zh: 总统指责参众两院没有在；天之内通过那些法案。

29.def_en: v. to check or diminish the activity or vigor

29.ex_zh: 政府一直在设法抑制人们对经济迅速复苏的期望。

29.def_en: (1)v. delay, defer (2)v. to extend forward or outward
29.ex_en: The had certainly taken his time, even protracting the process.
29.ex_zh: 他肯定是慢慢来的，甚至还拖延进程。

29.def_en: n. something strange, droll, curious, or eccentric

29.ex_zh: 他再次出场妙语脱口而出。

29.def_en: (1)adj. making provision for the future (2)adj. frugal, saving
29.ex_en: They are provident statesmen.
29.ex_zh: 他们是有远见的政治家。

29.def_en: adj. a member of a minority group who retains the customs, language, or social views of the group
29.ex_en: There are still several million ethnic Germans in Russia.
29.ex_zh: 在俄罗斯仍有几百万德国族裔。

29.def_en: (1)adj. pleasing to the mind or senses (2)adj. able to be accepted

29.ex_zh: 一段时间空闲是令人愉快的，整日无所事事可能就单调乏味了。

29.def_en: (1)v. to offend or insult (2)adj. very small in degree or amount

29.ex_zh: 没有充分征求他们的意见，这让他们感到被冷落了。

29.def_en: adj. comfortably or conveniently spacious

29.ex_zh: 客房宽敞舒适且陈设考究。

29.def_en: v. to fill completely with something that permeates or pervades

29.ex_zh: 那家公司的产品已使电子记事簿市场饱和。

29.def_en: n. an immature or inexperienced person
29.ex_en: It turns out to be a fledgling mercenary to save them.
29.ex_zh: 结果是一个新手雇佣兵去救他们。

29.def_en: v. to be sparing or frugal

29.ex_zh: 她举办聚会吃的东西从不小气。

29.def_en: adj. reduced to poverty

29.ex_zh: 他们因长期失业而一贫如洗。

29.def_en: v. to struggle at close quarters with disorder and confusion

29.ex_zh: 在离开所住的旅馆时，她和一些摄影记者发生了冲突。

29.def_en: adj. giving warning

29.ex_zh: 病人可有先兆性症状，例如易于激动，出汗和心动过速。

29.def_en: v. to cause to combine, unite, or coalesce

29.ex_zh: 美国银行和一家竞争银行合并了。

29.def_en: v. to collect and often hide away a supply of

29.ex_zh: 由于人们预计价格会迅速上升，他们开始储藏商品。

29.def_en: v. to overturn or overthrow from the foundation

29.ex_zh: 反叛军队企图颠覆政府统治。

29.ex_zh: 你的两张照片拍的都是静止物体。

29.def_en: n. a nervous or fearful feeling of uncertain agitation

29.ex_zh: 我忐忑不安地等着足球赛的结果。

29.def_en: (1)adj. hard to find or capture (2)adj. hard to understand, define, or remember

29.ex_zh: 翻译时设法把握住原文中难以捉摸的风韵。

29.def_en: (1)adj. highly developed and complex (2)adj. finely experienced and aware

29.ex_zh: 他们在作弊，但因为手法老练没有被发现。

29.def_en: n. a person who stimulates or annoys other people especially by persistent criticism

29.ex_zh: 布坎南只是故意搅局还是对总统构成真正的威胁，这还有待观察。

29.def_en: v. reject or dismiss as contemptible or unworthy

29.ex_zh: 他以前总是嘲笑巴斯克斯博士的社会主义观点。

29.def_en: n. a privilege, gain, or profit incidental to regular salary or wages
29.ex_en: Politics in Britain used to be the perquisite of the property-owning classes.
29.ex_zh: 英国的政治以往是有产阶级的特权。

29.def_en: n. people who use violent or extreme methods

29.ex_zh: 该国需要强大的情报机构来打击间谍活动和外国极端分子。

29.def_en: v. to prevent from doing something or to stop from happening

29.ex_zh: 会计事务所故意毁坏文件，阻挠政府调查工作。

29.def_en: n. a strong feeling of dislike or hatred

29.ex_zh: 当和平最终来临时这两个民族间战时的敌意消退为彼此的不信任。

29.def_en: adj. of the greatest importance
29.ex_en: This step is all-important for solving the problem.
29.ex_zh: 这个步骤在解决此问题中至关重要。

29.def_en: v. to cause of feeling of great wonder or surprise in ...
29.ex_en: A matter of repeated occurrence like this will not astonish people.
29.ex_zh: 这样司空见惯的事，不会使人吃惊。

29.def_en: adj. very small
29.ex_en: The film was shot in 17 days, a minuscule amount of time. 17
29.ex_zh: 这部电影仅用短短的；天便拍摄完毕。

29.def_en: v. to extract all the essential passages or portions from
29.def_zh: 取出内脏，取出基本内容

29.ex_zh: 冷冻鱼之前并不总是需要先把内脏掏空。

29.def_en: adj. very concerned about someone s safety, health, or comfort

29.ex_zh: 她知道这一切即将结束；反倒变得很有些放心不下了

29.def_en: adj. very fashionable

29.ex_zh: 这个地方非常有意识地追求时髦。

29.def_en: n. the quality or state of being very exact, careful, or strict

29.ex_zh: 这一罪行会严格依法审理。

30.def_en: adj. genetically transmitted or transmittable from parent to offspring
30.ex_en: In men, hair loss is hereditary.
30.ex_zh: 男性脱发属于遗传。

30.def_en: adj. disdainfully or skeptically humorous
30.ex_en: Occasionally he made a humorously sardonic remark.
30.ex_zh: 他时不时说一句幽默嘲讽的话。

30.def_en: v. to publicly criticize in a very harsh way
30.ex_en: She is pillory in the press for her extravagant parties. , .
30.ex_zh: 她的聚会十分铺张；新闻界对她大加揶揄

30.def_en: adj. pleasant or amiable in person: attractive
30.def_zh: 和蔼可亲的，平易近人的
30.ex_en: Everyone knows that it's wise to be friendly and personable when in the company of the boss.
30.ex_zh: 每个人都知道在老板的公司里聪明的做法是友善、和睦。

30.def_en: v. to behave in a manner conformable to what is right, proper, or expected
30.ex_en: Another aspect of executive presence is comportment your way of conducting yourself in interacting with others.
30.ex_zh: —；领导者气质的另一方面就是举止风度——你与他人交流时行为表现。

30.def_en: adj. living or lasting for a short time
30.ex_en: Chantal told Martine about her short- lived marriage.
30.ex_zh: 尚塔尔跟马丁内谈起她短暂的婚姻。

30.def_en: n. a church that is the official seat of a diocesan bishop
30.ex_en: A prayer vigil is being held in the cathedral in memory of the bishop
30.ex_zh: 为了纪念这位主教，教堂里正在举行守夜祈祷。

30.def_en: n. a major change or period of change that causes a lot of conflict, confusion, anger, etc.
30.ex_en: It was a violent political upheaval.
30.ex_zh: 这是一场激烈的政治动乱。

30.def_en: adj. marked by moderation
30.ex_en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
30.ex_zh: 尼罗河流域一年四季气候温和。

30.def_en: adj. of, relating to, suggestive of, or characteristic of a totem or totemism
30.ex_en: The religion of ancient Egypt emerged from the worship of tribal deities represented as totemic animals.
30.ex_zh: 古埃及的宗教信仰产生于对以图腾动物为代表的部落神的膜拜。

30.def_en: v. play down, de- emphasize
30.ex_en: On the issue of industrial pollution, the environmental activist plead with the government not to soft - pedal.
30.ex_zh: 自然环境保护活动分子请求政府不要淡化工业污染问题。

30.def_en: n. the lowest point
30.ex_en: The demand for this product will reach its nadir within two years.
30.ex_zh: 对此产品的需求在两年内将达到最低点。

30.def_en: v. to shorten by or as if by cutting off
30.ex_en: He truncated a news item to fit the available space.
30.ex_zh: 他删节一则新闻以适应报纸的篇幅。

30.def_en: adj. lavishly productive
30.ex_en: The vegetation is lush on the Hawaiian Islands.
30.ex_zh: 夏威夷岛上的植被很葱翠。

30.def_en: n. a typical or ideal example
30.ex_en: Zhenjing GRE is the epitome of GRE training. GRE GRE
30.ex_zh: 真经；是；培训的典型。

30.def_en: adj. feeling bored or impatient while waiting for something to happen or change
30.ex_en: The audience grew restive.
30.ex_zh: 观众变得不耐烦了。

30.def_en: (1)adj. made or produced first (2)adj. not like others
30.ex_en: The original plan was to hold an indefinite stoppage.
30.ex_zh: 最初的计划是无限期停工。

30.def_en: v. to present and urge reasons in opposition
30.ex_en: He remonstrated with the referee.
30.ex_zh: 他向裁判抗议。

30.def_en: adj. qualified to participate or be chosen
30.ex_en: Mike was not eligible for the examin ation because he was over age.
30.ex_zh: 迈克不能参加考试资格，因他已超龄

30.def_en: n. a hiding place especially for concealing and preserving provisions or implements
30.ex_en: A huge arms cache was discovered by police.
30.ex_zh: 警方发现了大批私藏的军火。

30.def_en: (1)adj. complete or total (2)adj. not having the skills, knowledge, or experience needed to do a particular job or activity
30.def_zh: 完全的，不受限制的；无资格的
30.ex_en: I gave her my unqualified support.
30.ex_zh: 我全力支持她。

30.def_en: v. to get rid of completely usually by killing off
30.ex_en: Some people exterminate garden insects by spraying poison on the plants.
30.ex_zh: 有些人在植物上喷撒毒剂以杀死花园内的昆虫。

30.def_en: (1)adj. lacking confidence (2)adj. very careful about acting or speaking
30.def_zh: 缺乏自信的；言行谨慎的
30.ex_en: He is diffident about expressing his opinions in the public.
30.ex_zh: 他在公开场合表达自己的意见感到胆怯。

30.def_en: v. to delight in
30.ex_en: She drank the wine slowly, savoring every drop. ,
30.ex_zh: 她慢慢地喝着葡萄酒；细细品味。

30.def_en: adj. showing concern for the happiness and welfare of other people rather than for yourself
30.ex_en: Nations are governed by self - interest, but they prefer to believe that their aims are altruistic. ,
30.ex_zh: 各国都只考虑自己的利益；却总愿意相信自己的目标是大公无私的。

30.def_en: adj. falsely appearing to be fair, just, or right
30.ex_en: It is unlikely that the Duke was convinced by such specious arguments.
30.ex_zh: 公爵不太可能相信这种似是而非的论点。

30.def_en: (1)v. to find an answer or solution to (2)v. to make a definite and serious decision to do something (3)n. a strong determination to do something
30.ex_en: we must find a way to resolve these problems before it's too late.
30.ex_zh: 我们必须及时找到解决这些问题的方法。

30.def_en: v. to prove to be false or wrong
30.ex_en: They accepted what he had said in default of any evidence to disprove it. ,
30.ex_zh: 由于没有相反的证据；他们相信了他的话。

30.def_en: adj. showing a readiness or desire to fight or argue
30.ex_en: He is a pugnacious fighter.
30.ex_zh: 他是个好斗的战士。

30.def_en: adj. not willing to accept new or different ideas
30.ex_en: You will never change their ideas because they are far too hidebound. ,
30.ex_zh: 你无法改变他们的意思；因为他们太墨守成规。

30.def_en: n. one who expends resources foolishly and self-indulgently
30.ex_en: Her father wouldn't let her marry a wastrel.
30.ex_zh: 她的父亲不会让她嫁给一个败家子。

30.def_en: adj. not enough or not good enough
30.ex_en: Supplies of food and medicines are inadequate.
30.ex_zh: 食物和药品供应不足。

30.def_en: adj. having, revealing, or marked by a smug, ingratiating, and false earnestness or spirituality
30.ex_en: The kind of unctuous tone that I've heard often at diplomatic parties.
30.ex_zh: 我常在外交聚会上听到的那种虚与委蛇的腔调

30.def_en: (1)adj. moving about aimlessly or irregularly (2)adj. behaving wrongly
30.ex_en: His errant son at Dartmouth ran up debts of 250m. 2 5
30.ex_zh: 他那行为出格的儿子在达特茅斯欠下了高达；亿；千万英镑的债务。

30.def_en: (1)adj. not having enough of something for comfort or happiness (2)adj. having little thin
30.ex_en: He could not support his family on his meager salary.
30.ex_zh: 他靠微薄的工资无法养家。

30.def_en: n. forecast, prognostication
30.ex_en: If the cancer is caught early the prognosis is excellent.
30.ex_zh: 如果癌症在早期发现，预后效果还是非常好的。

30.def_en: n. the substitution of an agreeable or inoffensive expression for one that may offend or suggest something unpleasant
30.ex_en: The term early retirement is nearly al ways a euphemism for redundancy nowadays.
30.ex_zh: 现在提前退休几乎就是裁员的委婉说法。

30.def_en: v. to cause to change direction
30.ex_en: The war did not deflect him from the path he had long ago taken.
30.ex_zh: 战争并没有使他放弃自己很久以前就选择的道路。

30.def_en: v. to keep company
30.ex_en: You should consort with your girlfriend and attend the opening ceremony.
30.ex_zh: 你应该陪你的女友参加开幕式。

30.def_en: (1)n. a strong feeling of happiness (2)v. to make very happy
30.ex_en: Andrew roared with delight when he heard Rachel's nickname for the baby.
30.ex_zh: 安德鲁听到雷切尔给婴儿起的绰号时，不禁高兴得大笑起来。

30.def_en: v. to occur, fall, or come between points of time or events
30.ex_en: The situation calmed down when police intervened
30.ex_zh: 警方介入后，局势平息下来。

30.def_en: (1)adj. causing fear, dread, or apprehension (2)adj. tending to inspire awe or wonder (3)adj. very difficult to deal with
30.def_zh: 可怕的；令人敬畏的；难对付的
30.ex_en: We have a formidable task ahead of us.
30.ex_zh: 我们面临着一项艰巨的任务。

30.def_en: adj. very clever and able to make intelligent
30.ex_en: A canny investor would need to predict when the dollar will once more start tumbling.
30.ex_zh: 精明的投资者需要预计到美元何时会再次大跌。

30.def_en: (1)adj. of or relating to a separate person or thing (2)adj. distinguished by superiority (3)adj. departing from general usage or expectation
30.ex_en: Cardinal Meschia was without doubt a singular character.
30.ex_zh: 红衣主教梅斯基亚无疑是个怪人。
